import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 shrink-0 [&_svg]:shrink-0 outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 dark:bg-destructive/60",
        outline:
          "border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:border-input dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3",
        sm: "h-8 rounded-md gap-1.5 px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5",
        lg: "h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4",
        icon: "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

===== FILE: src/components/ui/form.tsx =====
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import {
  Controller,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
  useFormState,
  type ControllerProps,
  type FieldPath,
  type FieldValues,
} from "react-hook-form"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
> = {
  name: TName
}

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue
)

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  )
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState } = useFormContext()
  const formState = useFormState({ name: fieldContext.name })
  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue
)

function FormItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div
        data-slot="form-item"
        className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  )
}

function FormLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>) {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Label
      data-slot="form-label"
      data-error={!!error}
      className={cn("data-[error=true]:text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormControl({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Slot>) {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Slot
      data-slot="form-control"
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-description"
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormMessage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message ?? "") : props.children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-message"
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-destructive text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  )
}

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}



===== FILE: src/components/ui/carousel.tsx =====
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

function Carousel({
  orientation = "horizontal",
  opts,
  setApi,
  plugins,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & CarouselProps) {
  const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
    {
      ...opts,
      axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
    },
    plugins
  )
  const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
  const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

  const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
    if (!api) return
    setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
    setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
  }, [])

  const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollPrev()
  }, [api])

  const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollNext()
  }, [api])

  const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
    (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollPrev()
      } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollNext()
      }
    },
    [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
  )

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api || !setApi) return
    setApi(api)
  }, [api, setApi])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api) return
    onSelect(api)
    api.on("reInit", onSelect)
    api.on("select", onSelect)

    return () => {
      api?.off("select", onSelect)
    }
  }, [api, onSelect])

  return (
    <CarouselContext.Provider
      value={{
        carouselRef,
        api: api,
        opts,
        orientation:
          orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
        scrollPrev,
        scrollNext,
        canScrollPrev,
        canScrollNext,
      }}
    >
      <div
        onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
        className={cn("relative", className)}
        role="region"
        aria-roledescription="carousel"
        data-slot="carousel"
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </CarouselContext.Provider>
  )
}

function CarouselContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      ref={carouselRef}
      className="overflow-hidden"
      data-slot="carousel-content"
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

function CarouselItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      data-slot="carousel-item"
      className={cn(
        "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
        orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CarouselPrevious({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-previous"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute size-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "top-1/2 -left-12 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollPrev}
      onClick={scrollPrev}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowLeft />
      <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

function CarouselNext({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-next"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute size-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "top-1/2 -right-12 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollNext}
      onClick={scrollNext}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowRight />
      <span className="sr-only">Next slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

export {
  type CarouselApi,
  Carousel,

// =====================================================
// ASSIGN MODAL WRAPPER
// =====================================================
function AssignModalWrapper() {
  const open = useYudit((s) => s.assignModalOpen);
  const fileId = useYudit((s) => s.assignModalFileId);
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const close = useYudit((s) => s.closeAssignModal);

  const file = useMemo(
    () => files.find((f) => f.id === fileId),
    [files, fileId],
  );

  if (!open || !fileId || !file) return null;

  return (
    <AssignDocumentModal
      open={open}
      fileId={fileId}
      fileName={file.name}
      onClose={close}
    />
  );
}

// =====================================================
// EDITOR MOUNT
// =====================================================
function EditorMount() {
  const editorState = useYudit((s) => s.editorState);
  const closeEditor = useYudit((s) => s.closeEditor);
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);

  const file = useMemo(
    () => (editorState ? files.find((f) => f.id === editorState.fileId) : null),
    [files, editorState],
  );

  if (!editorState || !file) return null;

  const handleClose = () => {
    closeEditor();
    fetchFiles();
  };

  if (editorState.mode === "local") {
    return (
      <DocEditor fileId={file.id} fileName={file.name} onClose={handleClose} />
    );
  }
  if (editorState.mode === "google_docs") {
    return (
      <GoogleDocViewer
        fileId={file.id}
        fileName={file.name}
        existingDocId={file.google_doc_id}
        onClose={handleClose}
      />
    );
  }
  if (editorState.mode === "preview") {
    return (
      <DocPreviewViewer
        fileId={file.id}
        fileName={file.name}
        onClose={handleClose}
      />
    );
  }
  return null;
}

  return (

          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.18)]">

              <span className="sm:hidden">Drives</span>
            </button>

              type="button"

// =====================================================
// VIEW ROUTER
// =====================================================
function ViewRouter({ view }: { view: string }) {
  switch (view) {
    case "files":
      return <FilesView />;
    case "my-tasks":
      return <MyTasksView />;
    case "convert":
      return <ConvertView />;
    case "monthly":
      return <MonthlyView />;
    case "stats":
      return <StatsView />;
    case "drives":
      return <DrivesView />;
    case "collaborators":
      return <CollaboratorsView />;
    case "profile":
      return <ProfileView />;
    // ⭐ scan & transfer adalah halaman terpisah (/scan, /transfer)
    // setView sudah redirect ke route terpisah, jadi tidak akan sampai sini
    // Case ini hanya untuk defensive programming / jika state lama tersimpan
    case "scan":
    case "transfer":
      return <FilesView />;
    default:
      return <FilesView />;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// MAIN COMPONENT
// =====================================================
export function YuditCloud() {
  const isAuthenticated = useYudit((s) => s.isAuthenticated);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const currentView = useYudit((s) => s.currentView);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const bootstrapAuth = useYudit((s) => s.bootstrapAuth);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);
  const fetchDrives = useYudit((s) => s.fetchDrives);
  const fetchCategories = useYudit((s) => s.fetchCategories);
  const fetchCollaborators = useYudit((s) => s.fetchCollaborators);
  const fetchConversionOperations = useYudit(
    (s) => s.fetchConversionOperations,
  );
  const fetchConversionJobs = useYudit((s) => s.fetchConversionJobs);

  // ⭐ Auto-track page views untuk Activity History
  usePageTracker();

  // ⭐ Auto-apply theme & language setelah login
  useApplyPreferences();

  useEffect(() => {
    registerToast((msg, type) => {
      if (type === "success") toast.success(msg);
      else if (type === "error") toast.error(msg);
      else toast(msg);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    bootstrapAuth();
  }, [bootstrapAuth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const oauthSuccess = params.get("oauth_success");
    const oauthError = params.get("oauth_error");

    if (!oauthSuccess && !oauthError) return;

    if (!canManageWorkspace(user)) {
      window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/");
      return;
    }

    setView("drives");

    if (oauthSuccess === "connected") {
      toast.success("Google Drive berhasil dihubungkan!");
    } else if (oauthError) {
      const errorMessages: Record<string, string> = {
        max_accounts: "Batas maksimal akun tercapai",
        duplicate_account: "Akun Google Drive sudah terhubung",
        no_refresh_token:
          "Google tidak mengirim refresh token. Coba connect ulang.",
        invalid_state: "Sesi OAuth tidak valid",
        forbidden:
          "Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa connect Google Drive.",
        user_not_found: "User tidak ditemukan",
        inactive_user: "Akun Anda dinonaktifkan",
        exchange_failed: "Gagal menukar kode OAuth. Coba lagi.",
        userinfo_failed: "Gagal mengambil info user dari Google. Coba lagi.",
        save_failed: "Gagal menyimpan akun Drive. Coba lagi.",
      };
      toast.error(errorMessages[oauthError] || `Gagal connect: ${oauthError}`);
    }

    fetchDrives().catch(() => {});
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/");
  }, [isAuthenticated, user, setView, fetchDrives]);

  // ⭐ FETCH DATA untuk SEMUA role (member = read-only)
  // ⭐ Semua fetch dibungkus .catch() SILENT agar 401 tidak spam console
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated || !user) return;

    // ⭐ Defensive: kalau currentView adalah halaman terpisah (scan/transfer)
    // yang somehow tersimpan di persist state, redirect ke halaman yang sesuai.
    if (currentView === "scan") {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        window.location.href = "/scan";
      }
      return;
    }
    if (currentView === "transfer") {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        window.location.href = "/transfer";
      }
      return;
    }

    const targetView = canAccessView(user, currentView)
      ? currentView
      : defaultViewForRole(user);

    if (targetView !== currentView) {
      setView(targetView);
      return;
    }

    const filesViews = ["files", "my-tasks", "monthly", "stats", "convert"];
    if (filesViews.includes(currentView)) {
      fetchFiles().catch(() => {});
    }

    if (currentView === "convert") {
      fetchConversionOperations().catch(() => {});
      fetchConversionJobs().catch(() => {});
    }

    // ⭐ Fetch drives, collabs, categories untuk semua role
    fetchDrives().catch(() => {});
    fetchCollaborators().catch(() => {});
    fetchCategories().catch(() => {});
  }, [
    isAuthenticated,
    user,
    currentView,
    setView,
    fetchFiles,
    fetchDrives,
    fetchCategories,
    fetchCollaborators,
    fetchConversionOperations,
    fetchConversionJobs,
  ]);

  if (isAuthenticated && user?.must_change_password) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen">
        <ForcedPasswordChangeView />
        <ConfirmDialog />
        <ProgressOverlay />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen">
        <LoginView />
        <ConfirmDialog />
        <ProgressOverlay />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="yudit-ambient relative flex min-h-screen flex-col">
      <div className="relative z-10 flex min-h-screen flex-1">
        <Sidebar />
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <Topbar />

          <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="y-container py-4 sm:py-6 lg:py-8">
              <DriveAuthBanner />

              <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                <motion.div
                  key={currentView}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <ViewRouter view={currentView} />
                </motion.div>
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </main>
        </div>
      </div>

      <PreviewModal />
      <ShareModal />
      <CategoryManagerModal />
      <AssignModalWrapper />
      <ConfirmDialog />
      <ProgressOverlay />
      <EditorMount />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Menu,
  FolderPlus,
  Upload,
  ChevronRight,
  User as UserIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import type { ViewKey } from "@/lib/yudit/types";

// =====================================================
// VIEW TITLES
// ⭐ Harus lengkap untuk SEMUA ViewKey — TypeScript strict mode
// =====================================================
const TITLES: Record<ViewKey, string> = {
  files: "My Files",
  monthly: "Arsip Per Bulan",
  stats: "Statistik & Analytics",
  drives: "Google Drive Accounts",
  convert: "File Conversion",
  collaborators: "Collaborators",
  "my-tasks": "Dokumen Saya",
  profile: "Profil Saya",
  scan: "Cam Scanner",
  transfer: "Transfer Workspace",
};

// ⭐ Views yang TIDAK menampilkan tombol Upload / New Folder
const HIDE_UPLOAD_VIEWS: ViewKey[] = [
  "profile",
  "scan",
  "transfer",
];

export function Topbar() {
  const currentView = useYudit((s) => s.currentView);
  const setSidebarOpen = useYudit((s) => s.setSidebarOpen);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const uploadFiles = useYudit((s) => s.uploadFiles);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);
  const drives = useYudit((s) => s.drives);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);

  const currentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.currentFolderId);
  const setCurrentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.setCurrentFolderId);
  const fetchFolders = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFolders);

  const isManager = canManageWorkspace(user);
  const showUploadActions = !HIDE_UPLOAD_VIEWS.includes(currentView);

  const [folderModalOpen, setFolderModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const triggerUpload = () => {
    if (drives.length === 0) {
      showConfirm(
        "Hubungkan Drive dulu",
        "Tambahkan akun Google Drive sebelum upload file.",
        () => useYudit.getState().setView("drives"),
      );
      return;
    }
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.multiple = true;
    input.onchange = () => {
      if (input.files) {
        uploadFiles(Array.from(input.files), currentFolderId);
      }
    };
    input.click();
  };

  const handleNewFolder = () => {
    if (!isManager) {
      showConfirm(
        "Akses Ditolak",
        "Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa membuat folder.",
        () => {},
      );
      return;
    }
    if (drives.length === 0) {
      showConfirm(
        "Hubungkan Drive dulu",
        "Tambahkan akun Google Drive sebelum membuat folder.",
        () => useYudit.getState().setView("drives"),
      );
      return;
    }
    setFolderModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenProfile = () => {
    setView("profile");
  };

  const initials = (user?.username || "U").charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <>
      <header className="y-glass sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-[var(--y-border)]">
        <div className="y-container flex h-16 items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(true)}
            className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] lg:hidden"
            aria-label="Open menu"
          >
            <Menu size={18} />
          </button>

          <nav className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <span className="hidden text-[var(--y-text-mute)] sm:inline">
              DPRD Cloud
            </span>
            <ChevronRight
              size={14}
              className="hidden text-[var(--y-text-mute)] sm:inline"
            />
            <span className="truncate font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              {TITLES[currentView] || "Dashboard"}
            </span>
          </nav>

          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            {showUploadActions && (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={handleNewFolder}
                  className="hidden h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] sm:inline-flex"
                >
                  <FolderPlus size={15} />
                  <span className="hidden md:inline">New Folder</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={triggerUpload}
                  className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 sm:px-4"
                >
                  <Upload size={15} />
                  <span>Upload</span>
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleOpenProfile}
              className="group ml-1 flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-2 pr-3 transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
              title="Profil Saya"
            >
              <div
                className={`grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold text-white ${
                  user?.role === "owner"
                    ? "y-gradient-brand"
                    : user?.role === "super_admin"
                      ? "bg-[#f59e0b]"
                      : "bg-[var(--y-primary)]"
                }`}
              >
                {initials}
              </div>
              <span className="hidden max-w-[100px] truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] sm:inline">
                {user?.username || "User"}
              </span>
              <UserIcon
                size={13}
                className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors group-hover:text-[var(--y-primary)]"
              />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <CreateFolderModal
        open={folderModalOpen}
        parentId={currentFolderId}
        onClose={() => setFolderModalOpen(false)}
        onCreated={async (folderId) => {
          await fetchFolders(currentFolderId);
          setCurrentFolderId(folderId);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";

interface NavItem {
  key: ViewKey;
  label: string;
  icon: typeof FolderOpen;
  /** Optional badge number override (bukan dari getBadge) */
  badgeCount?: number;
  /** Kalau true, item hanya tampil untuk owner */
  ownerOnly?: boolean;
}

// =====================================================
// NAV ITEMS
// =====================================================
function getNavItems(role: UserRole | undefined): NavItem[] {
  const base: NavItem[] = [
    { key: "files", label: "My Files", icon: FolderOpen },
  ];

  if (role === "member") {
    base.push({
      key: "my-tasks",
      label: "Dokumen Saya",
      icon: ClipboardCheck,
    });
  }

  // ⭐ Cam Scanner — semua role boleh (member upload ke pool owner)
  base.push({
    key: "scan",
    label: "Cam Scanner",
    icon: ScanLine,
  });

  base.push(
    { key: "convert", label: "Konversi Dokumen", icon: FileCog },
    { key: "monthly", label: "Per Bulan", icon: CalendarDays },
    { key: "stats", label: "Statistik", icon: BarChart3 },
  );

  // Drives & Collaborators tampil untuk SEMUA role
  // (member = read-only, action button disembunyikan di view)
  base.push(
    { key: "drives", label: "Google Drive", icon: HardDrive },
    { key: "collaborators", label: "Collaborators", icon: Users },
  );

  return base;
}

function formatBadge(n: number): string {
  if (n > 99) return "99+";
  return String(n);
}

export function Sidebar() {
  const currentView = useYudit((s) => s.currentView);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const sidebarOpen = useYudit((s) => s.sidebarOpen);
  const setSidebarOpen = useYudit((s) => s.setSidebarOpen);
  const pool = useYudit((s) => s.pool);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const drives = useYudit((s) => s.drives);
  const conversionJobs = useYudit((s) => s.conversionJobs);
  const collaborators = useYudit((s) => s.collaborators);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);
  const logout = useYudit((s) => s.logout);

  const NAV = getNavItems(user?.role);
  const isManager = canManageWorkspace(user);
  const isOwnerUser = isOwner(user);
  const pct = pool.total > 0 ? Math.round((pool.used / pool.total) * 100) : 0;

  const handleLogout = () => {
    showConfirm("Logout?", "Kamu akan keluar dari akun ini.", logout);
  };

  const handleOpenProfile = () => {
    setView("profile");
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.innerWidth < 1024) {
      setSidebarOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const convertingCount = conversionJobs.filter(
    (j) => j.status === "processing",
  ).length;

  const activeCategories = new Set(
    files.map((f) => f.category).filter((c): c is string => !!c),
  ).size;

  function getBadge(key: ViewKey): number | null {
    switch (key) {
      case "files":
        return files.length > 0 ? files.length : null;
      case "my-tasks":
        return files.length > 0 ? files.length : null;
      case "monthly":
        return countMonthlyFolders(files) || null;
      case "drives":
        return drives.length > 0 ? drives.length : null;
      case "convert":
        return convertingCount > 0 ? convertingCount : null;
      case "collaborators":
        return collaborators.length > 0 ? collaborators.length : null;
      case "stats":
        return activeCategories > 0 ? activeCategories : null;
      // ⭐ scan & transfer: tidak ada badge
      case "scan":
      case "transfer":
      default:
        return null;
    }
  }

  const isProfileActive = currentView === "profile";

  return (
    <>
      {sidebarOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-sm lg:hidden"
          onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

        >
          <ChevronLeft size={14} />
        </button>
      </aside>
    </>

function countMonthlyFolders(files: { folder_name: string | null }[]): number {
  const set = new Set<string>();
  files.forEach((f) => set.add(f.folder_name || "Tanpa Folder"));
  return set.size;
}

===== FILE: src/components/yudit/ui/dropzone.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/ui/dropzone.tsx
"use client";

import { useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { UploadCloud } from "lucide-react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Dropzone() {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragover, setDragover] = useState(false);
  const uploadFiles = useYudit((s) => s.uploadFiles);
  const drives = useYudit((s) => s.drives);
  // ⭐ FIX: sekarang store baru punya currentFolderId
  const currentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.currentFolderId);

  const handleFiles = (files: FileList | null) => {
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
    // ⭐ Pass currentFolderId (2 argumen — signature baru)
    uploadFiles(Array.from(files), currentFolderId);
  };

  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragover(false);
    handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="mb-5"
    >
      <button
        onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
        onDragEnter={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragover(true);
        }}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragover(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragover(false);
        }}
        onDrop={onDrop}
        className={cn(
          "group flex w-full flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed px-5 py-7 text-center transition-all",
          dragover
            ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.08)]"
            : "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] shadow-sm",
        )}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            "mb-2 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl transition-transform",
            dragover ? "scale-110" : "group-hover:scale-105",
          )}
          style={{
            background:
              "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.1), rgba(249,115,22,0.1))",
            boxShadow: "0 8px 24px rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
          }}
        >
          <UploadCloud size={26} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          Drop file di sini atau klik untuk upload
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {currentFolderId
            ? "File akan masuk ke folder yang sedang dibuka"
            : "File otomatis dikategorikan & masuk folder bulanan"}
          {drives.length === 0 && " • Hubungkan Drive dulu"}
        </div>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="file"
          multiple
          hidden
          onChange={(e) => {
            handleFiles(e.target.files);
            e.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
      </button>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";

export function ProgressOverlay() {

    <AnimatePresence>
      {progress.open && (

          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}

          style={{
            background: "rgba(10, 15, 31, 0.82)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
          }}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
            className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] p-8 text-center"
          >
            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-full">
              <Loader2 size={32} className="y-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
            </div>
            <div className="mb-1 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              {progress.label}
            </div>
            <div className="mb-4 truncate text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
              {progress.sub}
            </div>

            {/* ============================================
                PROGRESS BAR
                - Indeterminate (pct === null): pulse animation
                - Determinate: smooth width animation
                ============================================ */}
            <div className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
              {isIndeterminate ? (
                <motion.div
                  className="h-full rounded-full"
                  style={{
                    background:
                      "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))",
                  }}
                  animate={{
                    x: ["-100%", "100%"],
                  }}
                  transition={{
                    duration: 1.4,
                    repeat: Infinity,
                    ease: "easeInOut",
                  }}
                  initial={{ width: "40%" }}
                />
              ) : (
                <motion.div
                  className="h-full rounded-full"
                  style={{
                    background:
                      "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))",
                  }}
                  initial={{ width: "0%" }}
                  animate={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: "easeOut" }}
                />
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Percentage label untuk determinate */}
            {!isIndeterminate && typeof pct === "number" && (
              <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                {pct}%
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

// src/components/yudit/ui/file-row.tsx
"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";

import { DocEditor } from "../editor/doc-editor";
import { GoogleDocViewer } from "../editor/google-doc-viewer";
import { DocPreviewViewer } from "../editor/doc-preview-viewer";
import type { FileItem, EditorMode, User } from "@/lib/yudit/types";
import { formatBytes, formatDate, extOf } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import { useYudit, canManageWorkspace } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { fetchFileBlob } from "@/lib/api/files";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { FileIcon } from "./file-icon";

const GRID_CLASSNAME = cn(
  "grid items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 rounded-xl border border-transparent",
  "px-2 sm:px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors",
  "hover:border-[var(--y-border-soft)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]",

  "lg:grid-cols-[44px_minmax(0,1fr)_100px_160px_200px]",
);

function isDocxFile(file: FileItem): boolean {
  const ext = extOf(file.name);
  if (ext !== "docx") return false;
  const mime = file.mime_type || "";
  return (
    mime ===
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" ||
    mime === "application/msword" ||
    mime === ""
  );
}

function canEditFile(file: FileItem, user: User | null): boolean {
  if (!user) return false;
  if (!isDocxFile(file)) return false;
  if (user.role === "owner" || user.role === "super_admin") return true;
  return file.can_edit_to_me === true;
}

function canDeleteFile(file: FileItem, user: User | null): boolean {
  if (!user) return false;
  if (user.role === "owner" || user.role === "super_admin") return true;
  return file.can_delete_to_me === true;
}

// ⭐ Semua role selalu bisa share (backend sudah izinkan)
function canShareFile(file: FileItem, user: User | null): boolean {
  return !!user;
}

interface FileRowProps {
  file: FileItem;
  index?: number;
  showFolder?: boolean;
  alwaysShowActions?: boolean;
  assignmentCount?: number;
}

export function FileRow({
  file,
  index = 0,
  showFolder = false,
  alwaysShowActions = false,
  assignmentCount = 0,
}: FileRowProps) {
  const openPreview = useYudit((s) => s.openPreview);
  const openShare = useYudit((s) => s.openShare);
  const openAssignModal = useYudit((s) => s.openAssignModal);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);
  const deleteFile = useYudit((s) => s.deleteFile);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);

  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [editingMode, setEditingMode] = useState<EditorMode | null>(null);

  const isManager = canManageWorkspace(user);
  const canEdit = canEditFile(file, user);
  const canDelete = canDeleteFile(file, user);
  const canShare = canShareFile(file, user);
  const isDocx = isDocxFile(file);
  const isPdf = extOf(file.name) === "pdf";
  const isAssignedToSomeone = assignmentCount > 0;

  const handleDelete = () => {
    showConfirm(
      "Hapus file?",
      "File akan dihapus permanen dari penyimpanan.",
      () => {
        deleteFile(file.id);
      },
    );
  };

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    setDownloading(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading(`Mengunduh ${file.name}…`);
    try {
      const blob = await fetchFileBlob(file.id, "download");
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = file.name;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
      toast.success(`"${file.name}" berhasil diunduh`, { id: toastId });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.isDriveError) {
        const email = e.driveEmail || "Google Drive";
        toast.error(
          `${email} perlu di-reconnect. Buka menu "Google Drive" untuk memperbaiki.`,
          {
            id: toastId,
            duration: 10000,
            action: {
              label: "Buka Drives",
              onClick: () => setView("drives"),
            },
          },
        );
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
          window.dispatchEvent(
            new CustomEvent("yudit:drive-auth-error", {
              detail: {
                email: e.driveEmail,
                driveId: e.driveId,
                message: e.detail,
              },
            }),
          );
        }
      } else if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 404) {
        toast.error(
          "File tidak ditemukan di Google Drive (mungkin sudah dihapus).",
          { id: toastId },
        );
      } else {
        const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal download file";
        toast.error(msg, { id: toastId });
      }
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEditLocal = () => {
    if (!isDocx) {
      toast.error("Hanya file .docx yang bisa diedit");
      return;
    }
    if (user?.role === "member" && file.can_edit_to_me === false) {
      toast.error(
        "Anda tidak punya izin edit dokumen ini. " +
          "Minta owner untuk assign dokumen ke Anda.",
      );
      return;
    }
    setEditingMode("local");
  };

  const handleEditGoogleDocs = () => {
    if (!isDocx) {
      toast.error("Hanya file .docx yang bisa di-convert ke Google Docs");
      return;
    }
    setEditingMode("google_docs");
  };

  const handlePreviewFull = () => {
    if (!isDocx) {
      toast.error("Hanya file .docx yang bisa di-preview");
      return;
    }
    setEditingMode("preview");
  };

  const handleCloseEditor = () => {
    setEditingMode(null);
    fetchFiles();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{
          duration: 0.2,
          delay: Math.min(index * 0.015, 0.2),
        }}
        className={cn("group", GRID_CLASSNAME)}
      >
        <button
          onClick={() => openPreview(file.id)}
          className="flex items-center justify-center"
          title="Preview"
        >
          <FileIcon mime={file.mime_type || ""} name={file.name} />
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => openPreview(file.id)}
          className="flex min-w-0 flex-col text-left"
          title={file.name}
        >
          <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-[var(--y-text)] transition-colors group-hover:text-[var(--y-primary)]">
            {file.name}
          </span>

          {showFolder && file.folder_name && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              📅 {file.folder_name}
            </span>
          )}

          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 sm:hidden">
            <span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              {formatBytes(file.size)}
            </span>
            {file.category && (
              <>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">•</span>
                <CategoryBadge category={file.category} />
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {file.google_doc_id && (
              <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-[rgba(66,133,244,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold text-[#4285f4]">
                <FileText size={8} />
                Google Docs
              </span>
            )}
            {isAssignedToSomeone && (
              <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-[rgba(168,85,247,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold text-[#a855f7]">
                <Users size={8} />
                {assignmentCount} assigned
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </button>

        <div className="hidden text-xs tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text-dim)] sm:block sm:text-right">
          {formatBytes(file.size)}
        </div>

        <div className="hidden min-w-0 lg:block">
          <CategoryBadge category={file.category} />
        </div>

        <div className="file-row-actions-wrapper">
          <div
            className={cn(
              "file-row-actions",
              alwaysShowActions && "always-show",
            )}
          >
            {canEdit && isDocx && (
              <DropdownMenu>
                <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                  <button

                      <PencilLine
                        size={15}
                        className="text-[var(--y-primary)]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                        Edit Cepat
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">

                      </div>

                  </DropdownMenuItem>

                  {isManager && (

                      <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        onClick={() => openAssignModal(file.id)}

                      >
                        <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(168,85,247,0.15)]">
                          <UserPlus size={15} className="text-[#a855f7]" />

                          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">

                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                            {isAssignedToSomeone
                              ? `${assignmentCount} collaborator bisa edit`
                              : "Pilih siapa yang bisa edit dokumen ini"}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </>
                  )}
                </DropdownMenuContent>
              </DropdownMenu>
            )}

            {!isDocx && isPdf && (
              <span
                title="PDF tidak bisa diedit langsung. Convert ke Word dulu via menu Konversi."
                className="grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-md text-[var(--y-text-mute)] opacity-50"
              >
                <Lock size={13} />
              </span>
            )}

            {/* ⭐ Preview — Semua role */}
            <IconBtn label="Preview" onClick={() => openPreview(file.id)}>
              <Eye size={14} />
            </IconBtn>

            {/* ⭐ Share — Semua role */}
            {canShare && (
              <IconBtn label="Bagikan" onClick={() => openShare(file.id)}>
                <Share2 size={14} />
              </IconBtn>
            )}

            {/* ⭐ Download — Semua role */}
            <IconBtn label="Download" onClick={handleDownload}>
              {downloading ? (
                <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Download size={14} />
              )}
            </IconBtn>

            {/* ⭐ Hapus — Hanya jika can_delete */}
            {canDelete && (
              <IconBtn label="Hapus" danger onClick={handleDelete}>
                <Trash2 size={14} />
              </IconBtn>
            )}
          </div>

          <span className="file-row-date">{formatDate(file.created_at)}</span>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {editingMode &&
        typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        createPortal(
          <>
            {editingMode === "local" && (
              <DocEditor
                fileId={file.id}
                fileName={file.name}
                onClose={handleCloseEditor}
              />
            )}
            {editingMode === "google_docs" && (
              <GoogleDocViewer
                fileId={file.id}
                fileName={file.name}
                existingDocId={file.google_doc_id}
                onClose={handleCloseEditor}
                onSyncBack={() => {
                  toast.success("Berhasil sync ke .docx");
                  fetchFiles();
                }}
              />
            )}
            {editingMode === "preview" && (
              <DocPreviewViewer
                fileId={file.id}
                fileName={file.name}
                onClose={handleCloseEditor}
              />
            )}
          </>,
          document.body,
        )}
    </>
  );
}

function IconBtn({
  children,
  onClick,
  danger,
  accent,
  label,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onClick?: () => void;
  danger?: boolean;
  accent?: boolean;
  label: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClick?.();
      }}
      title={label}
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        "grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-md text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors",
        "hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
        accent &&
          "text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-primary)]",
        danger &&
          "hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)]",
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}



===== FILE: src/components/yudit/auth/require-auth.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/auth/require-auth.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { useYudit, isOwner, defaultViewForRole } from "@/lib/yudit/store";

interface RequireAuthProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /** Jika true, hanya role owner yang boleh masuk */
  requireOwner?: boolean;
  /** Redirect jika belum login */
  redirectTo?: string;
}

/**
 * Guard untuk halaman private yang dibuka langsung via URL (/scan, /transfer).
 *
 * Kenapa versi lama bug (redirect ke /?view=files):
 * - Zustand TIDAK persist isAuthenticated/user, jadi saat page load
 *   isAuthenticated=false sampai bootstrapAuth() selesai.
 * - useEffect [ready, isAuthenticated] membaca isAuthenticated dari
 *   closure lama (false) → router.replace("/") padahal sesi VALID.
 *
 * Perbaikan:
 * - isAuthenticated & user DIPERSIST di localStorage (lihat store.ts).
 * - Zustand hydration selesai SEBELUM render pertama → isAuthenticated
 *   sudah benar di render pertama.
 * - bootstrapAuth() dipanggil di useLayoutEffect (sync) untuk catch
 *   perubahan terbaru dari token (misal token dihapus di tab lain).
 * - Redirect baru dilakukan setelah bootstrapped=true.
 */
export function RequireAuth({
  children,
  requireOwner = false,
  redirectTo,
}: RequireAuthProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const isAuthenticated = useYudit((s) => s.isAuthenticated);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const bootstrapped = useYudit((s) => s.bootstrapped);
  const bootstrapAuth = useYudit((s) => s.bootstrapAuth);

  // ⭐ Bootstrap SEBELUM paint (useLayoutEffect) — hindari race
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    bootstrapAuth();
  }, [bootstrapAuth]);

  const ownerOk = !requireOwner || isOwner(user);
  const finalRedirect = redirectTo || "/";

  useEffect(() => {
    // ⭐ Tunggu bootstrapped benar-benar selesai
    if (!bootstrapped) return;

    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      router.replace(finalRedirect);
      return;
    }

    if (!ownerOk) {
      // Redirect ke default view untuk role user (bukan paksa /)
      const targetView = defaultViewForRole(user);
      const targetUrl =
        finalRedirect && finalRedirect !== "/"
          ? finalRedirect
          : `/?view=${targetView}`;
      router.replace(targetUrl);
    }
  }, [bootstrapped, isAuthenticated, ownerOk, user, router, finalRedirect]);

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Render
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  // Loading: tunggu Zustand hydration + bootstrapAuth
  if (!bootstrapped) {
    return (
      <div className="yudit-ambient grid min-h-screen place-items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          <Loader2
            size={22}
            className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
          Memeriksa sesi…
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Belum login → tunggu redirect
  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="yudit-ambient grid min-h-screen place-items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          <Loader2
            size={22}
            className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
          Mengarahkan…
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Login tapi tidak berhak (misal member buka /transfer)
  if (!ownerOk) {
    return (
      <div className="yudit-ambient grid min-h-screen place-items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          <Loader2
            size={22}
            className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
          Mengarahkan…
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}
