// src/components/yudit/transfer/transfer-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  Copy,
  Crown,
  KeyRound,
  Loader2,
  Mail,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldAlert,
  UserPlus,
  X,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  cancelTransfer,
  executeTransfer,
  listTransfers,
  requestTransfer,
  verifyTransfer,
  type Transfer,
  type TransferStatus,
} from "@/lib/api/transfer";
import { useYudit, isOwner } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";

type Step = "intro" | "target" | "verify" | "confirm" | "executing" | "done";

// =====================================================
// ERROR PARSER
// =====================================================
function parseTransferError(err: unknown): {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  hint?: string;
  canReset: boolean;
} {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    const detail = err.detail || "";
    const lower = detail.toLowerCase();

    if (lower.includes("belum terdaftar")) {
      return {
        title: "User Belum Terdaftar",
        message: detail,
        hint:
          "Minta user target untuk mendaftar dulu di DPRD Cloud " +
          "menggunakan email tersebut, lalu coba transfer lagi.",
        canReset: false,
      };
    }

    if (lower.includes("bukan owner") || lower.includes("member")) {
      return {
        title: "Target Bukan Owner",
        message: detail,
        hint:
          "Target harus OWNER di workspace-nya sendiri. " +
          "Kalau dia member di workspace Anda, minta dia daftar " +
          "email baru sebagai owner, ATAU batalkan transfer ini " +
          "dan pilih target owner lain.",
        canReset: true,
      };
    }

    if (lower.includes("tidak bisa transfer ke akun sendiri")) {
      return {
        title: "Email Tidak Valid",
        message: detail,
        hint: "Gunakan email user lain yang terdaftar sebagai OWNER.",
        canReset: false,
      };
    }

    if (lower.includes("sudah ada transfer")) {
      return {
        title: "Transfer Sudah Berjalan",
        message: detail,
        hint:
          "Batalkan transfer yang sedang berjalan dulu di halaman ini, " +
          "atau tunggu sampai selesai.",
        canReset: false,
      };
    }

    if (lower.includes("harus berstatus")) {
      return {
        title: "Status Transfer Tidak Valid",
        message: detail,
        hint: "Batalkan transfer ini lalu mulai dari awal.",
        canReset: true,
      };
    }

    if (err.status === 403) {
      return {
        title: "Akses Ditolak",
        message: detail || "Hanya owner workspace yang bisa transfer.",
        canReset: false,
      };
    }

    return {
      title: "Gagal Memproses",
      message: detail || "Terjadi kesalahan.",
      canReset: false,
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "Gagal Memproses",
    message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Terjadi kesalahan.",
    canReset: false,
  };
}

// =====================================================
// MAIN
// =====================================================
export function TransferView() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const isAuthenticated = useYudit((s) => s.isAuthenticated);

  const [transfers, setTransfers] = useState<Transfer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [activeTransfer, setActiveTransfer] = useState<Transfer | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("intro");

  const [targetEmail, setTargetEmail] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [verificationCode, setVerificationCode] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [inlineError, setInlineError] = useState<{
    title: string;
    message: string;
    hint?: string;
    canReset: boolean;
  } | null>(null);

  const isOwnerUser = isOwner(user);

  // =====================================================
  // LOAD TRANSFERS
  // ⚠️ Auth & permission sudah ditangani RequireAuth — di sini
  //    hanya load data kalau user sudah authenticated & owner.
  // =====================================================
  const loadTransfers = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await listTransfers();
      setTransfers(res);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as { detail?: string };
      toast.error(err?.detail || "Gagal memuat riwayat transfer");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Tunggu auth benar-benar siap
    if (!isAuthenticated || !isOwnerUser) return;
    void loadTransfers();
  }, [isAuthenticated, isOwnerUser, loadTransfers]);

  // =====================================================
  // HANDLERS
  // =====================================================
  const loadTransferDetail = async (id: string): Promise<Transfer> => {
    const all = await listTransfers();
    const t = all.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!t) throw new Error("Transfer tidak ditemukan");
    return t;
  };

  const handleRequest = async () => {
    setInlineError(null);

    const email = targetEmail.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!email) {
      setInlineError({
        title: "Email Kosong",
        message: "Masukkan email tujuan transfer.",
        canReset: false,
      });
      return;
    }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      setInlineError({
        title: "Format Email Tidak Valid",
        message: "Email tidak sesuai format standar.",
        hint: "Contoh: nama@domain.com",
        canReset: false,
      });
      return;
    }
    if (email === (user?.email || "").toLowerCase()) {
      setInlineError({
        title: "Email Sama dengan Anda",
        message: "Tidak bisa transfer ke akun sendiri.",
        hint: "Gunakan email user lain.",
        canReset: false,
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await requestTransfer({
        target_email: email,
        reason: reason.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(
        `Kode verifikasi dikirim ke ${user?.email}. ` +
          `Berlaku ${res.message.includes("30 menit") ? "30 menit" : "sementara"}.`,
        { duration: 8000 },
      );
      const detail = await loadTransferDetail(res.transfer_id);
      setActiveTransfer(detail);
      setInlineError(null);
      setStep("verify");
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const parsed = parseTransferError(e);
      setInlineError(parsed);
      toast.error(parsed.message, { duration: 8000 });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    if (!activeTransfer) return;
    if (verificationCode.length !== 6) {
      toast.error("Kode harus 6 digit");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    setInlineError(null);
    try {
      await verifyTransfer({
        transfer_id: activeTransfer.id,
        code: verificationCode.trim(),
      });
      toast.success("Kode benar. Lanjut ke konfirmasi");
      setStep("confirm");
      const updated = await loadTransferDetail(activeTransfer.id);
      setActiveTransfer(updated);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const parsed = parseTransferError(e);
      toast.error(parsed.message, { duration: 6000 });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    if (!activeTransfer) return;
    setInlineError(null);
    setStep("executing");

    try {
      await executeTransfer(activeTransfer.id);
      toast.success("Workspace berhasil dipindahkan!");
      setStep("done");
      await loadTransfers();
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const parsed = parseTransferError(e);
      setInlineError(parsed);
      toast.error(parsed.message, { duration: 8000 });

      // Reload detail untuk dapat status terbaru
      try {
        const fresh = await loadTransferDetail(activeTransfer.id);
        setActiveTransfer(fresh);
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }

      // Kembali ke step confirm agar user bisa cancel / arahkan
      setStep("confirm");
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = async () => {
    if (!activeTransfer) return;
    try {
      await cancelTransfer({
        transfer_id: activeTransfer.id,
        reason: "Dibatalkan oleh owner",
      });
      toast.success("Transfer dibatalkan");
      setActiveTransfer(null);
      setStep("intro");
      setInlineError(null);
      await loadTransfers();
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const parsed = parseTransferError(e);
      toast.error(parsed.message);
    }
  };

  const copyError = async (err: {
    title: string;
    message: string;
    hint?: string;
  }) => {
    const text = [
      err.title,
      "",
      err.message,
      err.hint ? `\nHint: ${err.hint}` : "",
    ].join("\n");
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      toast.success("Pesan error disalin");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Gagal menyalin pesan");
    }
  };

  // =====================================================
  // ⚠️ NO GUARD DI SINI
  // RequireAuth sudah menangani:
  //   - bootstrapAuth
  //   - redirect kalau belum login
  //   - redirect kalau bukan owner
  // Jadi kita bisa langsung render.
  // =====================================================

  return (
    <div className="yudit-ambient flex min-h-screen flex-col">
      <header className="y-glass sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-[var(--y-border)]">
        <div className="y-container flex h-14 items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => router.push("/?view=profile")}
            className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Crown size={18} className="text-[var(--y-warning)]" />
            <h1 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Transfer Workspace
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="y-container mx-auto max-w-2xl py-6">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {step === "intro" && (
              <motion.div
                key="intro"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="space-y-4"
              >
                <InfoCard />

                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5">
                  <h2 className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                    Mulai Transfer Baru
                  </h2>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setInlineError(null);
                      setStep("target");
                    }}
                    className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                  >
                    <UserPlus size={16} />
                    Mulai Transfer
                  </button>
                </div>

                {loading && transfers.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    <Loader2 size={14} className="mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    Memuat riwayat…
                  </div>
                )}

                {transfers.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5">
                    <h2 className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      Riwayat Transfer
                    </h2>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {transfers.map((t) => (
                        <TransferRow
                          key={t.id}
                          transfer={t}
                          onResume={(tr) => {
                            setActiveTransfer(tr);
                            setInlineError(null);
                            if (tr.status === "pending") setStep("verify");
                            else if (tr.status === "verified")
                              setStep("confirm");
                          }}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {step === "target" && (
              <motion.div
                key="target"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5"
              >
                <h2 className="mb-4 text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Masukkan Email Target
                </h2>

                {inlineError && (
                  <ErrorBanner
                    err={inlineError}
                    onClose={() => setInlineError(null)}
                    onCopy={() => copyError(inlineError)}
                  />
                )}

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      Email User Tujuan
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="email"
                      value={targetEmail}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setTargetEmail(e.target.value);
                        if (inlineError) setInlineError(null);
                      }}
                      placeholder="nama@domain.com"
                      autoFocus
                      className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                    />
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      User harus <b>sudah terdaftar sebagai OWNER</b> (bukan
                      member) di aplikasi ini.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      Alasan (opsional)
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      value={reason}
                      onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                      rows={2}
                      placeholder="Contoh: Pergantian pejabat struktural"
                      className="y-focus w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setInlineError(null);
                        setStep("intro");
                      }}
                      className="inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
                    >
                      <ArrowLeft size={14} />
                      Batal
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={handleRequest}
                      disabled={submitting || !targetEmail.trim()}
                      className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      {submitting ? (
                        <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <Mail size={16} />
                      )}
                      Kirim Kode
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {step === "verify" && activeTransfer && (
              <motion.div
                key="verify"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5"
              >
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.08)] p-3">
                  <ShieldAlert
                    size={18}
                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[var(--y-warning)]"
                  />
                  <div className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-warning)]">
                    <b>Kode dikirim ke email {user?.email}</b>
                    <br />
                    Buka email Anda, salin kode 6 digit, dan masukkan di
                    bawah. JANGAN bagikan kode ini ke siapa pun.
                  </div>
                </div>

                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  Kode Verifikasi
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  value={verificationCode}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setVerificationCode(
                      e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6),
                    )
                  }
                  placeholder="000000"
                  maxLength={6}
                  autoFocus
                  className="y-focus h-16 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-center font-mono text-3xl font-bold tracking-[0.5em] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none focus:border-[var(--y-primary)]"
                />

                <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    Sisa percobaan:{" "}
                    {activeTransfer.max_attempts -
                      activeTransfer.code_attempts}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    Kode berlaku s/d{" "}
                    {formatDateTime(activeTransfer.code_expires_at)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCancel}
                    className="inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
                  >
                    <X size={14} />
                    Batalkan
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleVerify}
                    disabled={submitting || verificationCode.length !== 6}
                    className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {submitting ? (
                      <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <KeyRound size={16} />
                    )}
                    Verifikasi
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {step === "confirm" && activeTransfer && (
              <motion.div
                key="confirm"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.05)] p-5"
              >
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <AlertTriangle
                    size={22}
                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[var(--y-danger)]"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      Konfirmasi Terakhir
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                      Tindakan ini akan memindahkan SELURUH workspace Anda ke
                      user lain. Anda akan menjadi MEMBER di workspace
                      tersebut.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Error banner setelah execute gagal */}
                {inlineError && (
                  <ErrorBanner
                    err={inlineError}
                    onClose={() => setInlineError(null)}
                    onCopy={() => copyError(inlineError)}
                  />
                )}

                <div className="mb-4 space-y-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-4 text-[12.5px]">
                  <Row
                    label="Dari"
                    value={`${activeTransfer.from_owner_username} (${activeTransfer.from_owner_email})`}
                  />
                  <Row
                    label="Ke"
                    value={`${activeTransfer.to_owner_username} (${activeTransfer.to_owner_email})`}
                  />
                  {activeTransfer.snapshot_before && (
                    <>
                      <div className="my-2 border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)]" />
                      <Row
                        label="Drive"
                        value={`${
                          (activeTransfer.snapshot_before as {
                            drives?: number;
                          }).drives || 0
                        } akun Google Drive`}
                      />
                      <Row
                        label="Collaborator"
                        value={`${
                          (activeTransfer.snapshot_before as {
                            collaborators?: number;
                          }).collaborators || 0
                        } user`}
                      />
                      <Row
                        label="File"
                        value={`${
                          (activeTransfer.snapshot_before as {
                            files?: number;
                          }).files || 0
                        } file`}
                      />
                    </>
                  )}
                  <div className="my-2 border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)]" />
                  <Row
                    label="Status"
                    value={activeTransfer.status.toUpperCase()}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCancel}
                    className="inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
                  >
                    <X size={14} />
                    {inlineError?.canReset
                      ? "Batalkan & Mulai Ulang"
                      : "Batalkan Transfer"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleExecute}
                    disabled={activeTransfer.status !== "verified"}
                    className="inline-flex h-11 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--y-danger)] text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-[#dc2626] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 disabled:hover:translate-y-0"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                    Ya, Transfer Sekarang
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {step === "executing" && (
              <motion.div
                key="executing"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-8 text-center"
              >
                <Loader2
                  size={48}
                  className="mx-auto animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
                />
                <h2 className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Memindahkan Workspace…
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  Mohon tunggu, sedang memindahkan file, drive, dan
                  collaborator. Jangan tutup halaman ini.
                </p>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {step === "done" && (
              <motion.div
                key="done"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(16,185,129,0.3)] bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.05)] p-8 text-center"
              >
                <CheckCircle2
                  size={48}
                  className="mx-auto text-[var(--y-success)]"
                />
                <h2 className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Transfer Berhasil!
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  Anda sekarang menjadi MEMBER di workspace baru. Login ulang
                  untuk melihat workspace dari sisi member.
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    useYudit.getState().logout();
                    router.push("/");
                  }}
                  className="y-gradient-brand mt-4 inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white"
                >
                  <RefreshCw size={14} />
                  Login Ulang
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

            {err.message}
          </p>
          {err.hint && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] italic text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              💡 {err.hint}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={onCopy}
            title="Salin pesan"
            className="grid h-6 w-6 place-items-center rounded text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          >
            <Copy size={12} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            title="Tutup"
            className="grid h-6 w-6 place-items-center rounded text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          >
            <X size={12} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

            <b>bukan member</b> di workspace Anda

          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TransferRow({
  transfer,
  onResume,
}: {
  transfer: Transfer;
  onResume: (t: Transfer) => void;
}) {
  const statusMeta: Record<TransferStatus, { label: string; color: string }> =
    {
      pending: { label: "Menunggu Verifikasi", color: "#f59e0b" },
      verified: { label: "Siap Dieksekusi", color: "#22d3ee" },
      executing: { label: "Sedang Diproses", color: "#6366f1" },
      completed: { label: "Selesai", color: "#10b981" },
      failed: { label: "Gagal", color: "#ef4444" },
      cancelled: { label: "Dibatalkan", color: "#94a3b8" },
      expired: { label: "Kadaluarsa", color: "#94a3b8" },
    };
  const meta = statusMeta[transfer.status] || statusMeta.pending;
  const canResume =
    transfer.status === "pending" || transfer.status === "verified";

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3">
      <div
        className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg"
        style={{ background: `${meta.color}22`, color: meta.color }}
      >
        <Crown size={15} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          → {transfer.to_owner_email}
        </div>
        <div className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {meta.label} · {formatDateTime(transfer.created_at)}
        </div>
      </div>
      {canResume && (
        <button
          onClick={() => onResume(transfer)}
          className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--y-primary)] px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white hover:opacity-90"
        >
          Lanjutkan
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
      <span className="shrink-0 font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {label}:
      </span>
      <span className="min-w-0 break-words text-[var(--y-text)]">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}



===== FILE: src/components/yudit/modals/create-folder-modal.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/modals/create-folder-modal.tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { FolderPlus, X, Loader2, Folder } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { createFolder } from "@/lib/api/folders";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface CreateFolderModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  parentId?: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (folderId: string) => void;
}

export function CreateFolderModal({
  open, parentId, onClose, onCreated,
}: CreateFolderModalProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setName("");
      setError(null);
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setError("Nama folder wajib diisi");
      return;
    }
    if (trimmed.length > 200) {
      setError("Nama folder terlalu panjang (maks 200 karakter)");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await createFolder({
        name: trimmed,
        parent_id: parentId || null,
      });
      toast.success(`Folder "${trimmed}" berhasil dibuat`);
      onCreated(res.folder.id);
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg =
        e instanceof ApiError
          ? e.detail
          : e instanceof Error
            ? e.message
            : "Gagal membuat folder";
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[998] grid place-items-center p-5"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)" }}
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft w-full max-w-[420px] rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] p-6"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]">
                <FolderPlus size={20} className="text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Buat Folder Baru
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  Kelompokkan dokumen Anda dalam folder
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
              >
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  Nama Folder
                </label>
                <div className="group relative">
                  <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] group-focus-within:text-[var(--y-primary)]">
                    <Folder size={15} />
                  </div>
                  <input
                    value={name}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setName(e.target.value);
                      setError(null);
                    }}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Dokumen-Arsip"
                    autoFocus
                    maxLength={200}
                    className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
                  />
                </div>
                {error && (
                  <div className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                    {error}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting || !name.trim()}
                  className={cn(
                    "y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white",
                    "disabled:opacity-60",
                  )}
                >
                  {submitting ? (
                    <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <FolderPlus size={14} />
                  )}
                  Buat Folder
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}



===== FILE: src/components/yudit/modals/assign-document-modal.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/modals/assign-document-modal.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  UserPlus, X, Loader2, Trash2, Users, ShieldCheck,
  Clock, CheckCircle2, Search, AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  assignDocument, listFileAssignments, revokeAssignment,
} from "@/lib/api/assignments";
import { listCollaborators } from "@/lib/api/collaborators";
import type { Collaborator, DocumentAssignment } from "@/lib/yudit/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface AssignDocumentModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  fileId: string;
  fileName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AssignDocumentModal({
  open, fileId, fileName, onClose,
}: AssignDocumentModalProps) {
  const [collabs, setCollabs] = useState<Collaborator[]>([]);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<DocumentAssignment[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Collaborator | null>(null);
  const [canEdit, setCanEdit] = useState(true);
  const [canDelete, setCanDelete] = useState(false);
  const [canShare, setCanShare] = useState(false);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [expiresHours, setExpiresHours] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  // ---- Load data saat open ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [cs, as] = await Promise.all([
          listCollaborators(),
          listFileAssignments(fileId),
        ]);
        if (!cancelled) {
          setCollabs(cs.filter((c) => c.is_active));
          setAssignments(as);
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        toast.error(e?.detail || "Gagal memuat data");
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [open, fileId]);

  // Reset saat close
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setSelected(null);
      setCanEdit(true);
      setCanDelete(false);
      setCanShare(false);
      setNote("");
      setExpiresHours("");
      setSearch("");
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleAssign = async () => {
    if (!selected) {
      toast.error("Pilih collaborator dulu");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const expiresAt = expiresHours
        ? new Date(
            Date.now() + parseInt(expiresHours) * 3600 * 1000,
          ).toISOString()
        : undefined;

      await assignDocument({
        file_id: fileId,
        assigned_to: selected.id,
        can_edit: canEdit,
        can_delete: canDelete,
        can_share: canShare,
        note: note.trim() || undefined,
        expires_at: expiresAt,
      });

      toast.success(`Di-assign ke ${selected.email}`);
      // Reload
      const updated = await listFileAssignments(fileId);
      setAssignments(updated);
      setSelected(null);
      setNote("");
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.detail || "Gagal assign");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRevoke = async (assignmentId: string) => {
    try {
      await revokeAssignment(assignmentId);
      toast.success("Assignment dicabut");
      setAssignments((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== assignmentId));
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.detail || "Gagal revoke");
    }
  };

  // ---- Derived ----
  const assignedIds = new Set(assignments.map((a) => a.assigned_to));
  const availableCollabs = collabs.filter((c) => !assignedIds.has(c.id));
  const filteredAvailable = availableCollabs.filter(
    (c) =>
      !search ||
      c.email.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      c.username.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  );

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[998] grid place-items-center p-5"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)" }}
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft flex max-h-[88vh] w-full max-w-[640px] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border)] p-5">
              <div className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl">
                <UserPlus size={18} className="text-white" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Assign Dokumen
                </h3>
                <p className="truncate text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  {fileName}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
              >
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Content */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5">
              {loading ? (
                <div className="grid place-items-center py-12">
                  <Loader2 size={24} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {/* ===== Assignments yang sudah ada ===== */}
                  {assignments.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mb-5">
                      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                        <CheckCircle2 size={12} />
                        Sudah di-assign ({assignments.length})
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        {assignments.map((a) => (
                          <ExistingAssignment
                            key={a.id}
                            assignment={a}
                            onRevoke={() => handleRevoke(a.id)}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* ===== Pilih collaborator baru ===== */}
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    <UserPlus size={12} />
                    Assign ke Collaborator Baru
                  </div>

                  {availableCollabs.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-6 text-center text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      {collabs.length === 0
                        ? "Belum ada collaborator. Undang dulu di menu Collaborators."
                        : "Semua collaborator sudah di-assign"}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {/* Search */}
                      {availableCollabs.length > 3 && (
                        <div className="relative mb-2">
                          <Search
                            size={14}
                            className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
                          />
                          <input
                            value={search}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Cari collaborator…"
                            className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-9 pr-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                          />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* List collaborator */}
                      <div className="mb-3 max-h-[180px] space-y-1 overflow-y-auto">
                        {filteredAvailable.map((c) => (
                          <button
                            key={c.id}
                            onClick={() => setSelected(c)}
                            className={cn(
                              "flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-left transition-all",
                              selected?.id === c.id
                                ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.12)]"
                                : "border-[var(--y-border)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)]",
                            )}
                          >
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                "grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white",
                                c.role === "super_admin"
                                  ? "bg-[#f59e0b]"
                                  : "bg-[var(--y-primary)]",
                              )}
                            >
                              {c.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                            </div>
                            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                              <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                                {c.username}
                              </div>
                              <div className="truncate text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                                {c.email}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            {c.role === "super_admin" && (
                              <ShieldCheck size={12} className="text-[#f59e0b]" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {/* Permission config (kalau sudah pilih) */}
                      {selected && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
                          className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3"
                        >
                          <div className="mb-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                            Permission untuk {selected.username}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                            <PermToggle
                              active={canEdit}
                              onClick={() => setCanEdit(!canEdit)}
                              label="Edit Dokumen"
                              color="#10b981"
                            />
                            <PermToggle
                              active={canDelete}
                              onClick={() => setCanDelete(!canDelete)}
                              label="Hapus"
                              color="#ef4444"
                            />
                            <PermToggle
                              active={canShare}
                              onClick={() => setCanShare(!canShare)}
                              label="Share"
                              color="#22d3ee"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div className="mb-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                            <div>
                              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                                Expiry (jam)
                              </label>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                value={expiresHours}
                                onChange={(e) => setExpiresHours(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Tanpa expiry"
                                className="y-focus h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-2 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                              />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                                Catatan
                              </label>
                              <input
                                value={note}
                                onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Revisi bab 2…"
                                className="y-focus h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-2 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <button
                            onClick={handleAssign}
                            disabled={submitting}
                            className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-9 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg text-[12px] font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                          >
                            {submitting ? (
                              <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <UserPlus size={14} />
                            )}
                            Assign Sekarang
                          </button>
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );

// =====================================================
// EXISTING ASSIGNMENT ROW
// =====================================================
function ExistingAssignment({
  assignment,
  onRevoke,
}: {
  assignment: DocumentAssignment;
  onRevoke: () => void;
}) {
  const user = assignment.assigned_to_user;
  const expired =
    assignment.expires_at &&
    new Date(assignment.expires_at) < new Date();

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2",
        expired
          ? "border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.05)]"
          : "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)]",
      )}
    >
      <div className="grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[var(--y-primary)] text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
        {user?.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || "?"}
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          {user?.username || "Unknown"}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
          {assignment.can_edit && (
            <span className="rounded bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#10b981]">
              EDIT
            </span>
          )}
          {assignment.can_delete && (
            <span className="rounded bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#ef4444]">
              DELETE
            </span>
          )}
          {assignment.can_share && (
            <span className="rounded bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#22d3ee]">
              SHARE
            </span>
          )}
          {expired && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#ef4444]">
              <Clock size={8} />
              EXPIRED
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        onClick={onRevoke}
        title="Cabut assignment"
        className="grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-md text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)]"
      >
        <Trash2 size={13} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// PERMISSION TOGGLE
// =====================================================
function PermToggle({
  active, onClick, label, color,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  label: string;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase transition-all",
        active
          ? "border-transparent text-white"
          : "border-[var(--y-border)] text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:border-[var(--y-text-dim)]",
      )}
      style={active ? { background: color } : undefined}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/modals/preview-modal.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/modals/preview-modal.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  X,
  Download,
  Loader2,
  FileQuestion,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { formatBytes, formatDate, fileIconInfo, extOf } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import { fetchFileBlob } from "@/lib/api/files";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { FileIcon } from "../ui/file-icon";
import { CategoryBadge } from "../ui/category-badge";

// =====================================================
// ERROR STATE
// =====================================================
interface PreviewError {
  message: string;
  status: number;
  isDriveError: boolean;
  driveEmail?: string;
}

function toPreviewError(e: unknown): PreviewError {
  if (e instanceof ApiError) {
    return {
      message: e.detail || "Gagal memuat file",
      status: e.status,
      isDriveError: e.isDriveError || false,
      driveEmail: e.driveEmail,
    };
  }
  if (e instanceof Error) {
    return {
      message: e.message || "Gagal memuat file",
      status: 0,
      isDriveError: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    message: "Gagal memuat file",
    status: 0,
    isDriveError: false,
  };
}

// =====================================================
// MAIN MODAL
// =====================================================
export function PreviewModal() {
  const previewFileId = useYudit((s) => s.previewFileId);
  const closePreview = useYudit((s) => s.closePreview);
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const file = files.find((f) => f.id === previewFileId) || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && previewFileId) closePreview();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [previewFileId, closePreview]);

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {file && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex flex-col"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.9)", backdropFilter: "blur(12px)" }}
        >
          <div className="y-glass flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-3">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                {file.name}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                <span>{formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
                <span>•</span>
                <span>{formatDate(file.created_at)}</span>
                {file.category && (
                  <>
                    <span>•</span>
                    <CategoryBadge category={file.category} />
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <DownloadButton fileId={file.id} filename={file.name} />
              <button
                onClick={closePreview}
                className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
                title="Tutup (Esc)"
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center overflow-auto p-6">
            <PreviewBody key={file.id} file={file} />
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// DOWNLOAD BUTTON
// =====================================================
function DownloadButton({
  fileId,
  filename,
}: {
  fileId: string;
  filename: string;
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading(`Mengunduh ${filename}…`);
    try {
      const blob = await fetchFileBlob(fileId, "download");
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
      toast.success(`"${filename}" berhasil diunduh`, { id: toastId });
    } catch (e) {
      // ⭐ FIX: Beri feedback untuk SEMUA kasus error (bukan silent)
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.isDriveError) {
        toast.error(
          `${e.driveEmail || "Google Drive"} perlu di-reconnect. Buka menu "Google Drive".`,
          { id: toastId, duration: 10000 },
        );
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
          window.dispatchEvent(
            new CustomEvent("yudit:drive-auth-error", {
              detail: {
                email: e.driveEmail,
                driveId: e.driveId,
                message: e.detail,
              },
            }),
          );
        }
      } else if (e instanceof ApiError) {
        toast.error(e.detail || "Gagal download file", { id: toastId });
      } else if (e instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(e.message || "Gagal download file", { id: toastId });
      } else {
        toast.error("Gagal download file", { id: toastId });
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleDownload}
      disabled={loading}
      className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-60"
      title="Download"
    >
      {loading ? (
        <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />
      ) : (
        <Download size={15} />
      )}
      <span className="hidden sm:inline">Download</span>
    </button>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// PREVIEW BODY — fetch blob
// =====================================================
function PreviewBody({
  file,
}: {
  file: { id: string; name: string; mime_type: string | null };
}) {
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const closePreview = useYudit((s) => s.closePreview);
  const [blobUrl, setBlobUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<PreviewError | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let url: string | null = null;

    (async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        const blob = await fetchFileBlob(file.id, "preview");
        url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        if (!cancelled) {
          setBlobUrl(url);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(toPreviewError(e));
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (url) setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url!), 500);
    };
  }, [file.id]);

  // Loading
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        <Loader2 size={32} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
        <div className="text-sm">Memuat preview…</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Error state
  if (error) {
    return (
      <PreviewErrorView
        error={error}
        onReconnect={() => {
          closePreview();
          setView("drives");
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  if (!blobUrl) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center">
        <FileQuestion
          size={80}
          className="mx-auto mb-3 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
        />
        <div className="mb-1 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          Preview tidak tersedia
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          Klik "Download" untuk mengunduh file
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <PreviewContent file={file} url={blobUrl} />;
}

// =====================================================
// ERROR VIEW
// =====================================================
function PreviewErrorView({
  error,
  onReconnect,
}: {
  error: PreviewError;
  onReconnect: () => void;
}) {
  // ⭐ FIX: 403 = permission denied (BUKAN drive error).
  //    Drive error selalu ditandai dengan `isDriveError` flag
  //    dari interceptor (yang sudah CORS-safe via message detection).
  const isDriveError = error.isDriveError === true;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
      <div
        className={`mx-auto mb-4 grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl ${
          isDriveError
            ? "bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]"
            : "bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]"
        }`}
      >
        {isDriveError ? (
          <AlertTriangle size={32} className="text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
        ) : (
          <FileQuestion size={32} className="text-[var(--y-danger)]" />
        )}
      </div>
      <h3 className="mb-2 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
        {isDriveError
          ? error.driveEmail
            ? `Google Drive ${error.driveEmail} Perlu Reconnect`
            : "Google Drive Tidak Valid"
          : "Gagal Memuat File"}
      </h3>
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {error.message}
      </p>
      {isDriveError && (
        <button
          onClick={onReconnect}
          className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={15} />
          Buka Menu Google Drive
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// PREVIEW CONTENT
// =====================================================
function PreviewContent({
  file,
  url,
}: {
  file: { name: string; mime_type: string | null };
  url: string;
}) {
  const ext = extOf(file.name);
  const mime = file.mime_type || "";
  const info = fileIconInfo(mime, file.name);

  if (
    mime.startsWith("image/") ||
    ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp", "svg", "bmp"].includes(ext)
  ) {
    return (
      <motion.img
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        src={url}
        alt={file.name}
        className="max-h-[80vh] max-w-[90vw] rounded-xl object-contain"
      />
    );
  }

  if (mime.startsWith("video/") || ["mp4", "webm", "mov", "mkv"].includes(ext)) {
    return (
      <motion.video
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        src={url}
        controls
        autoPlay
        className="aspect-video max-h-[80vh] w-full max-w-4xl rounded-xl bg-black"
      />
    );
  }

  if (mime.startsWith("audio/") || ["mp3", "wav", "flac", "m4a"].includes(ext)) {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="w-full max-w-xl"
      >
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-8">
          <div className="mb-4 flex justify-center">
            <info.Icon
              size={64}
              style={{ color: info.color }}
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          </div>
          <audio src={url} controls className="w-full" />
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  if (ext === "pdf") {
    return (
      <iframe
        src={url}
        className="h-[80vh] w-full max-w-4xl rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-white"
        title={file.name}
      />
    );
  }

  if (
    [
      "txt",
      "md",
      "json",
      "csv",
      "xml",
      "log",
      "py",
      "js",
      "ts",
      "html",
      "css",
    ].includes(ext)
  ) {
    return <TextPreview url={url} name={file.name} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="text-center">
      <FileQuestion
        size={80}
        className="mx-auto mb-3 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
      />
      <div className="mb-1 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
        Preview tidak tersedia untuk tipe ini
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        Klik "Download" untuk mengunduh file
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TextPreview({ url, name }: { url: string; name: string }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string>("Memuat…");
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    fetch(url)
      .then((r) => r.text())
      .then((t) => {
        if (!cancelled) setText(t);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setText("Gagal memuat teks");
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [url]);

  return (
    <motion.pre
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="y-glow-soft max-h-full w-full max-w-3xl overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text)] whitespace-pre-wrap"
    >
      {`// ${name}\n\n${text}`}
    </motion.pre>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/modals/share-modal.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/modals/share-modal.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  X,
  Link2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  ShieldCheck,
  Trash2,
  Clock,
  Eye,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";

import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { formatBytes } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import { getShareUrl } from "@/lib/api/share";
import { FileIcon } from "../ui/file-icon";

export function ShareModal() {
  const shareFileId = useYudit((s) => s.shareFileId);
  const closeShare = useYudit((s) => s.closeShare);
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const file = files.find((f) => f.id === shareFileId) || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && shareFileId) closeShare();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [shareFileId, closeShare]);

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {file && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[998] grid place-items-center p-5"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)" }}
          onClick={closeShare}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft w-full max-w-[500px] rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] p-6"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <ShareForm key={file.id} file={file} onClose={closeShare} />
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

function ShareForm({
  file,
  onClose,
}: {
  file: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    mime_type: string | null;
    size: number;
    is_public: boolean;
    share_token: string | null;
    share_views: number;
    share_expires_at?: string | null;
  };
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const createShare = useYudit((s) => s.createShare);
  const revokeShare = useYudit((s) => s.revokeShare);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);

  const [expires, setExpires] = useState("168");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await createShare({
        expires_hours: expires ? parseInt(expires) : null,
        password: password.trim() || null,
      });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!file.share_token) return;
    const url = getShareUrl(file.share_token);
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).catch(() => {});
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleRevoke = () => {
    showConfirm("Cabut share?", "Link yang sudah dibagikan tidak akan bisa diakses lagi.", async () => {
      await revokeShare(file.id);
      onClose();
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3">
        <div className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl">
          <Link2 size={20} className="text-white" />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">Bagikan File</h3>
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileIcon mime={file.mime_type || ""} name={file.name} size={16} />
            <span className="truncate text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
              {file.name} • {formatBytes(file.size)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
        >
          <X size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {file.is_public && file.share_token ? (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(16,185,129,0.3)] bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.1)] px-3 py-2.5">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} className="shrink-0 text-[var(--y-success)]" />
            <span className="text-[13px] text-[#34d399]">
              File ini sudah dibagikan. Salin link di bawah.
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            <Eye size={12} />
            <span>{file.share_views} views</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="y-focus flex-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-[12px] text-[var(--y-accent)]">
              {getShareUrl(file.share_token)}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="inline-flex h-10 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <Check size={15} className="text-[var(--y-success)]" />
              ) : (
                <Copy size={15} />
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
            <button
              onClick={handleRevoke}
              className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.1)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-danger)] transition-colors hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.2)]"
            >
              <Trash2 size={14} />
              Cabut Share
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="mb-4 space-y-3">
            <ShareOption icon={<Clock size={15} />} label="Kedaluwarsa">
              <select
                value={expires}
                onChange={(e) => setExpires(e.target.value)}
                className="y-focus h-9 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
              >
                <option value="">Tidak kedaluwarsa</option>
                <option value="24">24 jam</option>
                <option value="168">7 hari</option>
                <option value="720">30 hari</option>
              </select>
            </ShareOption>
            <ShareOption icon={<ShieldCheck size={15} />} label="Password">
              <input
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Kosongkan jika tidak perlu"
                className="y-focus h-9 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] outline-none"
              />
            </ShareOption>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              onClick={handleCreate}
              disabled={creating}
              className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {creating ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Link2 size={15} />}
              Buat Link
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function ShareOption({
  icon,
  label,
  children,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <div className="flex w-[110px] shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        <span className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">{icon}</span>
        {label}
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
