// =====================================================
// ⭐ ACCOUNT STATS SECTION (tidak diubah — sama seperti aslinya)
// =====================================================
function AccountStatsSection() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<AccountStats | null>(null);
  const [uploads, setUploads] = useState<MyUpload[]>([]);
  const [edits, setEdits] = useState<MyEdit[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [openUploads, setOpenUploads] = useState(false);
  const [openEdits, setOpenEdits] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [s, u, e] = await Promise.all([
        getAccountStats(),
        listMyUploads(50),
        listMyEdits(50),
      ]);
      setStats(s);
      setUploads(u);
      setEdits(e);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) return;
      const msg =
        err instanceof ApiError ? err.detail : "Gagal memuat statistik";
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center py-20">
        <Loader2 size={28} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !stats) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-6 text-center">
        <AlertCircle
          size={28}
          className="mx-auto mb-2 text-[var(--y-danger)]"
        />
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {error || "Statistik tidak tersedia"}
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={load}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={13} />
          Coba Lagi
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const cards: {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    sub: string;
    Icon: React.ElementType;
    color: string;
    bg: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      label: "Total Upload",
      value: String(stats.total_uploads),
      sub: formatBytes(stats.total_uploads_size),
      Icon: Upload,
      color: "#6366f1",
      bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Total Edit",
      value: String(stats.total_edits),
      sub: `${stats.total_edited_files} file unik`,
      Icon: PencilLine,
      color: "#10b981",
      bg: "rgba(16,185,129,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Download",
      value: String(stats.total_downloads),
      sub: "File diunduh",
      Icon: Download,
      color: "#22d3ee",
      bg: "rgba(34,211,238,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Preview",
      value: String(stats.total_previews),
      sub: "File dilihat",
      Icon: Eye,
      color: "#f59e0b",
      bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Share Link",
      value: String(stats.total_shares),
      sub: "Link dibuat",
      Icon: Share2,
      color: "#a855f7",
      bg: "rgba(168,85,247,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Konversi",
      value: String(stats.total_conversions),
      sub: "File dikonversi",
      Icon: FileCog,
      color: "#ec4899",
      bg: "rgba(236,72,153,0.12)",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Statistik Akun"
        desc="Ringkasan aktivitas upload, edit, dan interaksi Anda"
      />

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          onClick={load}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={12} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {cards.map((c, i) => (
          <motion.div
            key={c.label}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: i * 0.04 }}
            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3.5"
          >
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                {c.label}
              </span>
              <div
                className="grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-lg"
                style={{ background: c.bg, color: c.color }}
              >
                <c.Icon size={13} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div
              className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums"
              style={{ color: c.color }}
            >
              {c.value}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              {c.sub}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {stats.last_login_at && (
          <StatInfo
            icon={<Clock size={12} />}
            label="Login Terakhir"
            value={formatDateTime(stats.last_login_at)}
          />
        )}
        {stats.last_upload_at && (
          <StatInfo
            icon={<Upload size={12} />}
            label="Upload Terakhir"
            value={formatDateTime(stats.last_upload_at)}
          />
        )}
        {stats.last_edit_at && (
          <StatInfo
            icon={<PencilLine size={12} />}
            label="Edit Terakhir"
            value={formatDateTime(stats.last_edit_at)}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <DropdownPanel
        open={openUploads}
        onToggle={() => setOpenUploads((v) => !v)}
        icon={<Upload size={15} />}
        iconBg="rgba(99,102,241,0.12)"
        iconColor="#6366f1"
        title="Dokumen yang Saya Upload"
        count={uploads.length}
        countLabel="file"
        empty={uploads.length === 0}
        emptyText="Belum ada file yang Anda upload"
      >
        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
          {uploads.map((u, i) => (
            <UploadRow key={u.id} upload={u} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </DropdownPanel>

      <DropdownPanel
        open={openEdits}
        onToggle={() => setOpenEdits((v) => !v)}
        icon={<PencilLine size={15} />}
        iconBg="rgba(16,185,129,0.12)"
        iconColor="#10b981"
        title="Dokumen yang Saya Edit"
        count={edits.length}
        countLabel="file"
        empty={edits.length === 0}
        emptyText="Belum ada file yang Anda edit"
      >
        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
          {edits.map((e, i) => (
            <EditRow key={e.file_id} edit={e} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </DropdownPanel>
    </div>
  );
}

// ⭐ Sisa komponen lain (StatInfo, DropdownPanel, UploadRow, EditRow,
// PersonalSection, SecuritySection, SessionsSection, NotificationsSection,
// PreferencesSection, ActivitySection, SectionHeader, FormField,
// ReadOnlyField, DetailRow, getDeviceIcon) SAMA PERSIS dengan versi asli.
// Tidak ada perubahan di file ini — hanya penambahan TransferSection di atas.

// =====================================================
// (Sisa komponen tidak berubah — copy dari file asli)
// =====================================================

function StatInfo({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2">
      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">{icon}</span>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {label}
        </div>
        <div className="truncate text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {value}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DropdownPanel({
  open,
  onToggle,
  icon,
  iconBg,
  iconColor,
  title,
  count,
  countLabel,
  empty,
  emptyText,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  iconBg: string;
  iconColor: string;
  title: string;
  count: number;
  countLabel: string;
  empty: boolean;
  emptyText: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
      >
        <div
          className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg"
          style={{ background: iconBg, color: iconColor }}
        >
          {icon}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">{title}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            {count} {countLabel}
          </div>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown
          size={16}
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-transform duration-200",
            open && "rotate-180",
          )}
        />
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] p-2">
              {empty ? (
                <div className="grid place-items-center py-8 text-center">
                  <Inbox
                    size={28}
                    className="mb-1.5 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
                  />
                  <p className="text-[11.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    {emptyText}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                children
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

function UploadRow({ upload, index }: { upload: MyUpload; index: number }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -4 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.02, 0.2) }}
      className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
    >
      <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.1)] text-[#6366f1]">
        <FileText size={14} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div
          className="truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]"
          title={upload.name}
        >
          {upload.name}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span className="tabular-nums">{formatBytes(upload.size)}</span>
          {upload.category && (
            <>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="truncate">{upload.category}</span>
            </>
          )}
          {upload.drive_email && (
            <>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="truncate" title={upload.drive_email}>
                {upload.drive_email.split("@")[0]}
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {formatDate(upload.created_at)}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function EditRow({ edit, index }: { edit: MyEdit; index: number }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -4 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.02, 0.2) }}
      className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
    >
      <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.1)] text-[#10b981]">
        <PencilLine size={14} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div
          className="truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]"
          title={edit.file_name}
        >
          {edit.file_name}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#10b981]">
            {edit.edit_count}× edit
          </span>
          {edit.file_size != null && (
            <span className="tabular-nums">
              {formatBytes(edit.file_size)}
            </span>
          )}
          {edit.last_version_number != null && (
            <>
              <span>•</span>
              <span>v{edit.last_version_number}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {formatDate(edit.last_edited_at)}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function PersonalSection({
  profile,
  onChange,
}: {
  profile: UserProfile;
  onChange: (p: UserProfile) => void;
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    full_name: profile.full_name || "",
    phone_number: profile.phone_number || "",
    gender: profile.gender || "",
    address: profile.address || "",
    date_of_birth: profile.date_of_birth || "",
    bio: profile.bio || "",
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const updated = await updatePersonalInfo({
        full_name: form.full_name || null,
        phone_number: form.phone_number || null,
        gender: (form.gender as any) || null,
        address: form.address || null,
        date_of_birth: form.date_of_birth || null,
        bio: form.bio || null,
      });
      onChange(updated);
      toast.success("Informasi personal diperbarui");
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal menyimpan";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Personal Information"
        desc="Identitas dan informasi kepegawaian Anda"
      />

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <ReadOnlyField label="User ID" value={profile.id} mono />
        <ReadOnlyField label="Username" value={profile.username} mono />
        <ReadOnlyField label="Email" value={profile.email} />
        <ReadOnlyField
          label="Tanggal Bergabung"
          value={formatDate(profile.created_at)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <FormField label="Nama Lengkap" required>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={form.full_name}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, full_name: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Nama lengkap sesuai identitas"
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Nomor Telepon">
          <input
            type="tel"
            value={form.phone_number}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, phone_number: e.target.value })
            }
            placeholder="+62 xxx xxxx xxxx"
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          />
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Jenis Kelamin">
          <select
            value={form.gender}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, gender: e.target.value })}
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          >
            <option value="">Tidak disebutkan</option>
            <option value="male">Laki-laki</option>
            <option value="female">Perempuan</option>
            <option value="other">Lainnya</option>
            <option value="prefer_not_to_say">Memilih tidak menjawab</option>
          </select>
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Tanggal Lahir">
          <input
            type="date"
            value={form.date_of_birth}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, date_of_birth: e.target.value })
            }
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          />
        </FormField>
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <FormField label="Alamat">
            <textarea
              rows={2}
              value={form.address}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, address: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Alamat lengkap"
              className="y-focus w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            />
          </FormField>
        </div>
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <FormField label="Bio">
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              value={form.bio}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, bio: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Deskripsi singkat tentang Anda"
              maxLength={500}
              className="y-focus w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            />
          </FormField>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-4">
        <button
          onClick={handleSave}
          disabled={saving}
          className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {saving ? (
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Save size={14} />
          )}
          Simpan Perubahan
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SecuritySection({ profile }: { profile: UserProfile }) {
  const [currentPw, setCurrentPw] = useState("");
  const [newPw, setNewPw] = useState("");
  const [confirmPw, setConfirmPw] = useState("");
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleChangePw = async () => {
    if (newPw.length < 8) return toast.error("Password minimal 8 karakter");
    if (newPw !== confirmPw) return toast.error("Konfirmasi tidak cocok");
    if (newPw === currentPw) return toast.error("Password baru harus berbeda");

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await changePasswordFromProfile(currentPw, newPw);
      toast.success("Password berhasil diubah");
      setCurrentPw("");
      setNewPw("");
      setConfirmPw("");
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal mengganti password";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Security & Privacy"
        desc="Password, MFA dan keamanan akun"
      />

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Ubah Password
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              Terakhir diubah:{" "}
              {profile.last_password_change_at
                ? formatDateTime(profile.last_password_change_at)
                : "Belum pernah"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShow(!show)}
            className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
          >
            {show ? "Sembunyikan" : "Tampilkan form"}
          </button>
        </div>

        {show && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <FormField label="Password Saat Ini">
              <input
                type="password"
                value={currentPw}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentPw(e.target.value)}
                className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
              />
            </FormField>
            <FormField label="Password Baru">
              <input
                type="password"
                value={newPw}
                onChange={(e) => setNewPw(e.target.value)}
                minLength={8}
                className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
              />
            </FormField>
            <FormField label="Konfirmasi Password Baru">
              <input
                type="password"
                value={confirmPw}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPw(e.target.value)}
                className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
              />
            </FormField>
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <button
                onClick={handleChangePw}
                disabled={saving}
                className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {saving ? (
                  <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Shield size={13} />
                )}
                Simpan
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              {profile.mfa_enabled
                ? "✅ MFA aktif. Akun Anda lebih aman."
                : "Tambah lapisan keamanan dengan MFA (segera hadir)"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            disabled
            className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-mute)] opacity-60"
          >
            {profile.mfa_enabled ? "Nonaktifkan" : "Aktifkan (Coming Soon)"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionsSection() {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Session[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await listSessions();
      setSessions(data);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
      toast.error("Gagal memuat sesi");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleRevoke = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      await revokeSession(id);
      toast.success("Sesi dicabut");
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal mencabut sesi";
      toast.error(msg);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeAll = async () => {
    try {
      await revokeAllOtherSessions();
      toast.success("Semua sesi lain dicabut");
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal logout";
      toast.error(msg);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Devices & Sessions"
        desc="Perangkat dan sesi login aktif dengan detail lengkap"
      />

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.05)] p-3">
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowInfo(!showInfo)}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-warn)]">
            <AlertCircle size={14} />
            Info: Akurasi Lokasi & Deteksi Perangkat
          </div>
          <ChevronDown
            size={14}
            className={cn(
              "text-[var(--y-warn)] transition-transform",
              showInfo && "rotate-180",
            )}
          />
        </button>
        {showInfo && (
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            <p>
              • Lokasi <b>(estimasi)</b> berdasarkan IP address — akurasi
              ±50-200 km untuk mobile carrier (XL, Telkomsel, Indosat sering
              routing via gateway Jakarta).
            </p>
            <p>
              • IP publik bisa berubah saat Anda berpindah WiFi/data seluler.
              Session dengan perangkat sama akan <b>otomatis digabung</b>.
            </p>
            <p>
              • Untuk keamanan optimal, aktifkan <b>2FA</b> (coming soon) —
              jangan hanya andalkan geolokasi.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          onClick={handleRevokeAll}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.08)] px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-danger)] hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]"
        >
          <LogOut size={13} />
          Logout dari semua perangkat
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid place-items-center py-10">
          <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
        </div>
      ) : sessions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-10 text-center text-sm text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          Tidak ada sesi aktif
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {sessions.map((s) => {
            const Icon = getDeviceIcon(s.device_type);
            return (
              <div
                key={s.id}
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-xl border bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-4",
                  s.is_current
                    ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] ring-2 ring-[rgba(239,68,68,0.1)]"
                    : "border-[var(--y-border)]",
                )}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl",
                      s.is_current
                        ? "bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] text-[#10b981]"
                        : "bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]",
                    )}
                  >
                    <Icon size={20} />
                  </div>

                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                        {s.device_display || s.device_name || "Unknown Device"}
                      </span>
                      {s.is_current && (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-[#10b981]">
                          CURRENT
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {s.device_type && (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                          {s.device_type}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[11px] sm:grid-cols-2">
                      {s.device_brand && (
                        <DetailRow label="Brand" value={s.device_brand} />
                      )}
                      {s.device_model && s.device_model !== "Unknown" && (
                        <DetailRow label="Model" value={s.device_model} mono />
                      )}
                      {s.os && (
                        <DetailRow
                          label="OS"
                          value={`${s.os}${s.os_version ? ` ${s.os_version}` : ""}`}
                        />
                      )}
                      {s.browser && (
                        <DetailRow
                          label="Browser"
                          value={`${s.browser}${s.browser_version ? ` ${s.browser_version}` : ""}`}
                        />
                      )}
                      {s.ip_address && (
                        <DetailRow label="IP" value={s.ip_address} mono />
                      )}
                      {s.location && (
                        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                          <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                            Lokasi:
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className="min-w-0 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]"
                            title="Berdasarkan IP — bisa tidak akurat untuk koneksi mobile/VPN"
                          >
                            {s.location}{" "}
                            <span className="text-[10px] italic text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                              (estimasi)
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {s.isp && (
                        <DetailRow label="ISP" value={s.isp} truncate />
                      )}
                      {s.last_page && (
                        <DetailRow
                          label="Halaman Terakhir"
                          value={s.last_page}
                          mono
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock size={10} />
                        Aktif {formatDateTime(s.last_active_at)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Calendar size={10} />
                        Login {formatDateTime(s.created_at)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {!s.is_current && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleRevoke(s.id)}
                      className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)]"
                      title="Cabut sesi ini"
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={14} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function NotificationsSection() {
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<NotificationPrefs | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getNotificationPrefs();
      setPrefs(data);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
      toast.error("Gagal memuat preferensi notifikasi");
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleToggle = async (key: keyof NotificationPrefs) => {
    if (!prefs || key === "updated_at") return;
    setSaving(key);
    try {
      const updated = await updateNotificationPrefs({
        [key]: !prefs[key],
      });
      setPrefs(updated);
      toast.success("Preferensi diperbarui");
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal menyimpan";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSaving(null);
    }
  };

  if (!prefs) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center py-10">
        <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const items: {
    key: keyof NotificationPrefs;
    label: string;
    desc: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      key: "file_uploaded",
      label: "File Diunggah",
      desc: "Notifikasi saat ada file baru diunggah",
    },
    {
      key: "document_assigned",
      label: "Dokumen Ditugaskan",
      desc: "Notifikasi saat dokumen di-assign ke Anda",
    },
    {
      key: "drive_errors",
      label: "Error Google Drive",
      desc: "Notifikasi saat token Drive perlu reconnect",
    },
    {
      key: "monthly_reports",
      label: "Laporan Bulanan",
      desc: "Ringkasan storage & aktivitas setiap bulan",
    },
    {
      key: "collaboration_invites",
      label: "Undangan Kolaborasi",
      desc: "Notifikasi saat diundang ke workspace",
    },
    {
      key: "security_alerts",
      label: "Peringatan Keamanan",
      desc: "Notifikasi login/perubahan password",
    },
    {
      key: "product_updates",
      label: "Update Produk",
      desc: "Info fitur dan pembaruan aplikasi",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Notifications"
        desc="Atur notifikasi apa yang ingin Anda terima"
      />

      <div className="space-y-2">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.key}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3"
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                {item.label}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                {item.desc}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleToggle(item.key)}
              disabled={saving === item.key}
              className={cn(
                "relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors",
                prefs[item.key]
                  ? "bg-[var(--y-primary)]"
                  : "bg-[var(--y-bg-elev-2)]",
              )}
            >
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform",
                  prefs[item.key] ? "translate-x-6" : "translate-x-1",
                )}
              />
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PreferencesSection({
  profile,
  onChange,
}: {
  profile: UserProfile;
  onChange: (p: UserProfile) => void;
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    theme: getCurrentTheme() as "light" | "dark" | "system",
    timezone: profile.timezone || "Asia/Jakarta",
    email_notifications: profile.email_notifications,
    push_notifications: profile.push_notifications,
    digest_frequency: profile.digest_frequency,
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleThemeChange = async (theme: "light" | "dark" | "system") => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, theme }));
    applyTheme(theme);
    try {
      const updated = await updatePreferences({ theme });
      onChange(updated);
      toast.success(
        `Tema ${theme === "light" ? "terang" : theme === "dark" ? "gelap" : "sistem"} diterapkan`,
        { duration: 2000 },
      );
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal menyimpan tema";
      toast.error(msg);
      applyTheme(form.theme);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const updated = await updatePreferences({
        theme: form.theme,
        language: "id",
        timezone: form.timezone,
        email_notifications: form.email_notifications,
        push_notifications: form.push_notifications,
        digest_frequency: form.digest_frequency,
      });
      onChange(updated);
      applyTheme(updated.theme);
      applyLanguage("id");
      toast.success("Preferensi diperbarui");
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal menyimpan";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const timezones = [
    { value: "Asia/Jakarta", label: "WIB — Jakarta (UTC+7)" },
    { value: "Asia/Pontianak", label: "WIB — Pontianak (UTC+7)" },
    { value: "Asia/Makassar", label: "WITA — Makassar (UTC+8)" },
    { value: "Asia/Jayapura", label: "WIT — Jayapura (UTC+9)" },
  ];

  const themeOptions: {
    value: "light" | "dark" | "system";
    label: string;
    desc: string;
    icon: string;
    bg: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      value: "light",
      label: "Terang",
      desc: "Selalu pakai tema terang",
      icon: "☀️",
      bg: "linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, #f1f5f9)",
    },
    {
      value: "dark",
      label: "Gelap",
      desc: "Selalu pakai tema gelap",
      icon: "🌙",
      bg: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a, #1e293b)",
    },
    {
      value: "system",
      label: "Ikuti Sistem",
      desc: "Otomatis sesuai OS Anda",
      icon: "🖥️",
      bg: "linear-gradient(135deg, #e2e8f0 50%, #1e293b 50%)",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Appearance & Preferences"
        desc="Tema, zona waktu dan notifikasi aplikasi"
      />

      <div>
        <label className="mb-2 block text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          Tema Aplikasi
        </label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
          {themeOptions.map((opt) => {
            const isActive = form.theme === opt.value;
            return (
              <button
                key={opt.value}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleThemeChange(opt.value)}
                className={cn(
                  "group relative flex flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 p-3 transition-all",
                  isActive
                    ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]"
                    : "border-[var(--y-border)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)]",
                )}
              >
                <div
                  className="h-14 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)]"
                  style={{ background: opt.bg }}
                >
                  <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-2xl">
                    {opt.icon}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {isActive && (
                  <div className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 grid h-6 w-6 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[var(--y-primary)] shadow-lg">
                    <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-white" />
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="text-center">
                  <div className="text-[12px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                    {opt.label}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    {opt.desc}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] italic text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          💡 Perubahan tema langsung tersimpan otomatis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <FormField label="Zona Waktu">
          <select
            value={form.timezone}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, timezone: e.target.value })}
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {timezones.map((tz) => (
              <option key={tz.value} value={tz.value}>
                {tz.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </FormField>
        <FormField label="Frekuensi Digest Email">
          <select
            value={form.digest_frequency}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, digest_frequency: e.target.value as any })
            }
            className="y-focus h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm"
          >
            <option value="realtime">Real-time</option>
            <option value="daily">Harian</option>
            <option value="weekly">Mingguan</option>
            <option value="never">Tidak pernah</option>
          </select>
        </FormField>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3">
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Email Notifications
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              Terima notifikasi via email
            </div>
          </div>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={form.email_notifications}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, email_notifications: e.target.checked })
            }
            className="h-5 w-5 rounded border-[var(--y-border)] accent-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
        </label>
        <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3">
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Push Notifications
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              Notifikasi dalam aplikasi
            </div>
          </div>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={form.push_notifications}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, push_notifications: e.target.checked })
            }
            className="h-5 w-5 rounded border-[var(--y-border)] accent-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-4">
        <button
          onClick={handleSave}
          disabled={saving}
          className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {saving ? (
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Save size={14} />
          )}
          Simpan Preferensi
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ActivitySection() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ActivityItem[]>([]);
  const [pageViews, setPageViews] = useState<PageView[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"activity" | "pages">("activity");

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      if (tab === "activity") {
        const data = await listActivity(50, filter || undefined);
        setItems(data);
      } else {
        const data = await listPageViews(100);
        setPageViews(data);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
      toast.error("Gagal memuat riwayat");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [filter, tab]);

  const formatAction = (action: string) => {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      login: "Login",
      register: "Registrasi Akun",
      logout: "Logout",
      update_profile: "Update Profil",
      update_preferences: "Update Preferensi",
      password_changed: "Password Diubah",
      upload_file: "Upload File",
      download_file: "Download File",
      preview_file: "Preview File",
      edit_file: "Edit Dokumen",
      delete_file: "Hapus File",
      share_file: "Buat Share Link",
      revoke_share: "Cabut Share Link",
      share_download: "Download via Share Link",
      update_category: "Ubah Kategori",
      reclassify: "Re-classify File",
      bulk_delete: "Bulk Hapus File",
      bulk_category: "Bulk Ubah Kategori",
      revoke_session: "Cabut Sesi",
      revoke_all_sessions: "Logout Semua Sesi",
    };
    return map[action] || action;
  };

  const filterOptions: { key: string; label: string }[] = [
    { key: "", label: "Semua Aktivitas" },
    { key: "login", label: "Login" },
    { key: "logout", label: "Logout" },
    { key: "update_profile", label: "Update Profil" },
    { key: "update_preferences", label: "Update Preferensi" },
    { key: "password_changed", label: "Password Diubah" },
    { key: "upload_file", label: "Upload File" },
    { key: "download_file", label: "Download File" },
    { key: "preview_file", label: "Preview File" },
    { key: "edit_file", label: "Edit Dokumen" },
    { key: "delete_file", label: "Hapus File" },
    { key: "share_file", label: "Share File" },
    { key: "revoke_share", label: "Cabut Share" },
    { key: "revoke_session", label: "Cabut Sesi" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeader
        title="Activity History"
        desc="Riwayat aktivitas akun & halaman yang dikunjungi"
      />

      <div className="inline-flex gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-1">
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab("activity")}
          className={cn(
            "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold transition-colors",
            tab === "activity"
              ? "bg-[var(--y-primary)] text-white"
              : "text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
          )}
        >
          <History size={12} className="mr-1 inline" />
          Aktivitas
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab("pages")}
          className={cn(
            "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold transition-colors",
            tab === "pages"
              ? "bg-[var(--y-primary)] text-white"
              : "text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
          )}
        >
          <Globe size={12} className="mr-1 inline" />
          Halaman
        </button>
      </div>

      {tab === "activity" && (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <select
            value={filter}
            onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="y-focus h-9 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[12px]"
          >
            {filterOptions.map((opt) => (
              <option key={opt.key} value={opt.key}>
                {opt.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button
            onClick={load}
            className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={12} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid place-items-center py-10">
          <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
        </div>
      ) : tab === "activity" ? (
        items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-10 text-center text-sm text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            Belum ada aktivitas
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {items.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3"
              >
                <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  <History size={14} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                    {formatAction(item.action)}
                  </div>
                  {item.description && (
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                      {item.description}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Clock size={9} />
                      {formatDateTime(item.created_at)}
                    </span>
                    {item.ip_address && (
                      <span className="font-mono">{item.ip_address}</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )
      ) : pageViews.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-10 text-center text-sm text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          Belum ada halaman yang dikunjungi
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {pageViews.map((pv) => (
            <div
              key={pv.id}
              className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3"
            >
              <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.15)] text-[var(--y-primary)]">
                <Globe size={14} />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  {pv.page_title || pv.page_path}
                </div>
                <div className="truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  {pv.page_path}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Clock size={9} />
                    {formatDateTime(pv.created_at)}
                  </span>
                  {pv.device_display && (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Monitor size={9} />
                      {pv.device_display}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {pv.city && (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <MapPin size={9} />
                      {pv.city}
                      {pv.country ? `, ${pv.country}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {pv.duration_ms != null && pv.duration_ms > 0 && (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Compass size={9} />
                      {(pv.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionHeader({ title, desc }: { title: string; desc: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pb-3">
      <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">{title}</h2>
      <p className="text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">{desc}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormField({
  label,
  required,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  required?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-[var(--y-danger)]">*</span>}
      </label>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function ReadOnlyField({
  label,
  value,
  mono,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  mono?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {label}
      </div>
      <div
        className={cn(
          "mt-0.5 break-all rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)]",
          mono && "font-mono text-[11px]",
        )}
      >
        {value || "-"}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailRow({
  label,
  value,
  mono,
  truncate,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  mono?: boolean;
  truncate?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
      <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {label}:
      </span>
      <span
        className={cn(
          "min-w-0 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]",
          mono && "font-mono",
          truncate && "truncate",
        )}
        title={value}
      >
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function getDeviceIcon(deviceType: string | null): typeof Monitor {
  switch (deviceType) {
    case "mobile":
      return Smartphone;
    case "tablet":
      return Tablet;
    case "bot":
      return Bot;
    default:
      return Monitor;
  }
}
