export function ConvertView() {
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const filesLoading = useYudit((s) => s.filesLoading);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);
  const fetchConversionJobs = useYudit((s) => s.fetchConversionJobs);
  const conversionJobs = useYudit((s) => s.conversionJobs);
  const runConversion = useYudit((s) => s.runConversion);
  const converting = useYudit((s) => s.converting);
  const drives = useYudit((s) => s.drives);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const isManager = canManageWorkspace(user);

  const [selectedOp, setSelectedOp] = useState<OpMeta>(OPERATIONS[0]);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  // Opsi tambahan per operasi
  const [compressLevel, setCompressLevel] = useState<
    "low" | "recommended" | "extreme"
  >("extreme");
  const [pdfjpgMode, setPdfjpgMode] = useState<"pages" | "extract">("pages");

  // Fetch awal
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFiles();
    fetchConversionJobs();
  }, [fetchFiles, fetchConversionJobs]);

  // Reset selection saat ganti operasi
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIds([]);
    setSearch("");
  }, [selectedOp.key]);

  // Filter file sesuai operasi
  const eligibleFiles = useMemo(() => {
    const exts = new Set(selectedOp.extensions);
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return files.filter((f) => {
      const ext = (f.file_type || f.name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();
      if (!exts.has(ext)) return false;
      if (q && !f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [files, selectedOp, search]);

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      if (!selectedOp.multi) return prev.includes(id) ? [] : [id];
      return prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id];
    });
  };

  const canConvert =
    selectedIds.length > 0 &&
    (selectedOp.key !== "merge_pdf" || selectedIds.length >= 2) &&
    !converting;

  const handleConvert = async () => {
    if (!canConvert) return;

    let params: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (selectedOp.key === "compress_pdf") {
      params = { compression_level: compressLevel };
    } else if (selectedOp.key === "pdf_to_jpg") {
      params = { pdfjpg_mode: pdfjpgMode };
    }

    const res = await runConversion(selectedOp.key, selectedIds, params);
    if (res) setSelectedIds([]);
  };

  const noDrives = isManager && drives.length === 0;

  return (
    <div className="y-anim-fade">
      {/* =====================================================
          HEADER
          ===================================================== */}
      <div className="mb-5">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          Konversi Dokumen
        </h1>
        <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          Hanya untuk file yang sudah diupload ke Yudit Cloud. File asli tetap
          aman — hasil adalah file baru.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* =====================================================
          BANNER: NO DRIVES (owner/super_admin)
          ===================================================== */}
      {noDrives && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(245,158,11,0.35)] bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.08)] p-4">
          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.18)]">
            <Sparkles size={16} className="text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">Hubungkan Google Drive dulu.</b>{" "}
            Hasil konversi disimpan ke storage pool Anda.
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setView("drives")}
            className="inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--y-warn)] px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-white"
          >
            Connect <ArrowRight size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =====================================================
          ⭐ BANNER: MODE MEMBER (dipindah dari dalam card)
          ===================================================== */}
      {!isManager && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.06)] p-4">
          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.15)]">
            <Info size={16} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">Mode Member.</b> Konversi
            tersedia — file hasil akan disimpan ke storage pool owner.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =====================================================
          OPERATION PICKER
          ===================================================== */}
      <div className="mb-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
        {OPERATIONS.map((op) => {
          const active = selectedOp.key === op.key;
          return (
            <motion.button
              key={op.key}
              onClick={() => setSelectedOp(op)}
              whileHover={{ y: -2 }}
              className={cn(
                "group relative flex flex-col items-start gap-2 rounded-2xl border p-3 text-left transition-all",
                active
                  ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.1)] shadow-[0_0_0_2px_var(--y-primary-glow)]"
                  : "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)]",
              )}
            >
              <div
                className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg"
                style={{ background: op.bg, color: op.color }}
              >
                {op.icon}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-[12px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  {op.label}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  {op.desc}
                </div>
              </div>
              {active && (
                <CheckCircle2
                  size={13}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-[var(--y-primary)]"
                />
              )}
            </motion.button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* =====================================================
          MAIN PANEL
          ===================================================== */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">
        {/* ============================================
            FILE SELECTOR
            ============================================ */}
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                Pilih File
                {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--y-primary)] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
                    {selectedIds.length} dipilih
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                Format didukung:{" "}
                {selectedOp.extensions.join(", ").toUpperCase()}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => fetchFiles()}
              disabled={filesLoading}
              className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={12}
                className={filesLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}
              />
              Reload
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mb-3">
            <Search
              size={14}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
            />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Cari file…"
              className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-9 pr-9 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] outline-none"
            />
            {search && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
              >
                <X size={14} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {filesLoading && files.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="grid place-items-center py-14">
              <Loader2
                size={24}
                className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
              />
            </div>
          ) : eligibleFiles.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="grid place-items-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-12 text-center">
              <div className="grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
                <Inbox size={24} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                {search
                  ? "Tidak ada file yang cocok"
                  : "Belum ada file dengan format ini"}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 max-w-[260px] text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                Upload dulu file{" "}
                <b className="text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                  {selectedOp.extensions.join(" / ").toUpperCase()}
                </b>{" "}
                di menu My Files.
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex max-h-[520px] flex-col gap-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {eligibleFiles.map((f) => (
                <ConvertFileRow
                  key={f.id}
                  file={f}
                  selected={selectedIds.includes(f.id)}
                  onToggle={() => toggleSelect(f.id)}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {eligibleFiles.length > 1 && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-2.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              <span>{eligibleFiles.length} file tersedia</span>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() =>
                    setSelectedIds(eligibleFiles.map((f) => f.id))
                  }
                  className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
                >
                  Pilih semua
                </button>
                <span className="opacity-30">•</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedIds([])}
                  className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:underline"
                >
                  Reset
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ============================================
            RIGHT PANEL
            ============================================ */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <div
                className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg"
                style={{ background: selectedOp.bg, color: selectedOp.color }}
              >
                {selectedOp.icon}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  {selectedOp.label}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  {selectedIds.length} file dipilih
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Compress PDF options */}
            {selectedOp.key === "compress_pdf" && (
              <div className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-2.5">
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  Level Kompresi
                </label>
                <select
                  value={compressLevel}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCompressLevel(e.target.value as typeof compressLevel)
                  }
                  className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="low">Low — kualitas terbaik</option>
                  <option value="recommended">Recommended — balance</option>
                  <option value="extreme">Extreme — ukuran terkecil</option>
                </select>
                <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  💡 File dari Word/Excel biasanya hanya turun 10-20%. File
                  hasil scan bisa turun 50-70%.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* PDF → JPG options */}
            {selectedOp.key === "pdf_to_jpg" && (
              <div className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-2.5">
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  Mode Konversi
                </label>
                <select
                  value={pdfjpgMode}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setPdfjpgMode(e.target.value as typeof pdfjpgMode)
                  }
                  className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="pages">Pages — tiap halaman jadi 1 JPG</option>
                  <option value="extract">Extract — ekstrak gambar</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* PDF → Word info */}
            {selectedOp.key === "pdf_to_word" && (
              <div className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-[rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] bg-[rgba(34,197,94,0.08)] p-2.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[#4ade80]">
                ✅ Konversi lokal (gratis, tanpa credits iLovePDF). Format font,
                spacing, tabel, & gambar dipertahankan.
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-3 space-y-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-2">
                {selectedIds.slice(0, 5).map((id) => {
                  const f = files.find((x) => x.id === id);
                  if (!f) return null;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={id}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]"
                    >
                      <FileIcon
                        mime={f.mime_type || ""}
                        name={f.name}
                        size={12}
                      />
                      <span className="truncate">{f.name}</span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                {selectedIds.length > 5 && (
                  <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    +{selectedIds.length - 5} file lainnya
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleConvert}
              disabled={!canConvert || noDrives}
              className={cn(
                "y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all",
                "hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 disabled:hover:translate-y-0",
              )}
            >
              {converting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                  Memproses…
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  Konversi Sekarang <ArrowRight size={16} />
                </>
              )}
            </button>

            {selectedOp.key === "merge_pdf" && selectedIds.length < 2 && (
              <div className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--y-warn)]">
                Merge butuh minimal 2 file PDF
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              💡 File asli tidak akan diubah. Hasil konversi menjadi file baru
              di folder bulanan Anda.
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Jobs History */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package2 size={14} className="text-[var(--y-accent)]" />
                <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Riwayat Konversi
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => fetchConversionJobs()}
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
              >
                Refresh
              </button>
            </div>
            {conversionJobs.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-6 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                Belum ada riwayat konversi
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex max-h-[320px] flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                  {conversionJobs.slice(0, 20).map((j) => (
                    <JobRow key={j.id} job={j} files={files} />
                  ))}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// FILE ROW
// =====================================================
function ConvertFileRow({
  file,
  selected,
  onToggle,
}: {
  file: FileItem;
  selected: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onToggle}
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-2 text-left transition-all",
        selected
          ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.12)]"
          : "border-transparent hover:border-[var(--y-border)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]",
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "grid h-5 w-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md border transition-colors",
          selected
            ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[var(--y-primary)]"
            : "border-[var(--y-border)]",
        )}
      >
        {selected && (
          <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-white" strokeWidth={3} />
        )}
      </div>
      <FileIcon mime={file.mime_type || ""} name={file.name} size={16} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          {file.name}
        </div>
        <div className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {formatBytes(file.size)} • {formatDate(file.created_at)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// JOB ROW
// =====================================================
function JobRow({
  job,
  files,
}: {
  job: ConversionJob;
  files: FileItem[];
}) {
  const src = files.find((f) => f.id === job.source_file_id);
  const res = job.result_file_id
    ? files.find((f) => f.id === job.result_file_id)
    : null;

  const createdDate = new Date(job.created_at);
  const time = createdDate.toLocaleTimeString("id-ID", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
  const date = createdDate.toLocaleDateString("id-ID", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
  });

  const StatusIcon =
    job.status === "success"
      ? CheckCircle2
      : job.status === "failed"
        ? XCircle
        : Clock;

  const statusColor =
    job.status === "success"
      ? "text-[var(--y-success)]"
      : job.status === "failed"
        ? "text-[var(--y-danger)]"
        : "text-[var(--y-warn)]";

  const statusLabel =
    job.status === "success"
      ? "Berhasil"
      : job.status === "failed"
        ? "Gagal"
        : job.status === "processing"
          ? "Memproses…"
          : "Menunggu";

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
      className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-2 py-1.5"
    >
      <StatusIcon size={13} className={cn("mt-0.5 shrink-0", statusColor)} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="truncate text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          {job.operation.replace(/_/g, " ").toUpperCase()}
        </div>
        <div className="truncate text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {src?.name || `${job.source_file_id.slice(0, 8)}…`}
        </div>
        {res && (
          <div className="truncate text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-success)]">
            → {res.name}
          </div>
        )}
        {job.error_message && (
          <div
            className="truncate text-[10px] text-[var(--y-danger)]"
            title={job.error_message}
          >
            {job.error_message}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span>
            {date} · {time}
          </span>
          <span className="opacity-40">•</span>
          <span className={statusColor}>{statusLabel}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/views/forced-password-change-view.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/views/forced-password-change-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { KeyRound, Lock, ShieldAlert, Loader2, ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function ForcedPasswordChangeView() {
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const changePassword = useYudit((s) => s.changePassword);
  const logout = useYudit((s) => s.logout);

  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!currentPassword) return toast.error("Masukkan password saat ini");
    if (newPassword.length < 6) return toast.error("Password baru minimal 6 karakter");
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) return toast.error("Konfirmasi tidak cocok");
    if (newPassword === currentPassword) return toast.error("Password baru tidak boleh sama dengan lama");

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword);
      // Store sudah update user.must_change_password = false → YuditCloud auto rerender
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.detail || "Gagal ganti password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="yudit-ambient relative grid min-h-screen place-items-center overflow-hidden p-5">
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -left-20 top-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-30 blur-3xl"
        style={{ background: "radial-gradient(circle, var(--y-warn), transparent 70%)" }}
      />
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-20 bottom-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-25 blur-3xl"
        style={{ background: "radial-gradient(circle, var(--y-primary), transparent 70%)" }}
      />

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft relative z-10 w-full max-w-[440px] rounded-3xl border border-[var(--y-border)] p-8"
      >
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col items-center">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.8, rotate: -8 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, rotate: 0 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 15 }}
            className="mb-4 grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--y-warn)]"
            style={{ boxShadow: "0 8px 32px rgba(245,158,11,0.35)" }}
          >
            <KeyRound size={32} className="text-white" />
          </motion.div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">Ganti Password</h1>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-center text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            Halo <b>{user?.username}</b>, Anda masih memakai password default.
            <br />Demi keamanan, wajib ganti password sekarang.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.08)] p-3">
          <ShieldAlert size={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
          <div className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-warn)]">
            <b>Wajib ganti password.</b> Anda tidak bisa mengakses dashboard
            sampai password berhasil diubah.
          </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <PasswordField
            label="Password Saat Ini"
            placeholder="Password default: 123456"
            value={currentPassword}
            onChange={setCurrentPassword}
            autoFocus
          />
          <PasswordField
            label="Password Baru"
            placeholder="Minimal 6 karakter"
            value={newPassword}
            onChange={setNewPassword}
          />
          <PasswordField
            label="Konfirmasi Password Baru"
            placeholder="Ulangi password baru"
            value={confirmPassword}
            onChange={setConfirmPassword}
          />

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className={cn(
              "y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary group flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all",
              "hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-70 disabled:hover:translate-y-0",
            )}
          >
            {loading ? (
              <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <span>Simpan Password Baru</span>
                <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={logout}
            className="w-full text-center text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)]"
          >
            Logout
          </button>
        </form>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PasswordField({
  label, placeholder, value, onChange, autoFocus,
}: {
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div className="group relative">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] group-focus-within:text-[var(--y-primary)]">
          <Lock size={16} />
        </div>
        <input
          type={show ? "text" : "password"}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          required
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          minLength={6}
          className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-10 pr-11 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShow((s) => !s)}
          className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          tabIndex={-1}
        >
          {show ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// UTILS
// =====================================================
async function copyText(
  value: string,
  successMessage: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (!navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
      throw new Error("Clipboard API tidak tersedia");
    }
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    toast.success(successMessage);
    return true;
  } catch {
    toast.error("Tidak dapat menyalin. Periksa izin clipboard browser.");
    return false;
  }
}

function getInitial(value?: string | null): string {
  const normalized = value?.trim();
  return normalized ? normalized.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "?";
}

function parseInviteError(err: unknown): {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  hint?: string;
} {
  if (!(err instanceof ApiError)) {
    return {
      title: "Gagal Mengundang",
      message: "Terjadi kesalahan tidak terduga. Coba lagi.",
    };
  }

  const detail = err.detail || "";
  const detailLower = detail.toLowerCase();
  const status = err.status;

  if (status === 400 && detailLower.includes("email")) {
    if (
      detailLower.includes("sudah terdaftar") ||
      detailLower.includes("already") ||
      detailLower.includes("duplicate")
    ) {
      return {
        title: "Email Sudah Terdaftar",
        message: detail || "Email ini sudah ada di sistem.",
        hint: "Coba gunakan email lain, atau minta user tersebut login dengan akunnya.",
      };
    }
    if (detailLower.includes("format") || detailLower.includes("valid")) {
      return {
        title: "Format Email Tidak Valid",
        message: detail || "Format email tidak valid.",
        hint: "Periksa kembali penulisan email (contoh: nama@domain.com).",
      };
    }
  }

  if (status === 400 && detailLower.includes("role")) {
    return {
      title: "Role Tidak Valid",
      message: detail,
      hint: "Pilih 'member' atau 'super_admin'.",
    };
  }

  if (status === 400) {
    return {
      title: "Data Tidak Valid",
      message: detail || "Data yang dikirim tidak valid.",
      hint: "Periksa kembali form dan coba lagi.",
    };
  }

  if (status === 401) {
    return {
      title: "Sesi Berakhir",
      message: "Sesi login Anda sudah berakhir. Silakan login ulang.",
    };
  }

  if (status === 403) {
    return {
      title: "Akses Ditolak",
      message:
        detail ||
        "Anda tidak punya izin untuk mengundang collaborator dengan role ini.",
      hint:
        detailLower.includes("super_admin")
          ? "Hanya owner yang bisa membuat super_admin."
          : "Hubungi owner workspace.",
    };
  }

  if (status >= 500) {
    return {
      title: "Server Error",
      message: detail || "Terjadi kesalahan di server. Coba lagi nanti.",
      hint: "Jika terus terjadi, hubungi administrator.",
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "Gagal Mengundang",
    message: detail || "Terjadi kesalahan.",
  };
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ MAIN VIEW
// =====================================================
export function CollaboratorsView() {
  const user = useYudit((state) => state.user);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((state) => state.showConfirm);

  const [collabs, setCollabs] = useState<Collaborator[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [inviteOpen, setInviteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>("list");

  // ⭐ canManage = full access; member = read-only
  const canManage = canManageWorkspace(user);
  const isOwner = isOwnerFn(user);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await listCollaborators();
      setCollabs(Array.isArray(result) ? result : []);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const message =
        error instanceof ApiError
          ? error.detail
          : "Gagal memuat daftar collaborator";
      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    if (!query) return collabs;

    return collabs.filter((collaborator) => {
      const email = collaborator.email?.toLocaleLowerCase() ?? "";
      const username = collaborator.username?.toLocaleLowerCase() ?? "";
      return email.includes(query) || username.includes(query);
    });
  }, [collabs, search]);

  const stats = useMemo(
    () => ({
      total: collabs.length,
      superAdmins: collabs.filter((item) => item.role === "super_admin")
        .length,
      active: collabs.filter((item) => item.is_active).length,
      pendingPassword: collabs.filter(
        (item) => item.must_change_password,
      ).length,
    }),
    [collabs],
  );

  // =====================================================
  // HANDLERS (sama seperti sebelumnya)
  // =====================================================
  const handleToggleActive = (collaborator: Collaborator) => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner/super admin yang bisa ubah status");
      return;
    }
    showConfirm(
      collaborator.is_active ? "Nonaktifkan akun?" : "Aktifkan akun?",
      collaborator.is_active
        ? `${collaborator.email} tidak akan bisa login sampai diaktifkan kembali.`
        : `${collaborator.email} akan bisa login kembali.`,
      async () => {
        try {
          await updateCollaborator(collaborator.id, {
            is_active: !collaborator.is_active,
          });
          toast.success(
            collaborator.is_active
              ? "Akun berhasil dinonaktifkan"
              : "Akun berhasil diaktifkan",
          );
          await load();
        } catch (error: any) {
          toast.error(error?.detail || "Gagal mengubah status akun");
        }
      },
    );
  };

  const handleResetPassword = (collaborator: Collaborator) => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner/super admin yang bisa reset password");
      return;
    }
    showConfirm(
      "Reset password collaborator?",
      `Password ${collaborator.email} akan direset menjadi password sementara yang unik dan wajib diganti saat login berikutnya.`,
      async () => {
        try {
          const result = await updateCollaborator(collaborator.id, {
            reset_password: true,
          });
          if (result.email_delivery?.sent) {
            toast.success(
              "Password direset dan email kredensial diterima oleh Gmail API",
            );
          } else {
            const temporaryPassword = result.temporary_password || "";
            if (temporaryPassword && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
              try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(temporaryPassword);
                toast.error(
                  `Password sudah direset, tetapi email gagal (${result.email_delivery?.code || "unknown"}). Password sementara disalin ke clipboard.`,
                );
              } catch {
                toast.error(
                  `Password sudah direset tetapi email gagal. Kode: ${result.email_delivery?.code || "unknown"}.`,
                );
              }
            } else {
              toast.error(
                `Password sudah direset tetapi email gagal. Kode: ${result.email_delivery?.code || "unknown"}.`,
              );
            }
          }
          await load();
        } catch (error: any) {
          toast.error(error?.detail || "Gagal mereset password");
        }
      },
    );
  };

  const handleChangeRole = (collaborator: Collaborator) => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner yang bisa ubah role");
      return;
    }
    const nextRole =
      collaborator.role === "super_admin" ? "member" : "super_admin";
    showConfirm(
      `Ubah menjadi ${nextRole === "super_admin" ? "Super Admin" : "Member"}?`,
      nextRole === "super_admin"
        ? `${collaborator.email} akan dapat mengelola collaborator dan akun Google Drive.`
        : `${collaborator.email} hanya dapat mengelola dokumen yang ditugaskan.`,
      async () => {
        try {
          await updateCollaborator(collaborator.id, { role: nextRole });
          toast.success("Role collaborator berhasil diperbarui");
          await load();
        } catch (error: any) {
          toast.error(error?.detail || "Gagal mengubah role");
        }
      },
    );
  };

  const handleRemove = (collaborator: Collaborator) => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner yang bisa hapus collaborator");
      return;
    }
    showConfirm(
      "Hapus collaborator?",
      `${collaborator.email} akan dihapus permanen. Assignment dokumen miliknya juga akan dicabut.`,
      async () => {
        try {
          await removeCollaborator(collaborator.id);
          toast.success("Collaborator berhasil dihapus");
          await load();
        } catch (error: any) {
          toast.error(error?.detail || "Gagal menghapus collaborator");
        }
      },
    );
  };

  return (
    <section className="y-anim-fade min-w-0 space-y-5">
      {/* =====================================================
          HEADER
          ===================================================== */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-[rgba(249,91,47,0.12)] text-[var(--y-primary)]">
              <Users size={18} />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Collaborators
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {canManage
              ? "Kelola anggota tim, hak akses & statistik aktivitas."
              : "Daftar anggota workspace (read-only)."}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap gap-2 sm:w-auto sm:justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void load()}
            disabled={loading}
            className="inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] shadow-sm transition-colors hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 sm:flex-none"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={cn(loading && "animate-spin")} />
            Refresh
          </button>
          {canManage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setInviteOpen(true)}
              className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 sm:flex-none"
            >
              <UserPlus size={15} />
              Undang Collaborator
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ⭐ Info banner untuk member */}
      {!canManage && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.06)] p-4">
          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.15)]">
            <Info size={16} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />

          CONTENT

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        <motion.div

          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}

        >

                      : canManage
