        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>

      {canManage && (
        <InviteCollaboratorModal
          open={inviteOpen}
          onClose={() => setInviteOpen(false)}
          onSuccess={load}
          isOwner={isOwner}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ COLLABORATOR STATS SECTION — Hanya owner/super_admin
// =====================================================
function CollaboratorStatsSection() {
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<WorkspaceStatsSummary | null>(null);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<CollaboratorStats[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<
    "all" | "owner" | "super_admin" | "member"
  >("all");

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [s, st] = await Promise.all([
        getWorkspaceStatsSummary(),
        getCollaboratorStats(),
      ]);
      setSummary(s);
      setStats(st);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) return;
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 403) {
        setError("Hanya owner/super admin yang bisa melihat statistik tim.");
        return;
      }
      const msg =
        err instanceof ApiError ? err.detail : "Gagal memuat statistik";
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let out = stats;
    if (roleFilter !== "all") {
      out = out.filter((s) => s.role === roleFilter);
    }
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      out = out.filter(
        (s) =>
          s.username.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.email.toLowerCase().includes(q),
      );
    }
    return out;
  }, [stats, search, roleFilter]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center py-20">
        <Loader2 size={28} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !summary) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-6 text-center">
        <AlertCircle
          size={28}
          className="mx-auto mb-2 text-[var(--y-danger)]"
        />
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {error || "Statistik tidak tersedia"}
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={load}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={13} />
          Coba Lagi
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // =====================================================
  // WORKSPACE SUMMARY CARDS
  // =====================================================
  const summaryCards: {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    sub: string;
    Icon: React.ElementType;
    color: string;
    bg: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      label: "Anggota Tim",
      value: String(summary.total_users),
      sub: "Total user workspace",
      Icon: Users,
      color: "#6366f1",
      bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Total Upload",
      value: String(summary.total_uploads_workspace),
      sub: formatBytes(summary.total_uploads_size_workspace),
      Icon: Upload,
      color: "#10b981",
      bg: "rgba(16,185,129,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Total Edit",
      value: String(summary.total_edits_workspace),
      sub: "Versi dokumen",
      Icon: PencilLine,
      color: "#22d3ee",
      bg: "rgba(34,211,238,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Download",
      value: String(summary.total_downloads_workspace),
      sub: "File diunduh",
      Icon: Download,
      color: "#f59e0b",
      bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Preview",
      value: String(summary.total_previews_workspace),
      sub: "File dilihat",
      Icon: Eye,
      color: "#a855f7",
      bg: "rgba(168,85,247,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Share Link",
      value: String(summary.total_shares_workspace),
      sub: "Link dibuat",
      Icon: Share2,
      color: "#ec4899",
      bg: "rgba(236,72,153,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Konversi",
      value: String(summary.total_conversions_workspace),
      sub: "File dikonversi",
      Icon: FileCog,
      color: "#e11d48",
      bg: "rgba(225,29,72,0.12)",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="border-b border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pb-3">
        <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          Statistik Tim
        </h2>
        <p className="text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          Ringkasan aktivitas seluruh anggota workspace per user
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Refresh */}
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          onClick={load}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={12} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Workspace summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {summaryCards.map((c, i) => (
          <motion.div
            key={c.label}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: i * 0.04 }}
            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3.5"
          >
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                {c.label}
              </span>
              <div
                className="grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-lg"
                style={{ background: c.bg, color: c.color }}
              >
                <c.Icon size={13} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div
              className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums"
              style={{ color: c.color }}
            >
              {c.value}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              {c.sub}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Filter & Search */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
        <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-1">
          {(
            [
              { key: "all", label: "Semua" },
              { key: "owner", label: "Owner" },
              { key: "super_admin", label: "Super Admin" },
              { key: "member", label: "Member" },
            ] as const
          ).map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f.key}
              onClick={() => setRoleFilter(f.key)}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors",
                roleFilter === f.key
                  ? "bg-[var(--y-primary)] text-white"
                  : "text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
              )}
            >
              {f.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search
            size={15}
            className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
          />
          <input
            type="search"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Cari nama atau email user…"
            className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-9 pr-9 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] outline-none"
          />
          {search && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSearch("")}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
            >
              <X size={13} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Per-user list */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="grid place-items-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-12 text-center">
          <Inbox size={28} className="mb-2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
          <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {search || roleFilter !== "all"
              ? "Tidak ada user yang cocok"
              : "Belum ada user di workspace"}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            {search || roleFilter !== "all"
              ? "Coba reset filter atau ubah kata kunci."
              : "Undang collaborator untuk melihat statistik mereka di sini."}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          {filtered.map((s, i) => (
            <UserStatsCard key={s.user_id} stats={s} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ USER STATS CARD — Per user dengan dropdown
// =====================================================
function UserStatsCard({
  stats,
  index,
}: {
  stats: CollaboratorStats;
  index: number;
}) {
  const [openUploads, setOpenUploads] = useState(false);
  const [openEdits, setOpenEdits] = useState(false);
  const [uploads, setUploads] = useState<CollaboratorUpload[]>([]);
  const [edits, setEdits] = useState<CollaboratorEdit[]>([]);
  const [loadingUploads, setLoadingUploads] = useState(false);
  const [loadingEdits, setLoadingEdits] = useState(false);
  const [loadedUploads, setLoadedUploads] = useState(false);
  const [loadedEdits, setLoadedEdits] = useState(false);

  // Lazy load uploads saat dropdown dibuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openUploads || loadedUploads) return;
    setLoadingUploads(true);
    listCollaboratorUploads(stats.user_id, 50)
      .then((data) => {
        setUploads(data);
        setLoadedUploads(true);
      })
      .catch(() => toast.error("Gagal memuat upload"))
      .finally(() => setLoadingUploads(false));
  }, [openUploads, loadedUploads, stats.user_id]);

  // Lazy load edits saat dropdown dibuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openEdits || loadedEdits) return;
    setLoadingEdits(true);
    listCollaboratorEdits(stats.user_id, 50)
      .then((data) => {
        setEdits(data);
        setLoadedEdits(true);
      })
      .catch(() => toast.error("Gagal memuat edit"))
      .finally(() => setLoadingEdits(false));
  }, [openEdits, loadedEdits, stats.user_id]);

  const roleBadge = {
    owner: {
      label: "OWNER",
      bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
      color: "#ef4444",
      icon: <Crown size={10} />,
    },
    super_admin: {
      label: "SUPER ADMIN",
      bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.15)",
      color: "#f59e0b",
      icon: <ShieldCheck size={10} />,
    },
    member: {
      label: "MEMBER",
      bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.15)",
      color: "#6366f1",
      icon: <Shield size={10} />,
    },
  }[stats.role] || {
    label: stats.role.toUpperCase(),
    bg: "rgba(100,116,139,0.15)",
    color: "#94a3b8",
    icon: null,
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.03, 0.3) }}
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)]"
    >
      {/* Header user */}
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border-soft)] p-3.5">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm",
            stats.role === "super_admin"
              ? "bg-amber-500"
              : stats.role === "owner"
                ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500 to-orange-500"
                : "bg-[var(--y-primary)]",
            !stats.is_active && "grayscale",
          )}
        >
          {stats.avatar_url ? (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img
              src={stats.avatar_url}
              alt={stats.username}
              className="h-full w-full rounded-full object-cover"
            />
          ) : (
            getInitial(stats.username)
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              {stats.username}
            </span>
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold"
              style={{ background: roleBadge.bg, color: roleBadge.color }}
            >
              {roleBadge.icon}
              {roleBadge.label}
            </span>
            {!stats.is_active && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                NONAKTIF
              </span>
            )}
            {stats.must_change_password && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-[var(--y-warn)]">
                PERLU GANTI PW
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            {stats.email}
          </div>
          {stats.last_login_at && (
            <div className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              <Clock size={9} />
              Login terakhir {formatDateTime(stats.last_login_at)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-3.5 sm:grid-cols-6">
        <MiniStat
          icon={<Upload size={12} />}
          label="Upload"
          value={stats.total_uploads}
          color="#6366f1"
        />
        <MiniStat
          icon={<PencilLine size={12} />}
          label="Edit"
          value={stats.total_edits}
          color="#10b981"
        />
        <MiniStat
          icon={<Download size={12} />}
          label="Download"
          value={stats.total_downloads}
          color="#22d3ee"
        />
        <MiniStat
          icon={<Eye size={12} />}
          label="Preview"
          value={stats.total_previews}
          color="#f59e0b"
        />
        <MiniStat
          icon={<Share2 size={12} />}
          label="Share"
          value={stats.total_shares}
          color="#a855f7"
        />
        <MiniStat
          icon={<FileCog size={12} />}
          label="Konversi"
          value={stats.total_conversions}
          color="#ec4899"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Contributed size */}
      <div className="mx-3.5 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px]">
        <HardDrive size={11} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
        <span className="text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          Kontribusi storage:
        </span>
        <span className="font-bold text-[var(--y-accent)]">
          {formatBytes(stats.contributed_size)}
        </span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {formatBytes(stats.total_uploads_size)}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Dropdowns */}
      <div className="border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)]">
        {/* Uploads dropdown */}
        <StatsDropdown
          open={openUploads}
          onToggle={() => setOpenUploads((v) => !v)}
          icon={<Upload size={13} />}
          iconColor="#6366f1"
          title="Dokumen Upload"
          count={stats.total_uploads}
          totalSize={stats.total_uploads_size}
          loading={loadingUploads}
          empty={loadedUploads && uploads.length === 0}
          emptyText="User ini belum upload file"
        >
          {uploads.map((u) => (
            <UploadItem key={u.id} upload={u} />
          ))}
        </StatsDropdown>

        {/* Edits dropdown */}
        <StatsDropdown
          open={openEdits}
          onToggle={() => setOpenEdits((v) => !v)}
          icon={<PencilLine size={13} />}
          iconColor="#10b981"
          title="Dokumen Edit"
          count={stats.total_edited_files}
          totalSize={null}
          loading={loadingEdits}
          empty={loadedEdits && edits.length === 0}
          emptyText="User ini belum edit dokumen"
        >
          {edits.map((e) => (
            <EditItem key={e.file_id} edit={e} />
          ))}
        </StatsDropdown>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ MINI STAT
// =====================================================
function MiniStat({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  color,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-1.5">
      <div style={{ color }} className="mb-0.5">
        {icon}
      </div>
      <div
        className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums leading-none"
        style={{ color }}
      >
        {value}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {label}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ STATS DROPDOWN
// =====================================================
function StatsDropdown({
  open,
  onToggle,
  icon,
  iconColor,
  title,
  count,
  totalSize,
  loading,
  empty,
  emptyText,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  iconColor: string;
  title: string;
  count: number;
  totalSize: number | null;
  loading: boolean;
  empty: boolean;
  emptyText: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
      >
        <div
          className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md"
          style={{ background: `${iconColor}22`, color: iconColor }}
        >
          {icon}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {title}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            {count} file
            {totalSize != null && totalSize > 0 && (
              <> · {formatBytes(totalSize)}</>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown
          size={14}
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-transform duration-200",
            open && "rotate-180",
          )}
        />
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] p-1.5">
              {loading ? (
                <div className="grid place-items-center py-4">
                  <Loader2
                    size={16}
                    className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
                  />
                </div>
              ) : empty ? (
                <div className="grid place-items-center py-4 text-center">
                  <Inbox size={18} className="mb-1 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
                  <p className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    {emptyText}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                children
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ UPLOAD ITEM
// =====================================================
function UploadItem({ upload }: { upload: CollaboratorUpload }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]">
      <div className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.1)] text-[#6366f1]">
        <FileText size={11} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div
          className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]"
          title={upload.name}
        >
          {upload.name}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-[9.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span className="tabular-nums">{formatBytes(upload.size)}</span>
          {upload.category && (
            <>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="truncate">{upload.category}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="shrink-0 text-[9.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {formatDate(upload.created_at)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ EDIT ITEM
// =====================================================
function EditItem({ edit }: { edit: CollaboratorEdit }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]">
      <div className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.1)] text-[#10b981]">
        <PencilLine size={11} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div
          className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]"
          title={edit.file_name}
        >
          {edit.file_name}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-[9.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] px-1 py-0.5 font-bold text-[#10b981]">
            {edit.edit_count}× edit
          </span>
          {edit.file_size != null && (
            <span className="tabular-nums">
              {formatBytes(edit.file_size)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="shrink-0 text-[9.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {formatDate(edit.last_edited_at)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// STAT CARD (existing)
// =====================================================
function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon,
  color,
  helper,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  color: string;
  helper: string;
}) {
  return (
    <article className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-3.5 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md sm:p-4">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="truncate text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[var(--y-text-mute)] sm:text-[11px]">
          {label}
        </span>
        <span
          className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl"
          style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}18`, color }}
        >
          {icon}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-bold leading-none tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text)]">
        {value}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 truncate text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {helper}
      </p>
    </article>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// COLLABORATOR ROW (existing, tidak diubah)
// =====================================================
function CollaboratorRow({
  collab,
  isOwner,
  canManage,
  index,
  onToggleActive,
  onResetPassword,
  onChangeRole,
  onRemove,
}: {
  collab: Collaborator;
  isOwner: boolean;
  canManage: boolean;
  index: number;
  onToggleActive: () => void;
  onResetPassword: () => void;
  onChangeRole: () => void;
  onRemove: () => void;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleCopyEmail = async () => {
    const ok = await copyText(
      collab.email,
      "Email collaborator berhasil disalin",
    );
    if (ok) {
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
    }
  };

  return (
    <motion.article
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.025, 0.2), duration: 0.2 }}
      className={cn(
        "group flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-3 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(15,23,42,0.035)] transition-all duration-150",
        "hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:shadow-sm",
        !collab.is_active && "opacity-75",
        "sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-3.5 sm:px-3.5 sm:py-3",
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm",
            collab.role === "super_admin"
              ? "bg-amber-500"
              : "y-gradient-brand",
            !collab.is_active && "grayscale",
          )}
        >
          {getInitial(collab.username)}
        </div>

        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
            <h3 className="max-w-full truncate text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              {collab.username || "Tanpa username"}
            </h3>
            <RoleBadge role={collab.role} />
            {!collab.is_active && (
              <StatusBadge kind="inactive">NONAKTIF</StatusBadge>
            )}
            {collab.must_change_password && (
              <StatusBadge kind="warning">PERLU GANTI PW</StatusBadge>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void handleCopyEmail()}
            className="group/email mt-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md text-left text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          >
            <Mail size={11} className="shrink-0" />
            <span className="max-w-[min(68vw,420px)] truncate">
              {collab.email}
            </span>
            {copied ? (
              <Check size={11} className="shrink-0 text-[var(--y-success)]" />
            ) : (
              <Copy
                size={10}
                className="shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/email:opacity-100"
              />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {canManage && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 pl-[52px] sm:ml-auto sm:flex sm:shrink-0 sm:justify-end sm:pl-0">
          {isOwner && (
            <ActionButton
              label={
                collab.role === "super_admin"
                  ? "Jadikan Member"
                  : "Jadikan Super Admin"
              }
              onClick={onChangeRole}
              tone="neutral"
            >
              {collab.role === "super_admin" ? (
                <ShieldAlert size={14} />
              ) : (
                <Shield size={14} />
              )}
              <span className="sm:hidden">Role</span>
            </ActionButton>
          )}
          <ActionButton
            label="Reset password"
            onClick={onResetPassword}
            tone="warning"
          >
            <KeyRound size={14} />
            <span className="sm:hidden">Reset PW</span>
          </ActionButton>
          <ActionButton
            label={collab.is_active ? "Nonaktifkan akun" : "Aktifkan akun"}
            onClick={onToggleActive}
            tone="neutral"
          >
            {collab.is_active ? <UserX size={14} /> : <UserCheck size={14} />}
            <span className="sm:hidden">
              {collab.is_active ? "Nonaktifkan" : "Aktifkan"}
            </span>
          </ActionButton>
          {isOwner && (
            <ActionButton
              label="Hapus collaborator"
              onClick={onRemove}
              tone="danger"
            >
              <Trash2 size={14} />
              <span className="sm:hidden">Hapus</span>
            </ActionButton>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.article>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// BADGES
// =====================================================
export function RoleBadge({ role }: { role: "super_admin" | "member" }) {
  const isSuperAdmin = role === "super_admin";

  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wide",
        isSuperAdmin
          ? "border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-500/10 text-[var(--y-warn)]"
          : "border-indigo-500/20 bg-indigo-500/10 text-[var(--y-primary)]",
      )}
    >
      {isSuperAdmin ? <ShieldCheck size={10} /> : <Shield size={10} />}
      {isSuperAdmin ? "SUPER ADMIN" : "MEMBER"}
    </span>
  );
}

function StatusBadge({
  kind,
  children,
}: {
  kind: "inactive" | "warning";
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wide",
        kind === "warning"
          ? "border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-500/10 text-[var(--y-warn)]"
          : "border-rose-500/25 bg-rose-500/10 text-[var(--y-danger)]",
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

function ActionButton({
  children,
  label,
  onClick,
  tone,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  tone: "neutral" | "warning" | "danger";
}) {
  const toneClass = {
    neutral:
      "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
    warning:
      "border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-500/5 text-[var(--y-warn)] hover:border-amber-500/50 hover:bg-amber-500/10",
    danger:
      "border-rose-500/25 bg-rose-500/5 text-[var(--y-danger)] hover:border-rose-500/50 hover:bg-rose-500/10",
  }[tone];

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      title={label}
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-8 min-w-8 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-all",
        toneClass,
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// INVITE MODAL (existing — tidak diubah)
// =====================================================
function InviteCollaboratorModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  isOwner,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => Promise<void> | void;
  isOwner: boolean;
}) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState<"member" | "super_admin">("member");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<{
    email: string;
    password: string;
    emailDelivery: EmailDeliveryResult;
  } | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [copiedAll, setCopiedAll] = useState(false);
  const [inlineError, setInlineError] = useState<{
    title: string;
    message: string;
    hint?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const reset = () => {
    setEmail("");
    setUsername("");
    setRole("member");
    setCreated(null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setCopiedAll(false);
    setInlineError(null);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (submitting) return;
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setInlineError(null);

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalizedEmail) {
      toast.error("Email collaborator wajib diisi");
      return;
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(normalizedEmail)) {
      setInlineError({
        title: "Format Email Tidak Valid",
        message: "Email tidak sesuai format standar.",
        hint: "Contoh: nama@domain.com",
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const result = await inviteCollaborator({
        email: normalizedEmail,
        username: username.trim() || undefined,
        role,
      });
      setCreated({
        email: result.user.email,
        password: result.temporary_password,
        emailDelivery: result.email_delivery,
      });
      if (result.email_delivery?.sent) {
        toast.success(
          "Collaborator dibuat dan permintaan email diterima oleh Gmail API",
        );
      } else {
        toast.error(
          `Akun dibuat, tetapi email gagal: ${result.email_delivery?.code || "UNKNOWN"} (${result.email_delivery?.stage || "UNKNOWN"}). Kredensial tersedia di dialog ini.`,
        );
      }
      await onSuccess();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const parsed = parseInviteError(err);
      setInlineError(parsed);
      toast.error(parsed.message, { duration: 8000 });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyCredentials = async () => {
    if (!created) return;
    const credentials = [
      `Email: ${created.email}`,
      `Password: ${created.password}`,
      "",
      `Login: ${window.location.origin}`,
      "",
      "Segera ganti password setelah login pertama.",
    ].join("\n");

    const ok = await copyText(credentials, "Kredensial berhasil disalin");
    if (ok) {
      setCopiedAll(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopiedAll(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[998] grid place-items-center overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6"
          style={{
            background: "rgba(15,23,42,0.58)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(5px)",
          }}
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) handleClose();
          }}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.97, opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.97, opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="y-glass-strong relative my-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] w-full max-w-md overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5 shadow-2xl sm:p-6"
            onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="absolute right-3 top-3 grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <X size={17} />
            </button>

            {created ? (
              <div>
                <div className="pr-8 text-center">
                  <div className="mx-auto mb-4 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-[var(--y-success)]">
                    <Check size={27} />
                  </div>
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                    Collaborator ditambahkan
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mb-5 mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                    Simpan kredensial sementara berikut dan berikan kepada
                    anggota yang diundang.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="mb-3 space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-3.5">
                  <div>
                    <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      Email
                    </p>
                    <p className="break-all font-mono text-sm text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      {created.email}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-3">
                    <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                        Password sementara
                      </p>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setShowPassword((current) => !current)
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
                      >
                        {showPassword ? "Sembunyikan" : "Tampilkan"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-mono text-sm font-bold tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      {showPassword ? created.password : "••••••"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "mb-3 rounded-xl border p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed",
                    created.emailDelivery?.sent
                      ? "border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-500/8 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300"
                      : "border-red-500/25 bg-red-500/8 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300",
                  )}
                >
                  <p className="font-bold">
                    {created.emailDelivery?.sent
                      ? "Status email: diterima oleh Gmail API"
                      : `Status email: gagal (${created.emailDelivery?.code || "UNKNOWN"})`}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1">
                    {created.emailDelivery?.message ||
                      "Tidak ada detail dari layanan email."}
                  </p>
                  {created.emailDelivery?.request_id && (
                    <p className="mt-1 break-all font-mono text-[10px] opacity-80">
                      Request ID: {created.emailDelivery.request_id}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/8 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-warn)]">
                  <Info size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                  <p>
                    Anggota wajib mengganti password sementara setelah
                    berhasil login pertama kali.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void handleCopyCredentials()}
                    className="inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
                  >
                    {copiedAll ? (
                      <Check
                        size={15}
                        className="text-[var(--y-success)]"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy size={15} />
                    )}
                    {copiedAll ? "Tersalin" : "Salin kredensial"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleClose}
                    className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white"
                  >
                    Selesai
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="pt-1">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 pr-8">
                  <div className="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-[rgba(249,91,47,0.12)] text-[var(--y-primary)]">
                    <UserPlus size={19} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      Undang collaborator
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                      Anggota baru akan dibuat dengan password sementara dan
                      wajib menggantinya saat login pertama.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {inlineError && (
                  <div
                    className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/8 p-3"
                    role="alert"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <AlertCircle
                        size={15}
                        className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[var(--y-danger)]"
                      />
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                          {inlineError.title}
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                          {inlineError.message}
                        </p>
                        {inlineError.hint && (
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] italic text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                            💡 {inlineError.hint}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setInlineError(null)}
                        className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
                      >
                        <X size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="mb-4 space-y-1.5">
                  <label
                    htmlFor="collaborator-email"
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-dim)]"
                  >
                    Email <span className="text-[var(--y-danger)]">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="collaborator-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="nama@instansi.go.id"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    required
                    autoFocus
                    disabled={submitting}
                    className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3.5 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] focus:border-[var(--y-primary)] disabled:opacity-60"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="mb-4 space-y-1.5">
                  <label
                    htmlFor="collaborator-username"
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-dim)]"
                  >
                    Username{" "}
                    <span className="font-normal normal-case text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      (opsional)
                    </span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="collaborator-username"
                    type="text"
                    value={username}
                    onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Otomatis diambil dari email"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    disabled={submitting}
                    className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3.5 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] focus:border-[var(--y-primary)] disabled:opacity-60"
                  />
                </div>

                <fieldset className="mb-5">
                  <legend className="mb-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                    Role akses
                  </legend>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <RoleOption
                      active={role === "member"}
                      onClick={() => !submitting && setRole("member")}
                      icon={<UserRound size={17} />}
                      label="Member"
                      desc="Upload dan edit dokumen yang ditugaskan."
                      disabled={submitting}
                    />
                    <RoleOption
                      active={role === "super_admin"}
                      onClick={() =>
                        !submitting && isOwner && setRole("super_admin")
                      }
                      icon={<ShieldCheck size={17} />}
                      label="Super Admin"
                      desc="Kelola collaborator dan akun Google Drive."
                      disabled={!isOwner || submitting}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {!isOwner && (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      Hanya owner yang dapat mengundang Super Admin.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </fieldset>

                <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleClose}
                    disabled={submitting}
                    className="inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Batal
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={submitting || !email.trim()}
                    className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition-opacity disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {submitting ? (
                      <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <UserPlus size={15} />
                    )}
                    {submitting ? "Mengundang..." : "Undang collaborator"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

function RoleOption({
  active,
  onClick,
  icon,
  label,
  desc,
  disabled,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  desc: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={cn(
        "flex min-h-[104px] w-full flex-col items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition-all",
        active
          ? "border-[var(--y-primary)] bg-[rgba(249,91,47,0.085)] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--y-primary)]"
          : "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]",
        disabled && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50",
      )}
    >
      <span className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span
          className={cn(
            "text-[var(--y-text-dim)]",
            active && "text-[var(--y-primary)]",
          )}
        >
          {icon}
        </span>
        {active && <Check size={15} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />}
      </span>
      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {desc}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}



===== FILE: src/components/yudit/views/files-view.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/views/files-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Search,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Tags,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
  Inbox,
  Folder,
  ChevronRight,
  Loader2,
  Trash2,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  useYudit,
  categoryCounts,
  availableYears,
  canManageWorkspace,
} from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import {
  CATEGORY_META,
  getCategoryMeta,
  FILE_TYPES,
  MONTHS_ID,
} from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import type { FileItem, Filters } from "@/lib/yudit/types";
import { FileRow } from "../ui/file-row";
import { Dropzone } from "../ui/dropzone";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// Folder types
import type { FolderItem, BreadcrumbItem } from "@/lib/api/folders";

export function FilesView() {
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const customCategories = useYudit((s) => s.customCategories);
  const currentCategory = useYudit((s) => s.currentCategory);
  const setCategory = useYudit((s) => s.setCategory);
  const searchQuery = useYudit((s) => s.searchQuery);
  const setSearch = useYudit((s) => s.setSearch);
  const filters = useYudit((s) => s.filters);
  const setFilters = useYudit((s) => s.setFilters);
  const resetFilters = useYudit((s) => s.resetFilters);
  const filterPanelOpen = useYudit((s) => s.filterPanelOpen);
  const setFilterPanelOpen = useYudit((s) => s.setFilterPanelOpen);
  const setCategoryManagerOpen = useYudit((s) => s.setCategoryManagerOpen);

  const currentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.currentFolderId);
  const fetchFolders = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFolders);
  const filesLoading = useYudit((s) => s.filesLoading);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFolders(currentFolderId).catch(() => {});
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [currentFolderId]);

  const counts = useMemo(() => categoryCounts(files), [files]);
  const years = useMemo(() => availableYears(files), [files]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = [...files];
    if (currentCategory !== "all") {
      list = list.filter((f) => f.category === currentCategory);
    }
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      list = list.filter((f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }
    const f = filters;
    if (f.year) list = list.filter((x) => x.year === f.year);
    if (f.month) list = list.filter((x) => x.month === f.month);
    if (f.date_from)
      list = list.filter(
        (x) => new Date(x.created_at) >= new Date(f.date_from!),
      );
    if (f.date_to)
      list = list.filter(
        (x) => new Date(x.created_at) <= new Date(f.date_to! + "T23:59:59"),
      );
    if (f.file_type) {
      list = list.filter((x) => {
        const ext = (x.name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();
        return ext === f.file_type;
      });
    }
    const sortBy = f.sort_by || "created_at";
    const sortOrder = f.sort_order || "desc";
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let cmp = 0;
      if (sortBy === "name") cmp = a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      else if (sortBy === "size") cmp = a.size - b.size;
      else
        cmp =
          new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime();
      return sortOrder === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return list;
  }, [files, currentCategory, searchQuery, filters]);

  return (
    <div className="y-anim-fade">
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {currentFolderId ? "Folder Contents" : "My Files"}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {filtered.length} file{filtered.length !== 1 && "s"}
            {currentCategory !== "all" && ` • ${currentCategory}`}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Breadcrumb */}
      <FolderBreadcrumb />

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative mb-3">
        <Search
          size={16}
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
        />
        <input
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Cari nama file…"
          className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-all"
        />
        {searchQuery && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setSearch("")}
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={filterPanelOpen}
          onClick={() => setFilterPanelOpen(!filterPanelOpen)}
        >
          <SlidersHorizontal size={14} />
          Filter Lanjutan
          {Object.keys(filters).length > 0 && (
            <span className="ml-1 rounded-full bg-white px-1.5 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-primary)]">
              {
                Object.keys(filters).filter(
                  (k) => k !== "sort_by" && k !== "sort_order",
                ).length
              }
            </span>
          )}
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn onClick={() => setCategoryManagerOpen(true)}>
          <Tags size={14} />
          Kelola Kategori
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          onClick={() => {
            setFilters({});
            setSearch("");
            setCategory("all");
          }}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={14} />
          Refresh
        </ToolbarBtn>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {filterPanelOpen && (
          <FilterPanel
            years={years}
            current={filters}
            onApply={(f) => {
              setFilters(f);
              setFilterPanelOpen(false);
            }}
            onReset={() => {
              resetFilters();
            }}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <ActiveFilters
        filters={filters}
        onRemove={(key) => {
          const next = { ...filters };
          delete (next as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
          setFilters(next);
        }}
        onReset={resetFilters}
      />

      {/* Info banner folder virtual */}
      <FolderInfoBanner />

      {/* Folder grid */}
      <FolderGrid />

      <CategoryTabs
        counts={counts}
        current={currentCategory}
        onSelect={setCategory}
        customCats={customCategories.map((c) => ({
          name: c.name,
          icon: c.icon,
        }))}
      />

      <Dropzone />

      <FileList
        files={filtered}
        emptyCategory={currentCategory}
        loading={filesLoading && files.length === 0}
        currentFolderId={currentFolderId}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   FOLDER INFO BANNER
   ============================================================ */
function FolderInfoBanner() {
  const folders = useYudit((s) => s.folders);
  if (folders.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-2 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.05)] px-3 py-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
      <Info size={13} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      <div>
        <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">
          Folder adalah pengelompokan virtual.
        </b>{" "}
        File yang Anda upload ke folder akan tersimpan di{" "}
        <b>folder bulanan Google Drive</b> (contoh: &quot;November-2026&quot;),
        tetapi tetap terlihat di folder ini pada UI.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   FOLDER BREADCRUMB
   ============================================================ */
function FolderBreadcrumb() {
  const currentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.currentFolderId);
  const breadcrumb = useYudit((s) => s.folderBreadcrumb);
  const setCurrentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.setCurrentFolderId);

  if (!currentFolderId) return null;

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Breadcrumb"
      className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 py-2"
    >
      <button
        onClick={() => setCurrentFolderId(null)}
        className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
      >
        <Folder size={13} />
        My Files
      </button>
      {breadcrumb.map((item, idx) => {
        const isLast = idx === breadcrumb.length - 1;
        return (
          <span
            key={item.id}
            className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1"
          >
            <ChevronRight size={13} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
            <button
              onClick={() => !isLast && setCurrentFolderId(item.id)}
              disabled={isLast}
              className={cn(
                "max-w-[200px] truncate rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[12.5px] font-semibold transition-colors",
                isLast
                  ? "cursor-default text-[var(--y-text)]"
                  : "text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]",
              )}
              title={item.name}
            >
              {item.name}
            </button>
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   FOLDER GRID
   ============================================================ */
function FolderGrid() {
  const folders = useYudit((s) => s.folders);
  const foldersLoading = useYudit((s) => s.foldersLoading);
  const setCurrentFolderId = useYudit((s) => s.setCurrentFolderId);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);
  const deleteFolderAction = useYudit((s) => s.deleteFolderAction);
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);

  const isManager = canManageWorkspace(user);

  if (foldersLoading && folders.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />
        Memuat folder…
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (folders.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-4">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          Folder ({folders.length})
        </h3>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {folders.map((f) => (
          <motion.div
            key={f.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className="group flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-2.5 transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
          >
            <button
              onClick={() => setCurrentFolderId(f.id)}
              className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 text-left"
              title={f.name}
            >
              <div className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]">
                <Folder size={15} className="text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  {f.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  {f.file_count} file
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>
            {isManager && (
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  showConfirm(
                    `Hapus folder "${f.name}"?`,
                    f.file_count > 0
                      ? `Folder masih berisi ${f.file_count} file. Kosongkan folder terlebih dahulu.`
                      : "Folder akan dihapus permanen.",
                    async () => {
                      await deleteFolderAction(f.id);
                    },
                  );
                }}
                className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded text-[var(--y-text-mute)] opacity-0 transition-opacity hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)] group-hover:opacity-100"
                title="Hapus folder"
              >
                <Trash2 size={12} />
              </button>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   FILTER PANEL
   ============================================================ */
function FilterPanel({
  years,
  current,
  onApply,
  onReset,
}: {
  years: string[];
  current: Filters;
  onApply: (f: Filters) => void;
  onReset: () => void;
}) {
  const [year, setYear] = useState(
    current.year ? String(current.year) : "",
  );
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(
    current.month ? String(current.month) : "",
  );
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState(current.date_from || "");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState(current.date_to || "");
  const [fileType, setFileType] = useState(current.file_type || "");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState(
    current.sort_by && current.sort_order
      ? `${current.sort_by}:${current.sort_order}`
      : "created_at:desc",
  );

  const apply = () => {
    const f: Filters = {};
    if (year) f.year = parseInt(year);
    if (month) f.month = parseInt(month);
    if (dateFrom) f.date_from = dateFrom;
    if (dateTo) f.date_to = dateTo;
    if (fileType) f.file_type = fileType;
    if (sort) {
      const [by, order] = sort.split(":");
      f.sort_by = by as Filters["sort_by"];
      f.sort_order = order as Filters["sort_order"];
    }
    onApply(f);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
      className="mb-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] shadow-sm"
    >
      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
          <FilterGroup label="Tahun">
            <FilterSelect value={year} onChange={setYear}>
              <option value="">Semua Tahun</option>
              {years.map((y) => (
                <option key={y} value={y}>
                  {y}
                </option>
              ))}
            </FilterSelect>
          </FilterGroup>
          <FilterGroup label="Bulan">
            <FilterSelect value={month} onChange={setMonth}>
              <option value="">Semua Bulan</option>
              {MONTHS_ID.map((m, i) => (
                <option key={i} value={String(i + 1)}>
                  {m}
                </option>
              ))}
            </FilterSelect>
          </FilterGroup>
          <FilterGroup label="Tipe File">
            <FilterSelect value={fileType} onChange={setFileType}>
              <option value="">Semua Tipe</option>
              {FILE_TYPES.map((t) => (
                <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>
                  {t.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </FilterSelect>
          </FilterGroup>
          <FilterGroup label="Dari Tanggal">
            <FilterInput type="date" value={dateFrom} onChange={setDateFrom} />
          </FilterGroup>
          <FilterGroup label="Sampai Tanggal">
            <FilterInput type="date" value={dateTo} onChange={setDateTo} />
          </FilterGroup>
          <FilterGroup label="Urutkan">
            <FilterSelect value={sort} onChange={setSort}>
              <option value="created_at:desc">Terbaru</option>
              <option value="created_at:asc">Terlama</option>
              <option value="name:asc">Nama A-Z</option>
              <option value="name:desc">Nama Z-A</option>
              <option value="size:desc">Ukuran Terbesar</option>
              <option value="size:asc">Ukuran Terkecil</option>
            </FilterSelect>
          </FilterGroup>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-3">
          <button
            onClick={onReset}
            className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          >
            Reset
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={apply}
            className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white"
          >
            Terapkan
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function FilterGroup({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5">
      <label className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterSelect({
  value,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <select
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
    >
      {children}
    </select>
  );
}

function FilterInput({
  type,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  type: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <input
      type={type}
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      className="y-focus h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text)] outline-none"
    />
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   ACTIVE FILTERS
   ============================================================ */
function ActiveFilters({
  filters,
  onRemove,
  onReset,
}: {
  filters: Filters;
  onRemove: (key: string) => void;
  onReset: () => void;
}) {
  const items: { key: string; label: string }[] = [];
  if (filters.year)
    items.push({ key: "year", label: `Tahun: ${filters.year}` });
  if (filters.month)
    items.push({
      key: "month",
      label: `Bulan: ${MONTHS_ID[filters.month - 1]}`,
    });
  if (filters.date_from)
    items.push({ key: "date_from", label: `Dari: ${filters.date_from}` });
  if (filters.date_to)
    items.push({ key: "date_to", label: `Sampai: ${filters.date_to}` });
  if (filters.file_type)
    items.push({
      key: "file_type",
      label: `Tipe: ${filters.file_type.toUpperCase()}`,
    });

  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
      {items.map((it) => (
        <div
          key={it.key}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--y-primary)] px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white"
        >
          {it.label}
          <button
            onClick={() => onRemove(it.key)}
            className="grid h-4 w-4 place-items-center rounded-full hover:bg-black/20"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
      <button
        onClick={onReset}
        className="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
      >
        Hapus Semua
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   CATEGORY TABS
   ============================================================ */
function CategoryTabs({
  counts,
  current,
  onSelect,
  customCats,
}: {
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  current: string;
  onSelect: (cat: string) => void;
  customCats: { name: string; icon: string }[];
}) {
  const totalCount = Object.values(counts).reduce((s, n) => s + n, 0);

  const tabs: { name: string; icon: string; count: number }[] = [];
  customCats.forEach((c) => {
    const cnt = counts[c.name] || 0;
    if (cnt > 0) tabs.push({ name: c.name, icon: c.icon, count: cnt });
  });

  const PRIORITY = Object.keys(CATEGORY_META);
  PRIORITY.forEach((name) => {
    const cnt = counts[name] || 0;
    if (cnt > 0) {
      const meta = getCategoryMeta(name, customCats);
      tabs.push({ name, icon: meta.icon, count: cnt });
    }
  });

  return (
    <div className="mb-4 w-full min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1.5 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
        <CatTab
          active={current === "all"}
          icon="📂"
          label="Semua"
          count={totalCount}
          onClick={() => onSelect("all")}
        />
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <CatTab
            key={t.name}
            active={current === t.name}
            icon={t.icon}
            label={t.name}
            count={t.count}
            onClick={() => onSelect(t.name)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CatTab({
  active,
  icon,
  label,
  count,
  onClick,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  count: number;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all",
        active
          ? "y-glow-primary border-transparent bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--y-primary)] to-[var(--y-accent)] text-white"
          : "border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
      )}
    >
      <span>{icon}</span>
      <span className="max-w-[140px] truncate">{label}</span>
      <span
        className={cn(
          "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold tabular-nums",
          active ? "bg-white/25" : "bg-[var(--y-bg-elev-2)]",
        )}
      >
        {count}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   FILE LIST
   ============================================================ */
const GRID_COLS_MOBILE = "44px minmax(0,1fr) auto";
const GRID_COLS_TABLET = "44px minmax(0,1fr) 80px 140px";
const GRID_COLS_DESKTOP = "44px minmax(0,1fr) 100px 160px 200px";

function FileList({
  files,
  emptyCategory,
  loading,
  currentFolderId,
}: {
  files: FileItem[];
  emptyCategory: string;
  loading: boolean;
  currentFolderId: string | null;
}) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] py-16 shadow-sm">
        <Loader2 size={28} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (files.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] py-16 text-center shadow-sm">
        <div className="grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]">
          <Inbox size={28} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {emptyCategory !== "all"
            ? `Belum ada file kategori "${emptyCategory}"`
            : currentFolderId
              ? "Folder ini masih kosong"
              : "Belum ada file"}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          Upload file untuk memulai
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-2 shadow-sm">
      <div
        className="hidden items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)] sm:grid"
        style={{ gridTemplateColumns: GRID_COLS_TABLET }}
      >
        <div className="text-center">Tipe</div>
        <div>Nama</div>
        <div className="text-right">Ukuran</div>
        <div className="text-right">Aksi</div>
      </div>

      <div
        className="hidden items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)] lg:grid"
        style={{ gridTemplateColumns: GRID_COLS_DESKTOP }}
      >
        <div className="text-center">Tipe</div>
        <div>Nama</div>
        <div className="text-right">Ukuran</div>
        <div>Kategori</div>
        <div className="text-right">Aksi</div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        {files.map((f, i) => (
          <FileRow key={f.id} file={f} index={i} showFolder={false} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export const FILE_GRID = {
  mobile: GRID_COLS_MOBILE,
  tablet: GRID_COLS_TABLET,
  desktop: GRID_COLS_DESKTOP,
};
