// src/components/yudit/views/stats-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Files,
  HardDrive,
  CalendarRange,
  FileBox,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";

import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { getStats, type StatsResponse } from "@/lib/api/files";
import { formatBytes, MONTHS_SHORT, getCategoryMeta } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";

export function StatsView() {
  const customCats = useYudit((s) => s.customCategories);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<StatsResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useMemo(
    () => async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const s = await getStats();
        setStats(s);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  if (loading || !stats) {
    return (
      <div className="grid place-items-center py-20">
        <Loader2 size={28} className="animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const cards = [
    {
      label: "Total File",
      value: String(stats.total_files),
      sub: "Semua file terupload",
      Icon: Files,
      color: "#6366f1",
      bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Total Ukuran",
      value: formatBytes(stats.total_size),
      sub: "Kapasitas terpakai",
      Icon: HardDrive,
      color: "#22d3ee",
      bg: "rgba(34,211,238,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Tahun Aktif",
      value: String(Object.keys(stats.by_year).length),
      sub: "Tahun dengan file",
      Icon: CalendarRange,
      color: "#10b981",
      bg: "rgba(16,185,129,0.12)",
    },
    {
      label: "Tipe File",
      value: String(Object.keys(stats.by_type).length),
      sub: "Format berbeda",
      Icon: FileBox,
      color: "#f59e0b",
      bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.12)",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="y-anim-fade">
      <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            Statistik &amp; Analytics
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            Overview penggunaan storage &amp; dokumen
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={load}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={15} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mb-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {cards.map((c, i) => (
          <motion.div
            key={c.label}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }}
            className="group rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-4 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.4)]"
          >
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                {c.label}
              </span>
              <div
                className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
                style={{ background: c.bg }}
              >
                <c.Icon size={15} style={{ color: c.color }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="y-gradient-text mb-1 text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">
              {c.value}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">{c.sub}</div>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <ChartCard
          title="Distribusi Per Bulan"
          icon="📅"
          entries={Object.entries(stats.by_month)
            .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
            .slice(-8)}
          labelFn={(k) => {
            const [y, m] = k.split("-");
            return `${MONTHS_SHORT[parseInt(m) - 1]} ${y}`;
          }}
        />
        <ChartCard
          title="Distribusi Per Kategori"
          icon="🏷️"
          entries={Object.entries(stats.by_category).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])}
          labelFn={(k) => k}
          colored
          customCats={customCats.map((c) => ({ name: c.name, icon: c.icon }))}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <ChartCard
          title="Distribusi Per Tipe File"
          icon="📄"
          entries={Object.entries(stats.by_type).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])}
          labelFn={(k) => k.toUpperCase()}
          full
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ChartCard({
  title,
  icon,
  entries,
  labelFn,
  colored,
  customCats,
  full,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  entries: [string, number][];
  labelFn: (k: string) => string;
  colored?: boolean;
  customCats?: { name: string; icon: string }[];
  full?: boolean;
}) {
  const max = entries.length ? Math.max(...entries.map((e) => e[1])) : 1;

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5"
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-base">{icon}</span>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">{title}</h3>
        <span className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <TrendingUp size={12} />
          {entries.length} item
        </span>
      </div>
      {entries.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          Belum ada data
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          {entries.slice(0, 12).map(([key, count], i) => {
            const pct = max > 0 ? (count / max) * 100 : 0;
            const label = labelFn(key);
            const meta = colored ? getCategoryMeta(key, customCats || []) : null;
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={key}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.04 }}
                className="flex items-center gap-3"
              >
                <div
                  className="w-32 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]"
                  title={label}
                >
                  {meta && <span className="mr-1">{meta.icon}</span>}
                  {label}
                </div>
                <div className="relative h-6 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
                  <motion.div
                    className="flex h-full items-center justify-end rounded-md pr-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-white"
                    style={{
                      background: meta
                        ? `linear-gradient(90deg, ${meta.color}, ${meta.color}cc)`
                        : "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))",
                    }}
                    initial={{ width: 0 }}
                    animate={{ width: `${Math.max(pct, 10)}%` }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: i * 0.04, ease: "easeOut" }}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </motion.div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/views/login-view.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/views/login-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Cloud, Mail, Lock, User as UserIcon, ArrowRight, Loader2,
  Search, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Send, ShieldCheck, Crown, UserRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import {
  checkAccount,
  type AccountCheckAccount,
} from "@/lib/api/auth";

type Tab = "login" | "register" | "check";

// =====================================================
// MAIN
// =====================================================
export function LoginView() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("login");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Cek akun state
  const [checkEmail, setCheckEmail] = useState("");
  const [checkLoading, setCheckLoading] = useState(false);
  const [checkResult, setCheckResult] = useState<{
    found: boolean;
    accounts: AccountCheckAccount[];
    email_sent?: boolean;
    message: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const login = useYudit((s) => s.login);
  const register = useYudit((s) => s.register);

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !password || loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email, password);
    } catch (error: any) {
      const detail = error?.detail || error?.message || "";
      if (detail.includes("dinonaktifkan")) {
        toast.error(
          "Akun Anda dinonaktifkan. Hubungi owner workspace untuk mengaktifkan kembali.",
          { duration: 6000 },
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !password || !username || loading) return;
    if (password.length < 8) {
      toast.error("Password minimal 8 karakter");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await register(email, username, password);
    } catch (error: any) {
      const detail =
        error instanceof ApiError
          ? error.detail
          : error?.detail || error?.message || "";
      const detailLower = String(detail).toLowerCase();

      if (
        detailLower.includes("email sudah terdaftar") ||
        detailLower.includes("email already")
      ) {
        toast.error(
          "Email ini sudah terdaftar. Silakan login atau gunakan email lain.",
          { duration: 6000 },
        );
        setTimeout(() => {
          setTab("login");
          setPassword("");
        }, 1500);
        return;
      }
      if (
        detailLower.includes("username sudah dipakai") ||
        detailLower.includes("username already")
      ) {
        toast.error("Username sudah dipakai. Coba username lain.", {
          duration: 6000,
        });
        return;
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle check account
  const handleCheckAccount = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!checkEmail.trim() || checkLoading) return;

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(checkEmail.trim())) {
      toast.error("Format email tidak valid");
      return;
    }

    setCheckLoading(true);
    setCheckResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await checkAccount(checkEmail);
      setCheckResult(res);
      if (res.found) {
        toast.success(
          res.email_sent
            ? "Info akun telah dikirim ke email tersebut"
            : "Akun ditemukan (email gagal dikirim, hubungi admin)",
          { duration: 5000 },
        );
      } else {
        toast.info("Tidak ada akun aktif dengan email tersebut", {
          duration: 5000,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 429) {
        toast.error(
          "Terlalu banyak percobaan. Tunggu beberapa menit sebelum coba lagi.",
          { duration: 6000 },
        );
      } else {
        toast.error(
          error?.detail || "Gagal memeriksa akun. Coba lagi.",
          { duration: 5000 },
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setCheckLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="yudit-ambient relative grid min-h-screen place-items-center overflow-hidden p-5">
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -left-20 top-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-30 blur-3xl"
        style={{
          background:
            "radial-gradient(circle, var(--y-primary), transparent 70%)",
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-20 bottom-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-25 blur-3xl"
        style={{
          background:
            "radial-gradient(circle, var(--y-accent), transparent 70%)",
        }}
      />

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="y-glass-strong y-glow-soft relative z-10 w-full max-w-[460px] rounded-3xl border border-[var(--y-border)] p-8"
      >
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col items-center">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.8, rotate: -8 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, rotate: 0 }}
            transition={{
              type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 15, delay: 0.1,
            }}
            className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary mb-4 grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl"
          >
            <Cloud size={32} className="text-white" fill="currentColor" />
          </motion.div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--y-text)]">
            DPRD<span className="y-gradient-text">Cloud</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-center text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            Satu cloud virtual, banyak Google Drive di belakangnya
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="mb-6 flex gap-1 rounded-xl bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-1">
          {(
            [
              { key: "login", label: "Masuk" },
              { key: "register", label: "Daftar" },
              { key: "check", label: "Cek Akun" },
            ] as { key: Tab; label: string }[]
          ).map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
              className="relative flex-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold transition-colors"
              style={{
                color: tab === t.key ? "var(--y-text)" : "var(--y-text-dim)",
              }}
            >
              {tab === t.key && (
                <motion.div
                  layoutId="auth-tab"
                  className="absolute inset-0 rounded-lg bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] shadow-sm"
                  style={{ border: "1px solid var(--y-border-soft)" }}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 350, damping: 30 }}
                />
              )}
              <span className="relative z-10">{t.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          {tab === "login" && (
            <motion.form
              key="login"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
              onSubmit={handleLogin}
              className="space-y-4"
            >
              <Field
                icon={<Mail size={16} />}
                label="Email"
                type="email"
                placeholder="kamu@example.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={setEmail}
                autoComplete="email"
              />
              <Field
                icon={<Lock size={16} />}
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={setPassword}
                autoComplete="current-password"
              />
              <SubmitButton label="Masuk" loading={loading} />
            </motion.form>
          )}

          {tab === "register" && (
            <motion.form
              key="register"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
              onSubmit={handleRegister}
              className="space-y-4"
            >
              <Field
                icon={<UserIcon size={16} />}
                label="Username"
                type="text"
                placeholder="username"
                value={username}
                onChange={setUsername}
                autoComplete="username"
              />
              <Field
                icon={<Mail size={16} />}
                label="Email"
                type="email"
                placeholder="kamu@example.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={setEmail}
                autoComplete="email"
              />
              <Field
                icon={<Lock size={16} />}
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                placeholder="min 8 karakter"
                value={password}
                onChange={setPassword}
                autoComplete="new-password"
              />
              <SubmitButton label="Daftar" loading={loading} />
            </motion.form>
          )}

          {tab === "check" && (
            <motion.div
              key="check"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            >
              <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.2)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.06)] p-3 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)]">
                  <Send size={12} />
                  Lupa Akun?
                </div>
                Masukkan email Anda. Jika terdaftar, kami akan mengirim info
                akun (username, role, workspace owner) ke email tersebut.
                <b className="mt-1 block text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Password TIDAK akan dikirim via email.
                </b>
              </div>

              <form onSubmit={handleCheckAccount} className="space-y-4">
                <Field
                  icon={<Mail size={16} />}
                  label="Email Terdaftar"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="kamu@example.com"
                  value={checkEmail}
                  onChange={setCheckEmail}
                  autoComplete="email"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={checkLoading || !checkEmail.trim()}
                  className={cn(
                    "y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary group relative flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all",
                    "hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-70 disabled:hover:translate-y-0",
                  )}
                >
                  {checkLoading ? (
                    <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Search size={16} />
                      <span>Cek & Kirim Info Akun</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </form>

              {/* Result */}
              {checkResult && (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  className="mt-4"
                >
                  {!checkResult.found ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.06)] p-3">
                      <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                        <XCircle size={14} />
                        Tidak Ada Akun
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                        {checkResult.message}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(16,185,129,0.3)] bg-[rgba(16,185,129,0.06)] p-3">
                        <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-[#10b981]" />
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#10b981]">
                            {checkResult.accounts.length} Akun Terdaftar
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
                            {checkResult.email_sent
                              ? "Info akun telah dikirim ke email Anda"
                              : "Email gagal dikirim — hubungi admin"}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        {checkResult.accounts.map((acc, i) => (
                          <AccountCard key={i} account={acc} />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Footer hint */}
        <div className="mt-5 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {tab === "login" && (
            <>
              Belum punya akun?{" "}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab("register")}
                className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
              >
                Daftar
              </button>
              {" · "}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab("check")}
                className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
              >
                Lupa Akun?
              </button>
            </>
          )}
          {tab === "register" && (
            <>
              Sudah punya akun?{" "}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab("login")}
                className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
              >
                Masuk
              </button>
            </>
          )}
          {tab === "check" && (
            <>
              Sudah ingat?{" "}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab("login")}
                className="font-semibold text-[var(--y-primary)] hover:underline"
              >
                Masuk
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AccountCard({ account }: { account: AccountCheckAccount }) {
  const roleMeta = {
    owner: {
      label: "Owner",
      icon: Crown,
      color: "#ef4444",
      bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)",
    },
    super_admin: {
      label: "Super Admin",
      icon: ShieldCheck,
      color: "#f59e0b",
      bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.1)",
    },
    member: {
      label: "Member",
      icon: UserRound,
      color: "#6366f1",
      bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.1)",
    },
  }[account.role] ?? {
    label: account.role,
    icon: UserRound,
    color: "#6366f1",
    bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.1)",
  };

  const Icon = roleMeta.icon;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] p-2.5">
      <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
        <div
          className="grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg"
          style={{ background: roleMeta.bg, color: roleMeta.color }}
        >
          <Icon size={13} />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {account.username}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
            {roleMeta.label}
            {account.workspace_owner_email && (
              <>
                {" · "}
                <span className="truncate">
                  Owner: {account.workspace_owner_email}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {account.role_permission_summary}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// FIELD
// =====================================================
function Field({
  icon, label, type, placeholder, value, onChange, autoComplete,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  type: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  autoComplete?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div className="group relative">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-colors group-focus-within:text-[var(--y-primary)]">
          {icon}
        </div>
        <input
          type={type}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          required
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-all"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =====================================================
// SUBMIT BUTTON
// =====================================================
function SubmitButton({ label, loading }: { label: string; loading: boolean }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={loading}
      className={cn(
        "y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary group relative flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all",
        "hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-70 disabled:hover:translate-y-0",
      )}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
      ) : (
        <>
          <span className="relative z-10">{label}</span>
          <ArrowRight
            size={16}
            className="relative z-10 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5"
          />
        </>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

function isDocxFile(name: string): boolean {
  return extOf(name) === "docx";
}

export function MyTasksView() {
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const openEditor = useYudit((s) => s.openEditor);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);

  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<DocumentAssignment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // State untuk modal editor
  const [editingFile, setEditingFile] = useState<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    googleDocId?: string | null;
    mode: EditorMode;
  } | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await myAssignments();
      setAssignments(res);
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.detail || "Gagal memuat tugas");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const isExpired = (a: DocumentAssignment) => {
    if (!a.expires_at) return false;
    return new Date(a.expires_at) < new Date();
  };

  const handleOpenEditor = (
    file: NonNullable<DocumentAssignment["file"]>,
    mode: EditorMode,
  ) => {
    setEditingFile({
      id: file.id,
      name: file.name,
      googleDocId: file.google_doc_id,
      mode,
    });
  };

  const handleCloseEditor = () => {
    setEditingFile(null);
    fetchFiles(); // refresh list file utama
    load(); // refresh list tugas ini (jika ada perubahan)

===== FILE: src/components/yudit/views/monthly-view.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronsUpDown,
  Search,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useYudit, groupByFolder } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { MONTHS_ID, formatBytes } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import type { FileItem } from "@/lib/yudit/types";
import { FileRow } from "../ui/file-row";

export function MonthlyView() {
  const files = useYudit((s) => s.files);
  const search = useYudit((s) => s.monthlySearchQuery);
  const setSearch = useYudit((s) => s.setMonthlySearch);
  const expanded = useYudit((s) => s.expandedMonthly);
  const toggle = useYudit((s) => s.toggleMonthly);
  const collapseAll = useYudit((s) => s.collapseAllMonthly);
  const expandAll = useYudit((s) => s.expandAllMonthly);

  const grouped = useMemo(() => groupByFolder(files), [files]);

  const sortedKeys = useMemo(() => {
    const parseKey = (s: string) => {
      if (s.includes("Tanpa Folder")) return 0;
      const cleaned = s.replace("📅 ", "");
      const parts = cleaned.split(" ");
      const m = parts[0];
      const y = parseInt(parts[1] || "0");
      const mi = MONTHS_ID.indexOf(m);
      return y * 100 + (mi >= 0 ? mi + 1 : 0);
    };
    return Object.keys(grouped).sort((a, b) => parseKey(b) - parseKey(a));
  }, [grouped]);

  const filteredKeys = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return sortedKeys;
    return sortedKeys.filter((k) => {
      if (k.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      return grouped[k].some((f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [sortedKeys, grouped, search]);

  const totalFiles = filteredKeys.reduce(
    (s, k) =>
      s + grouped[k].filter((f) => matchSearch(f.name, k, search)).length,
    0,
  );

  const anyExpanded = Object.values(expanded).some(Boolean);

  return (
    <div className="y-anim-fade">
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            Arsip Per Bulan
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {filteredKeys.length} folder • {totalFiles} file
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => (anyExpanded ? collapseAll() : expandAll())}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
        >
          <ChevronsUpDown size={15} />
          {anyExpanded ? "Lipat Semua" : "Buka Semua"}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <Search
          size={16}
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)]"
        />
        <input
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Cari di semua folder bulanan…"
          className="y-focus h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-[var(--y-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--y-text-mute)] transition-all"
        />
        {search && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setSearch("")}
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--y-text-mute)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {filteredKeys.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState search={search} />
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {filteredKeys.map((key, idx) => {
            const allFiles = grouped[key];
            const files = search
              ? allFiles.filter(
                  (f) =>
                    f.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
                    key.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()),
                )
              : allFiles;
            if (files.length === 0) return null;
            const totalSize = files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0);
            const isOpen = expanded[key] ?? (idx === 0 && !search);
            return (
              <MonthlyGroup
                key={key}
                name={key}
                count={files.length}
                totalSize={totalSize}
                isOpen={!!isOpen}
                onToggle={() => toggle(key)}
                files={files}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function matchSearch(name: string, folder: string, q: string) {
  if (!q) return true;
  const ql = q.toLowerCase();
  return name.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || folder.toLowerCase().includes(ql);
}

function MonthlyGroup({
  name,
  count,
  totalSize,
  isOpen,
  onToggle,
  files,
}: {
  name: string;
  count: number;
  totalSize: number;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  files: FileItem[];
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] transition-colors hover:border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)]"
    >
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border-soft)] px-4 py-3.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.06)]"
        style={{
          background: isOpen
            ? "linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.08), transparent)"
            : undefined,
        }}
      >
        <motion.span
          animate={{ rotate: isOpen ? 90 : 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        >
          <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
        </motion.span>
        <div className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]">
          <CalendarDays size={17} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
        </div>
        <span className="flex-1 truncate text-[15px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
          {name}
        </span>
        <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          {count} file • {formatBytes(totalSize)}
        </span>
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 p-2">
              {files.map((f, i) => (
                <FileRow
                  key={f.id}
                  file={f}
                  index={i}
                  showFolder={false}
                  alwaysShowActions
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ search }: { search: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] py-16 text-center shadow-sm">
      <div className="grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]">
        <CalendarDays size={28} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
        {search ? "Tidak ada hasil" : "Belum ada arsip bulanan"}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        {search
          ? `Pencarian "${search}" tidak ditemukan`
          : "Upload file untuk mulai mengorganisir per bulan"}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/views/drives-view.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/views/drives-view.tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Mail,
  CheckCircle2,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  Shield,
  HardDrive,
  Users,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useYudit, canManageWorkspace } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { formatBytes, formatDate } from "@/lib/yudit/utils";
import { connectGoogleDrive } from "@/lib/api/oauth";
import { forceRefreshQuota, disconnectDrive } from "@/lib/api/drives";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type { DriveAccount } from "@/lib/yudit/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const MAX_DRIVES: number | null = null;

// =====================================================
// ⭐ MAIN COMPONENT — read-only untuk member
// =====================================================
export function DrivesView() {
  const user = useYudit((s) => s.user);
  const drives = useYudit((s) => s.drives);
  const pool = useYudit((s) => s.pool);
  const fetchDrives = useYudit((s) => s.fetchDrives);
  const fetchFiles = useYudit((s) => s.fetchFiles);
  const showConfirm = useYudit((s) => s.showConfirm);

  const [connecting, setConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ⭐ canManage = full access; member = read-only
  const canManage = canManageWorkspace(user);
  const canConnect = canManage && (MAX_DRIVES === null || drives.length < MAX_DRIVES);

  const handleConnect = async () => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa connect Google Drive");
      return;
    }
    if (!canConnect) {
      toast.error(`Maksimal ${MAX_DRIVES} akun Google Drive`);
      return;
    }
    setConnecting(true);
    try {
      const res = await connectGoogleDrive();
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchDrives();
        await fetchFiles();
        toast.success("Akun Google Drive terhubung");
      } else if (res.error === "duplicate_account") {
        toast.error("Akun ini sudah terhubung");
      } else if (res.error === "max_accounts") {
        toast.error("Maksimal akun sudah tercapai");
      } else if (res.error === "forbidden") {
        toast.error(
          "Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa connect Google Drive",
        );
      } else if (res.error && res.error !== "cancelled") {
        toast.error(`Gagal connect: ${res.error}`);
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Gagal connect";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setConnecting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRefreshQuota = async () => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa refresh quota");
      return;
    }
    if (refreshing) return;
    setRefreshing(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading("Refreshing quota semua drive…");
    try {
      await forceRefreshQuota();
      await fetchDrives();
      toast.success("Quota berhasil di-refresh", { id: toastId });
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Gagal refresh quota";
      toast.error(msg, { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemove = async (drive: DriveAccount) => {
    if (!canManage) {
      toast.error("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa hapus drive");
      return;
    }
    if (deletingId) return;
    setDeletingId(drive.id);

    try {
      try {
        const res = await disconnectDrive(drive.id, false);
        toast.success(
          res.message || `Akun Drive ${drive.google_email} dihapus`,
        );
        await fetchDrives();
        await fetchFiles();
        return;
      } catch (e: unknown) {
        const err = e as ApiError;
        const detail = err?.detail || err?.message || "";
        const isForceRequired =
          err?.status === 400 &&
          detail.toLowerCase().includes("force");

        if (!isForceRequired) {
          throw e;
        }

        showConfirm(
          "Drive Masih Berisi File",
          detail,
          async () => {
            try {
              const res2 = await disconnectDrive(drive.id, true);
              toast.success(res2.message || "Akun Drive dihapus");
              await fetchDrives();
              await fetchFiles();
            } catch (err2: unknown) {
              const e2 = err2 as ApiError;
              toast.error(e2?.detail || "Gagal hapus drive");
            } finally {
              setDeletingId(null);
            }
          },
        );
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as ApiError;
      toast.error(err?.detail || "Gagal hapus drive");
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => {
        setDeletingId((prev) => (prev === drive.id ? null : prev));
      }, 100);
    }
  };

  const pct = pool.total > 0 ? Math.round((pool.used / pool.total) * 100) : 0;

  const activeDrives = drives.filter((d) => d.is_active).length;
  const inactiveDrives = drives.length - activeDrives;
  const accountsText = MAX_DRIVES
    ? `${drives.length} dari ${MAX_DRIVES} akun terhubung`
    : `${drives.length} akun terhubung`;

  return (
    <div className="y-anim-fade">
      {/* Header — tombol Refresh/Connect HANYA untuk manager */}
      <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            Google Drive Accounts
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {accountsText} • {formatBytes(pool.used)} dari{" "}
            {formatBytes(pool.total)} terpakai
          </p>
        </div>
        {canManage && (
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleRefreshQuota}
              disabled={refreshing || drives.length === 0}
              title="Refresh quota dari Google"
              className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-all hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {refreshing ? (
                <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <RefreshCw size={15} />
              )}
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh Quota</span>
            </button>
            {canConnect && (
              <button
                onClick={handleConnect}
                disabled={connecting}
                className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-70"
              >
                {connecting ? (
                  <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Plus size={16} />
                )}
                Hubungkan Drive
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ⭐ Info banner untuk member */}
      {!canManage && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.06)] p-4">
          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.15)]">
            <Info size={16} className="text-[var(--y-primary)]" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">Mode read-only.</b> Hanya
            owner/super admin yang bisa menambah atau menghapus akun Google
            Drive. Anda bisa lihat statistik & kapasitas pool di sini.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Stats summary */}
      {drives.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <StatChip
            icon={<HardDrive size={14} />}
            label="Total Drive"
            value={String(drives.length)}
            color="#6366f1"
          />
          <StatChip
            icon={<CheckCircle2 size={14} />}
            label="Aktif"
            value={`${activeDrives}${inactiveDrives > 0 ? ` / ${drives.length}` : ""}`}
            color="#10b981"
          />
          <StatChip
            icon={<Users size={14} />}
            label="Storage"
            value={formatBytes(pool.total)}
            color="#22d3ee"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pool bar */}
      <div className="mb-5 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-4">
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            Total Storage Pool • {drives.length} akun
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--y-accent)] tabular-nums">
            {pct}%
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
          <motion.div
            className="h-full rounded-full"
            style={{
              background:
                "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))",
            }}
            initial={{ width: 0 }}
            animate={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: "easeOut" }}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          <span className="tabular-nums">
            {formatBytes(pool.used)} terpakai
          </span>
          <span className="tabular-nums">
            {formatBytes(pool.free)} tersisa
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Empty state */}
      {drives.length === 0 && !connecting && (
        <div className="mb-5 grid place-items-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] py-16 text-center">
          <div className="mb-3 grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)]">
            <HardDrive size={28} className="text-[var(--y-text-mute)]" />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-1 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            Belum ada akun Google Drive
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 max-w-sm text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {canManage
              ? "Hubungkan akun Google Drive pertama Anda untuk mulai menyimpan file di YuditCloud."
              : "Owner workspace belum menghubungkan akun Google Drive."}
          </div>
          {canManage && (
            <button
              onClick={handleConnect}
              disabled={connecting}
              className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:opacity-70"
            >
              {connecting ? (
                <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Plus size={16} />
              )}
              Hubungkan Google Drive
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Drive grid */}
      {drives.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {drives.map((d, i) => {
            const dpct =
              d.quota_total > 0
                ? Math.min(
                    100,
                    Math.round((d.quota_used / d.quota_total) * 100),
                  )
                : 0;
            const isDeleting = deletingId === d.id;
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={d.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={{ delay: Math.min(i * 0.03, 0.3) }}
                className={cn(
                  "group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-5 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]",
                  d.is_active
                    ? "border-[var(--y-border)] hover:border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.4)]"
                    : "border-[rgba(239,68,68,0.3)]",
                  isDeleting && "pointer-events-none opacity-60",
                )}
              >
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[3px] opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"
                  style={{
                    background: d.is_active
                      ? "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))"
                      : "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-danger), var(--y-warn))",
                  }}
                />

                {/* ⭐ Tombol delete HANYA untuk manager */}
                {canManage && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleRemove(d)}
                    disabled={isDeleting}
                    title="Hapus drive"
                    className="absolute right-3 top-3 grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-mute)] opacity-100 transition-all hover:bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] hover:text-[var(--y-danger)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100"
                  >
                    {isDeleting ? (
                      <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Trash2 size={14} />
                    )}
                  </button>
                )}

                {/* Header */}
                <div className="mb-3.5 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-white">
                    <GDriveLogo />
                  </div>
                  <div className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1", canManage && "pr-6")}>
                    <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                      {d.google_email}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                      <span className="rounded bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-semibold">
                        Slot #{d.slot_index}
                      </span>
                      {d.is_active ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--y-success)]">
                          <CheckCircle2 size={11} />
                          aktif
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                          <AlertCircle size={11} />
                          token invalid
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Warning */}
                {!d.is_active && (
                  <div className="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.08)] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-danger)]">
                    ⚠️ Refresh token Google Drive ini sudah revoked.
                    {canManage
                      ? " Reconnect akun untuk mengaktifkan kembali."
                      : " Owner perlu reconnect akun."}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Progress bar */}
                <div className="mb-2 h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--y-bg)]">
                  <motion.div
                    className="h-full rounded-full"
                    style={{
                      background:
                        dpct > 80
                          ? "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-warn), var(--y-danger))"
                          : "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--y-primary), var(--y-accent))",
                    }}
                    initial={{ width: 0 }}
                    animate={{ width: `${dpct}%` }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.8 }}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-dim)] tabular-nums">
                  <span>{formatBytes(d.quota_used)} terpakai</span>
                  <span>{formatBytes(d.quota_total)} total</span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-1 text-[10.5px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  {formatBytes(Math.max(0, d.quota_total - d.quota_used))}{" "}
                  bebas • {dpct}% terpakai
                </div>

                {d.quota_updated_at && (
                  <div className="mt-2 border-t border-[var(--y-border-soft)] pt-2 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                    Quota diperbarui {formatDate(d.quota_updated_at)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}

          {/* ⭐ Add drive card HANYA untuk manager */}
          {canConnect && (
            <motion.button
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: Math.min(drives.length * 0.03, 0.3) }}
              onClick={handleConnect}
              disabled={connecting}
              className={cn(
                "group grid min-h-[220px] place-items-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--y-border)] p-6 text-center transition-all",
                "hover:border-[var(--y-primary)] hover:bg-[rgba(99,102,241,0.05)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60",
              )}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="mx-auto mb-3 grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] text-[var(--y-primary)] transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">
                  {connecting ? (
                    <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Plus size={22} />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
                  Hubungkan Google Drive
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
                  {MAX_DRIVES
                    ? `Slot ${drives.length + 1} dari ${MAX_DRIVES}`
                    : "Tambah akun (tidak terbatas)"}
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Info cards */}
      <div className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.05)] p-4">
        <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]">
          <Mail size={16} className="text-[var(--y-accent)]" />
        </div>
        <div className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">Storage pool tak terbatas.</b>{" "}
          Semua akun Google Drive digabungkan menjadi satu cloud virtual. File
          baru otomatis dialokasikan ke drive dengan ruang tersisa paling
          efisien.
        </div>
      </div>

      {canManage && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(168,85,247,0.05)] p-4">
          <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(168,85,247,0.15)]">
            <Trash2 size={16} className="text-[#a855f7]" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Hapus drive yang masih berisi file?
            </b>{" "}
            Boleh. File metadata tetap tersimpan (tidak dihapus permanen), tapi
            disembunyikan dari UI. Kalau reconnect akun Google yang{" "}
            <b>sama</b>, drive akan di-resurrect dan semua file lama muncul
            kembali.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border-soft)] bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.05)] p-4">
        <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]">
          <Shield size={16} className="text-[var(--y-warn)]" />
        </div>
        <div className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
          <b className="text-[var(--y-text)]">Keamanan token.</b> Access token
          &amp; refresh token dienkripsi dengan Fernet (AES-128 CBC)
          menggunakan SECRET_KEY Anda.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatChip({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  color,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-3 py-2.5">
      <div
        className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg"
        style={{ background: `${color}22`, color }}
      >
        {icon}
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
          {label}
        </div>
        <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-bold text-[var(--y-text)] tabular-nums">
          {value}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
