===== FILE: src/components/yudit/editor/doc-preview-viewer.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/editor/doc-preview-viewer.tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  Download,
  FileSearch,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  RefreshCw,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { fetchRawDocx } from "@/lib/api/docs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// =====================================================
// PROPS
// =====================================================
interface DocPreviewViewerProps {
  fileId: string;
  fileName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

// =====================================================
// COMPONENT
// =====================================================
export function DocPreviewViewer({
  fileId,
  fileName,
  onClose,
}: DocPreviewViewerProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(100);

  // ---- Load & render docx ----
  const loadDocx = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      // Download binary .docx
      const blob = await fetchRawDocx(fileId);

      if (!containerRef.current) return;
      containerRef.current.innerHTML = "";

      // ✅ Dynamic import — type declaration dari docx-preview sudah include
      const { renderAsync } = await import("docx-preview");

      await renderAsync(blob, containerRef.current, undefined, {
        className: "docx-preview-wrapper",
        inWrapper: true,
        ignoreWidth: false,
        ignoreHeight: false,
        ignoreFonts: false,
        breakPages: true,
        ignoreLastRenderedPageBreak: false,
        experimental: true,
        useBase64URL: true,
        renderHeaders: true,
        renderFooters: true,
        renderFootnotes: true,
        renderEndnotes: true,
      });

      setLoading(false);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as { detail?: string; message?: string; status?: number };
      const msg =
        err?.status === 401
          ? "Google Drive tidak valid. Reconnect dulu."
          : err?.detail || err?.message || "Gagal render dokumen";
      setError(msg);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fileId]);

useEffect(() => {
  loadDocx();
}, [loadDocx]);

// ---- Download original ----
  const handleDownload = async () => {
    const toastId = toast.loading("Mengunduh…");
    try {
      const blob = await fetchRawDocx(fileId);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
      toast.success("Berhasil diunduh", { id: toastId });
    } catch {
      toast.error("Gagal download", { id: toastId });
    }
  };

  // ---- Zoom controls ----
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom((z) => Math.min(z + 25, 200));
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom((z) => Math.max(z - 25, 50));
  const handleZoomReset = () => setZoom(100);

  // =====================================================
  // RENDER
  // =====================================================
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex flex-col bg-[var(--y-bg)]"
    >
      {/* ===== HEADER ===== */}
      <div className="y-glass flex h-14 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border)] px-4">
        <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]">
          <FileSearch size={17} className="text-[var(--y-accent)]" />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {fileName}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-accent)]">
            <span>●</span>
            <span>Preview Asli — fidelity 100%</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Zoom controls */}
        {!loading && !error && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-1">
            <button
              onClick={handleZoomOut}
              disabled={zoom <= 50}
              title="Zoom out"
              className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-30"
            >
              <ZoomOut size={14} />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleZoomReset}
              title="Reset zoom"
              className="min-w-[44px] text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
            >
              {zoom}%
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleZoomIn}
              disabled={zoom >= 200}
              title="Zoom in"
              className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)] disabled:opacity-30"
            >
              <ZoomIn size={14} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Reload */}
        <button
          onClick={loadDocx}
          disabled={loading}
          title="Muat ulang"
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Reload</span>
        </button>

        {/* Download */}
        <button
          onClick={handleDownload}
          title="Download .docx"
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <Download size={14} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Download</span>
        </button>

        {/* Close */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          title="Tutup"
          className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ===== CONTENT ===== */}
      <div className="relative flex-1 overflow-auto bg-[#525659] p-4">
        {/* Loading overlay */}
        {loading && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 grid place-items-center bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <div className="text-center text-white">
              <Loader2
                size={40}
                className="mx-auto animate-spin text-[var(--y-accent)]"
              />
              <div className="mt-4 text-sm font-semibold">
                Merender dokumen…
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-white/60">
                Memuat semua tabel, gambar, dan style
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Error */}
        {error && !loading && (
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-6 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]">
              <AlertCircle size={28} className="text-[var(--y-danger)]" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
              Gagal Render Dokumen
            </h3>
            <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">{error}</p>
            <button
              onClick={loadDocx}
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} />
              Coba Lagi
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Render container */}
        <div
          ref={containerRef}
          className={cn(
            "docx-preview-container mx-auto",
            loading && "invisible",
          )}
          style={{
            transform: `scale(${zoom / 100})`,
            transformOrigin: "top center",
            transition: "transform 0.2s ease",
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ===== FOOTER ===== */}
      <div className="border-t border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-4 py-2 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        💡 Preview asli dari file <b>.docx</b> — tidak bisa diedit. Untuk edit,
        tutup preview lalu pilih <b>"Google Docs"</b> atau <b>"Edit Cepat"</b>.
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/yudit/editor/doc-editor.tsx =====
// src/components/yudit/editor/doc-editor.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { useEditor, EditorContent } from "@tiptap/react";
import StarterKit from "@tiptap/starter-kit";
import { Image } from "@tiptap/extension-image";
import { Table } from "@tiptap/extension-table";
import { TableRow } from "@tiptap/extension-table-row";
import { TableCell } from "@tiptap/extension-table-cell";
import { TableHeader } from "@tiptap/extension-table-header";
import { Link } from "@tiptap/extension-link";
import { Underline } from "@tiptap/extension-underline";
import { TextAlign } from "@tiptap/extension-text-align";
import { Placeholder } from "@tiptap/extension-placeholder";
import { Highlight } from "@tiptap/extension-highlight";
import { Color } from "@tiptap/extension-color";
import { TextStyle } from "@tiptap/extension-text-style";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Bold,
  Italic,
  Underline as UnderlineIcon,
  Strikethrough,
  Heading1,
  Heading2,
  Heading3,
  List,
  ListOrdered,
  AlignLeft,
  AlignCenter,
  AlignRight,
  Quote,
  Code,
  Table as TableIcon,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  Undo,
  Redo,
  Save,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  History,
  X,
  Highlighter,
  RefreshCw,
  FileWarning,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useDocEditor } from "@/hooks/use-doc-editor";
import {
  uploadDocImage,
  listDocVersions,
  restoreDocVersion,
  openDoc,
  type DocVersion,
} from "@/lib/api/docs";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// =====================================================
// PROPS
// =====================================================
interface DocEditorProps {
  fileId: string;
  fileName?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

// =====================================================
// MAIN COMPONENT
// =====================================================
export function DocEditor({ fileId, fileName, onClose }: DocEditorProps) {
  const { doc, loading, error, saveState, queueSave, saveNow, reload } =
    useDocEditor(fileId);
  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<DocVersion[]>([]);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const setView = useYudit((s) => s.setView);

  const editor = useEditor({
    immediatelyRender: false,
    extensions: [
      // ✅ StarterKit — disable link & underline karena ada manual
      StarterKit.configure({
        heading: { levels: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] },
        link: false,
        underline: false,
      }),
      Link.configure({
        openOnClick: false,
        HTMLAttributes: { class: "text-blue-500 underline" },
      }),
      Underline,
      Highlight.configure({ multicolor: true }),
      TextStyle,
      Color,
      TextAlign.configure({ types: ["heading", "paragraph"] }),
      Image.configure({ inline: true, allowBase64: true }),
      Table.configure({ resizable: true }),
      TableRow,
      TableHeader,
      TableCell,
      Placeholder.configure({
        placeholder: "Mulai menulis…",
      }),
    ],
    content: "",
    editorProps: {
      attributes: {
        class:
          "prose prose-invert prose-sm max-w-none focus:outline-none min-h-[600px]",
      },
    },
    onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
      queueSave(editor.getHTML());
    },
  });

  // ---- Set initial content ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editor && doc?.html && editor.getHTML() === "<p></p>") {
      editor.commands.setContent(doc.html);
    }
  }, [editor, doc]);

  // ---- Ctrl+S handler ----
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === "s") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (editor) {
          saveNow(editor.getHTML());
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [editor, saveNow]);

  // ---- Load versions ----
  const openHistory = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryOpen(true);
    try {
      const vs = await listDocVersions(fileId);
      setVersions(vs);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Gagal memuat riwayat");
    }
  }, [fileId]);

  const handleRestore = async (versionNumber: number) => {
    try {
      await restoreDocVersion(fileId, versionNumber);
      toast.success(`Versi ${versionNumber} berhasil dipulihkan`);
      const res = await openDoc(fileId);
      editor?.commands.setContent(res.html);
      setHistoryOpen(false);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Gagal restore versi");
    }
  };

  // ---- Image upload ----
  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !editor) return;
    e.target.value = "";

    const toastId = toast.loading("Mengunggah gambar…");
    try {
      const { url } = await uploadDocImage(fileId, file);
      editor.chain().focus().setImage({ src: url }).run();
      toast.success("Gambar disisipkan", { id: toastId });
    } catch {
      toast.error("Gagal upload gambar", { id: toastId });
    }
  };

  const displayName = doc?.file.name || fileName || "Dokumen";

  // =====================================================
  // RENDER: LOADING
  // =====================================================
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur">
        <div className="text-center text-white">
          <Loader2
            size={40}
            className="mx-auto animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
          <div className="mt-4 text-sm">Memuat dokumen…</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // =====================================================
  // RENDER: ERROR
  // =====================================================
  if (error || !doc) {
    // ✅ error sekarang object: { message, status, isAuthError }
    const isAuthError = error?.isAuthError ?? false;
    const errorMessage =
      error?.message || "Terjadi kesalahan saat memuat dokumen.";
    const errorStatus = error?.status ?? 0;

    // Icon & title berdasarkan jenis error
    const errorTitle = (() => {
      if (isAuthError) return "Google Drive Tidak Valid";
      if (errorStatus === 403) return "Akses Ditolak";
      if (errorStatus === 400) return "File Tidak Bisa Diedit";
      if (errorStatus >= 500) return "Server Error";
      return "Gagal Membuka Dokumen";
    })();

    const iconBg = isAuthError
      ? "bg-[rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]"
      : errorStatus === 400
        ? "bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]"
        : "bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]";

    const iconColor = isAuthError
      ? "text-[var(--y-warn)]"
      : "text-[var(--y-danger)]";

    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
          className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-6 text-center"
        >
          {/* Icon */}
          <div
            className={cn(
              "mx-auto mb-4 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl",
              iconBg,
            )}
          >
            {isAuthError ? (
              <RefreshCw size={28} className={iconColor} />
            ) : errorStatus === 400 ? (
              <FileWarning size={28} className={iconColor} />
            ) : (
              <AlertCircle size={28} className={iconColor} />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Title */}
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {errorTitle}
          </h3>

          {/* Message */}
          <p className="mb-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {errorMessage}
          </p>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {/* Tombol Reconnect — hanya kalau auth error */}
            {isAuthError && (
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  onClose();
                  setView("drives");
                }}
                className="y-gradient-brand y-glow-primary inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={15} />
                Buka Menu Google Drive
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Tombol Coba Lagi — untuk semua error */}
            <button
              onClick={() => reload()}
              className="inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={15} />
              Coba Lagi
            </button>

            {/* Tombol Tutup */}
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
            >
              Tutup
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Info detail (opsional, untuk debugging) */}
          {errorStatus > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 text-[10px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
              Error code: {errorStatus}
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // =====================================================
  // RENDER: MAIN EDITOR
  // =====================================================
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex flex-col bg-[var(--y-bg)]"
    >
      {/* ===== HEADER ===== */}
      <div className="y-glass flex h-14 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border)] px-4">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {displayName}
          </div>
          <SaveStatus state={saveState} />
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={openHistory}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <History size={14} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Riwayat</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (editor) saveNow(editor.getHTML());
          }}
          disabled={saveState.status === "saving"}
          className="y-gradient-brand inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {saveState.status === "saving" ? (
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Save size={14} />
          )}
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Simpan</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ===== TOOLBAR ===== */}
      <div className="y-glass sticky top-0 z-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-0.5 border-b border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 py-1.5">
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("bold")}
          onClick={() => editor?.chain().focus().toggleBold().run()}
          title="Bold (Ctrl+B)"
        >
          <Bold size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("italic")}
          onClick={() => editor?.chain().focus().toggleItalic().run()}
          title="Italic (Ctrl+I)"
        >
          <Italic size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("underline")}
          onClick={() => editor?.chain().focus().toggleUnderline().run()}
          title="Underline (Ctrl+U)"
        >
          <UnderlineIcon size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("strike")}
          onClick={() => editor?.chain().focus().toggleStrike().run()}
          title="Strikethrough"
        >
          <Strikethrough size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("highlight")}
          onClick={() => editor?.chain().focus().toggleHighlight().run()}
          title="Highlight"
        >
          <Highlighter size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>

        <ToolbarDivider />

        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("heading", { level: 1 })}
          onClick={() =>
            editor?.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: 1 }).run()
          }
          title="Heading 1"
        >
          <Heading1 size={15} />
        </ToolbarBtn>
        <ToolbarBtn
          active={editor?.isActive("heading", { level: 2 })}
          onClick={() =>
            editor?.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: 2 }).run()
          }
          title="Heading 2"
        >

function ToolbarBtn({
  children,
  active,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  title,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  active?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  title?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      title={title}
      className={cn(
        "grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded transition-colors",
        active
          ? "bg-[var(--y-primary)] text-white"
          : "text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] hover:text-[var(--y-text)]",
        disabled && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-30",
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function ToolbarDivider() {
  return <div className="mx-1 h-5 w-px bg-[var(--y-border)]" />;
}

 function SaveStatus({
  state,
}: {
  state: {
    status: "idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error" | "unsaved";
    lastSavedAt: Date | null;
    error: string | null;
  };
}){
  if (state.status === "saving") {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        <Loader2 size={11} className="animate-spin" />
        Menyimpan…
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (state.status === "saved" && state.lastSavedAt) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-success)]">
        <CheckCircle2 size={11} />
        Tersimpan{" "}
        {new Date(state.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString("id-ID", {
          hour: "2-digit",
          minute: "2-digit",
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (state.status === "error") {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--y-danger)]">
        <AlertCircle size={11} />
        {state.error || "Gagal simpan"}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (state.status === "unsaved") {
    return (
      <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-warn)]">● Belum tersimpan</div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

// src/components/yudit/editor/google-doc-viewer.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Download,
  FileText,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  convertToGoogleDoc,
  syncFromGoogleDoc,
  type GoogleDocInfo,
} from "@/lib/api/docs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface GoogleDocViewerProps {
  fileId: string;
  fileName: string;
  existingDocId?: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSyncBack?: () => void;
}

export function GoogleDocViewer({
  fileId,
  fileName,
  existingDocId,
  onClose,
  onSyncBack,
}: GoogleDocViewerProps) {
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<GoogleDocInfo | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);

  // ---- Convert / load ----
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const res = await convertToGoogleDoc(fileId);
        if (!cancelled) {
          setInfo(res);
        }
      } catch (e: unknown) {
        const err = e as { detail?: string; status?: number };
        const msg =
          err?.status === 401
            ? "Google Drive tidak valid. Reconnect di menu Google Drive."
            : err?.detail || "Gagal membuka Google Doc";
        if (!cancelled) setError(msg);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [fileId]);

  // ---- Sync back to .docx ----
  const handleSyncBack = async () => {
    setSyncing(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading("Menyimpan perubahan ke .docx…");
    try {
      await syncFromGoogleDoc(fileId);
      toast.success("Berhasil disimpan ke .docx", { id: toastId });
      onSyncBack?.();
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as { detail?: string };
      toast.error(err?.detail || "Gagal sync", { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  // ---- Loading ----
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur">
        <div className="text-center text-white">
          <Loader2
            size={40}
            className="mx-auto animate-spin text-[var(--y-primary)]"
          />
          <div className="mt-4 text-sm">Convert ke Google Doc…</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-white/60">
            Google Drive sedang memproses file
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ---- Error ----
  if (error || !info) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] grid place-items-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
          className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] p-6 text-center"
        >
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]">
            <AlertCircle size={28} className="text-[var(--y-danger)]" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-base font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            Gagal Membuka Google Docs
          </h3>
          <p className="mb-5 text-sm text-[var(--y-text-dim)]">
            {error || "Terjadi kesalahan"}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg)] text-sm font-semibold"
          >
            Tutup
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ---- Success: embed iframe ----
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex flex-col bg-[var(--y-bg)]"
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="y-glass flex h-14 items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--y-border)] px-4">
        <div className="grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[#4285f4]">
          <FileText size={17} className="text-white" />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--y-text)]">
            {info.name || fileName}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--y-success)]">
            ● Google Docs — fidelity 100%
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Sync back */}
        <button
          onClick={handleSyncBack}
          disabled={syncing}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)] disabled:opacity-60"
          title="Simpan balik ke .docx"
        >
          {syncing ? (
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Download size={14} />
          )}
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sync ke .docx</span>
        </button>

        {/* Open in new tab */}
        <a
          href={info.edit_url}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--y-border)] px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
          title="Buka di tab baru"
        >
          <ExternalLink size={14} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Tab Baru</span>
        </a>

        {/* Close */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-[var(--y-text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--y-bg-hover)]"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Iframe */}
      <div className="flex-1 bg-white">
        <iframe
          src={info.embed_url}
          className="h-full w-full border-0"
          title={info.name}
          allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write"
          sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-popups allow-forms allow-modals allow-downloads"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Footer hint */}
      <div className="border-t border-[var(--y-border)] bg-[var(--y-bg-elev)] px-4 py-2 text-center text-[11px] text-[var(--y-text-mute)]">
        💡 Edit langsung di sini. Klik <b>Sync ke .docx</b> untuk menyimpan
        balik ke Yudit Cloud.
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useUpload.ts =====
// src/hooks/useUpload.ts
"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { uploadFile } from "@/services/uploadService";
import type {
  UploadPhase,
  UploadProgress,
  UploadResult,
} from "@/types/upload";

export interface UseUploadState {
  phase: UploadPhase;
  overallPercent: number;
  clientPercent: number;
  serverPercent: number;
  message: string;
  speedBps: number;
  etaSeconds: number | null;
  bytesUploaded: number;
  bytesTotal: number;
  elapsedSeconds: number;
  fileName: string | null;
  category: string | null;
  isUploading: boolean;
  isDone: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  errorMessage: string | null;
  errorCode: string | null;
  retryable: boolean;
}

const INITIAL: UseUploadState = {
  phase: "IDLE",
  overallPercent: 0,
  clientPercent: 0,
  serverPercent: 0,
  message: "",
  speedBps: 0,
  etaSeconds: null,
  bytesUploaded: 0,
  bytesTotal: 0,
  elapsedSeconds: 0,
  fileName: null,
  category: null,
  isUploading: false,
  isDone: false,
  isError: false,
  errorMessage: null,
  errorCode: null,
  retryable: false,
};

export function useUpload(apiBaseUrl: string, authToken: string) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<UseUploadState>(INITIAL);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const lastFileRef = useRef<File | null>(null);
  const lastFolderRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);

  const upload = useCallback(
    async (file: File, folderId?: string): Promise<UploadResult> => {
      lastFileRef.current = file;
      lastFolderRef.current = folderId;

      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      setState({
        ...INITIAL,
        phase: "UPLOADING_TO_SERVER",
        message: "Memulai upload...",
        isUploading: true,
        bytesTotal: file.size,
        fileName: file.name,
      });

      const result = await uploadFile(file, {
        folderId,
        apiBaseUrl,
        authToken,
        signal: controller.signal,
        onProgress: (p: UploadProgress) => {
          setState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            phase: p.phase,
            overallPercent: p.overallPercent,
            clientPercent: p.clientPercent,
            serverPercent: p.serverPercent,
            message: p.message,
            speedBps: p.speedBps || 0,
            etaSeconds: p.etaSeconds ?? null,
            bytesUploaded: p.bytesUploaded || 0,
            bytesTotal: p.bytesTotal || file.size,
            elapsedSeconds: p.elapsedSeconds || 0,
            fileName: p.fileName || file.name,
            category: p.category || null,
            isUploading:
              p.phase !== "DONE" &&
              p.phase !== "FAILED" &&
              p.phase !== "CANCELLED",
            isDone: p.phase === "DONE",
            isError: p.phase === "FAILED",
          }));
        },
      });

      if (!result.success) {
        setState((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          isUploading: false,
          isError: true,
          isDone: false,
          errorMessage: result.errorMessage || "Upload gagal",
          errorCode: result.errorCode || "UNKNOWN",
          retryable: result.retryable ?? false,
        }));
      }

      abortRef.current = null;
      return result;
    },
    [apiBaseUrl, authToken]
  );

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
  }, []);

  const retry = useCallback(async () => {
    if (lastFileRef.current) {
      return upload(lastFileRef.current, lastFolderRef.current);
    }
    return null;
  }, [upload]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setState(INITIAL);
    abortRef.current = null;
    lastFileRef.current = null;
    lastFolderRef.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  return { state, upload, cancel, retry, reset };
}

===== FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.ts =====
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}



===== FILE: src/hooks/use-toast.ts =====
"use client"

// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
    type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
    toast: ToasterToast
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
    toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
              ...t,
              open: false,
            }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  openDoc,
  saveDoc,
  type DocOpenResponse,
  type DocSaveResponse,
} from "@/lib/api/docs";

// =====================================================
// TYPES
// =====================================================
interface SaveState {
  status: "idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error" | "unsaved";
  lastSavedAt: Date | null;
  error: string | null;
}

interface LoadError {
  message: string;
  status: number;
  isAuthError: boolean;
  requestId?: string; // ⭐ TAMBAH — untuk tracing 500 error
}

// =====================================================
// HOOK
// =====================================================
export function useDocEditor(fileId: string | null) {
  const [doc, setDoc] = useState<DocOpenResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<LoadError | null>(null);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<SaveState>({
    status: "idle",
    lastSavedAt: null,
    error: null,
  });

  const contentHashRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const pendingHtmlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // ---- Load ----
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!fileId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await openDoc(fileId);
      setDoc(res);
      contentHashRef.current = res.content_hash;
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as {
        detail?: string;
        status?: number;
        requestId?: string;
      };
      const status = err?.status || 0;
      const requestId = err?.requestId;

      let message = err?.detail || "Gagal membuka dokumen";
      let isAuthError = false;

      if (status === 401) {
        isAuthError = true;
        message =
          err?.detail ||
          "Google Drive yang menyimpan file ini sudah tidak valid. " +
            "Buka menu 'Google Drive' → hapus akun lama → connect ulang.";
      } else if (status === 403) {
        message = err?.detail || "Anda tidak memiliki akses ke file ini.";
      } else if (status === 429) {
        message = "Terlalu banyak permintaan. Coba lagi beberapa saat.";
      } else if (status >= 500) {
        const rid = requestId ? ` (Ref: ${requestId})` : "";
        message = "Server sedang bermasalah. Coba lagi beberapa saat." + rid;
      }

      setError({ message, status, isAuthError, requestId });
      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fileId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ---- Save internal ----
  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (html: string, saveAsNew = false) => {
      if (!fileId) return null;
      setSaveState((s) => ({ ...s, status: "saving", error: null }));
      try {
        const res: DocSaveResponse = await saveDoc(
          fileId,
          html,
          contentHashRef.current,
          saveAsNew,
        );
        contentHashRef.current = res.file.content_hash;
        setSaveState({
          status: "saved",
          lastSavedAt: new Date(),
          error: null,
        });
        return res;
      } catch (e: unknown) {
        const err = e as {
          detail?: string;
          status?: number;
          requestId?: string;
        };
        const status = err?.status || 0;
        const requestId = err?.requestId;

        let msg = err?.detail || "Gagal simpan";
        if (status === 401) {
          msg =
            "Google Drive tidak valid. Reconnect dulu di menu Google Drive.";
        } else if (status === 400) {
          msg = err?.detail || "Dokumen sudah berubah. Muat ulang.";
        } else if (status === 429) {
          msg = "Terlalu banyak permintaan. Coba lagi beberapa saat.";
        } else if (status >= 500) {
          const rid = requestId ? ` (Ref: ${requestId})` : "";
          msg = "Server error. Coba lagi beberapa saat." + rid;
        }

        setSaveState({ status: "error", lastSavedAt: null, error: msg });
        toast.error(msg);
        return null;
      }
    },
    [fileId],
  );

  // ---- Debounced save ----
  const queueSave = useCallback(
    (html: string) => {
      pendingHtmlRef.current = html;
      setSaveState((s) => ({ ...s, status: "unsaved" }));

      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (pendingHtmlRef.current) {
          doSave(pendingHtmlRef.current);
          pendingHtmlRef.current = null;
        }
      }, 1500);
    },
    [doSave],
  );

  // ---- Manual save ----
  const saveNow = useCallback(
    async (html: string, saveAsNew = false) => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      return doSave(html, saveAsNew);
    },
    [doSave],
  );

  // ---- Cleanup: save pending changes sebelum unmount ----
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      if (fileId && pendingHtmlRef.current) {
        const html = pendingHtmlRef.current;
        pendingHtmlRef.current = null;
        // Fire-and-forget — tidak blocking unmount
        saveDoc(fileId, html, contentHashRef.current, false).catch((err) => {
          console.warn("[useDocEditor] Save on unmount failed:", err);
        });
      }
    };
  }, [fileId]);

  return {
    doc,
    loading,
    error,
    saveState,
    queueSave,
    saveNow,
    reload: load,
  };
}



===== FILE: src/hooks/use-apply-preferences.ts =====
// src/hooks/use-apply-preferences.ts
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";
import { getProfile } from "@/lib/api/profile";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";

// =====================================================
// CONSTANTS
// =====================================================
const THEME_KEY = "yudit_theme";
const LANGUAGE_KEY = "yudit_language";

const VALID_THEMES = ["light", "dark", "system"] as const;
type ThemeType = (typeof VALID_THEMES)[number];

// =====================================================
// VALIDATE THEME
// =====================================================
function isValidTheme(value: unknown): value is ThemeType {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    (VALID_THEMES as readonly string[]).includes(value)
  );
}

/**
 * Resolve theme "system" → "light" | "dark" berdasarkan preferensi OS.
 */
function resolveTheme(theme: ThemeType): "light" | "dark" {
  if (theme === "system") {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return "light";
    return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      ? "dark"
      : "light";
  }
  return theme;
}

// =====================================================
// APPLY THEME
// =====================================================
/**
 * Terapkan theme ke <html>.
 *
 * - Menghapus class `light` & `dark` lama
 * - Menambahkan class baru sesuai theme
 * - Set `color-scheme` CSS untuk form native elements
 * - Simpan ke localStorage
 * - Trigger event global `yudit:theme-changed` agar komponen lain bisa react
 */
export function applyTheme(theme: string): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;

  // ⭐ Validasi — kalau tidak valid, fallback ke "system"
  const safeTheme: ThemeType = isValidTheme(theme) ? theme : "system";
  const resolved = resolveTheme(safeTheme);

  const root = document.documentElement;

  // ⭐ Enable smooth transition (matikan setelah 300ms)
  root.classList.add("theme-transition");
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    root.classList.remove("theme-transition");
  }, 300);

  // Hapus class lama
  root.classList.remove("light", "dark");
  // Tambah class baru
  root.classList.add(resolved);
  // ⭐ Set color-scheme — PENTING untuk form, scrollbar, autofill
  root.style.colorScheme = resolved;

  // Simpan preferensi (bukan yang resolved, tapi yang dipilih user)
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, safeTheme);
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  // ⭐ Broadcast ke komponen lain (toast, chart, dll)
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("yudit:theme-changed", {
        detail: { theme: safeTheme, resolved },
      }),
    );
  }
}

// =====================================================
// APPLY LANGUAGE
// =====================================================
/**
 * Terapkan bahasa ke <html lang>.
 * Saat ini hanya mendukung "id" (Indonesia).
 */
export function applyLanguage(language: string): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;

  const safeLang = language === "en" ? "en" : "id";
  document.documentElement.lang = safeLang;

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LANGUAGE_KEY, safeLang);
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

// =====================================================
// GET CURRENT THEME
// =====================================================
/**
 * Baca theme saat ini dari localStorage.
 * Return "system" kalau tidak ada / invalid.
 */
export function getCurrentTheme(): ThemeType {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "system";
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    return isValidTheme(stored) ? stored : "system";
  } catch {
    return "system";
  }
}

// =====================================================
// LEGACY MEDIAQUERYLIST SUPPORT
// =====================================================
/**
 * Attach listener ke MediaQueryList dengan fallback ke legacy API
 * (addListener/removeListener) untuk browser lama (Safari < 14, dll).
 *
 * ⭐ Menggunakan type assertion yang aman alih-alih `@ts-expect-error`,
 *    sehingga kompatibel di semua versi TypeScript tanpa error TS2578.
 */
function addMediaQueryListener(
  mql: MediaQueryList,
  handler: (ev: MediaQueryListEvent) => void,
): () => void {
  // Modern API — semua browser modern support
  if (typeof mql.addEventListener === "function") {
    mql.addEventListener("change", handler);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", handler);
  }

  // Legacy fallback — Safari < 14, iOS < 14, Chrome < 39
  // Type assertion aman karena kita sudah cek keberadaan method-nya
  const legacyMql = mql as MediaQueryList & {
    addListener?: (cb: (ev: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) => void;
    removeListener?: (cb: (ev: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) => void;
  };

  if (typeof legacyMql.addListener === "function") {
    legacyMql.addListener(handler);
    return () => {
      if (typeof legacyMql.removeListener === "function") {
        legacyMql.removeListener(handler);
      }
    };
  }

  // Tidak ada listener support sama sekali → no-op cleanup
  return () => {
    /* no-op */
  };
}

// =====================================================
// HOOK — apply preferences saat login
// =====================================================
/**
 * Apply theme (light/dark/system) + language ke <html> tag.
 *
 * Dipanggil di YuditCloud setelah login berhasil.
 *
 * Flow:
 * 1. Instant apply dari localStorage (untuk theme & language)
 * 2. Fetch /profile/ untuk sinkronisasi dengan DB
 * 3. Kalau beda → apply theme baru
 * 4. Listen system preference change kalau theme = "system"
 */
export function useApplyPreferences(): void {
  const isAuthenticated = useYudit((s) => s.isAuthenticated);

  // ---- Instant apply dari localStorage ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    try {
      const cachedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
      if (cachedTheme) applyTheme(cachedTheme);

      const cachedLang = localStorage.getItem(LANGUAGE_KEY);
      if (cachedLang) applyLanguage(cachedLang);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  // ---- Sync dengan DB setelah login ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const profile = await getProfile();
        if (cancelled) return;

        // ⭐ Validasi + apply
        const dbTheme = isValidTheme(profile.theme)
          ? profile.theme
          : "system";

        // Hanya apply kalau BEDA dengan localStorage (hindari flicker)
        const cachedTheme = getCurrentTheme();
        if (dbTheme !== cachedTheme) {
          applyTheme(dbTheme);
        }

        // Language — hardcode "id" karena app hanya Indonesia
        applyLanguage("id");
      } catch (e) {
        if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
        // Silent — jangan ganggu UX kalau fetch profile gagal
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  // ---- Listen system preference change ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

    const mql = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");

    const handleChange = () => {
      try {
        const cachedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
        if (cachedTheme === "system") {
          applyTheme("system");
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    };

    // ⭐ Pakai helper yang kompatibel dengan semua versi TypeScript
    const cleanup = addMediaQueryListener(mql, handleChange);
    return cleanup;
  }, []);
}

===== FILE: src/hooks/use-page-tracker.ts =====
// src/hooks/use-page-tracker.ts
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { trackPageView } from "@/lib/api/profile";
import { useYudit } from "@/lib/yudit/store";

// =====================================================
// PAGE TITLES
// ⭐ Sinkron dengan TITLES di topbar.tsx & ViewKey di types.ts
// =====================================================
const PAGE_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  files: "My Files",
  "my-tasks": "Dokumen Saya",
  convert: "Konversi Dokumen",
  monthly: "Arsip Per Bulan",
  stats: "Statistik",
  drives: "Google Drive Accounts",
  collaborators: "Collaborators",
  profile: "Profil Saya",
  scan: "Cam Scanner",
  transfer: "Transfer Workspace",
};

/**
 * Hook untuk auto-track page views.
 * Panggil di komponen utama (yudit-cloud.tsx) dengan currentView.
 * Track setiap kali view berubah → catat ke backend.
 *
 * ⭐ Special handling untuk "scan" & "transfer":
 *    Keduanya adalah halaman TERPISAH (/scan, /transfer).
 *    Ketika user klik menu, `setView` langsung redirect via
 *    window.location.href, jadi currentView di store tidak pernah
 *    berubah ke "scan"/"transfer".
 *    Tracking untuk kedua halaman ini dilakukan oleh komponen
 *    masing-masing (CamScannerView, TransferView).
 */
export function usePageTracker() {
  const isAuthenticated = useYudit((s) => s.isAuthenticated);
  const currentView = useYudit((s) => s.currentView);
  const userId = useYudit((s) => s.user?.id);
  const lastTrackedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const startTimeRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated || !userId) return;

    // ⭐ Skip tracking untuk view yang hanya placeholder
    // (scan & transfer tidak akan sampai sini karena setView redirect)
    if (currentView === "scan" || currentView === "transfer") {
      return;
    }

    // Hitung duration di view sebelumnya
    const prevView = lastTrackedRef.current;
    const now = Date.now();
    const durationMs = prevView ? now - startTimeRef.current : 0;

    // Skip kalau masih di view yang sama (hindari duplicate)
    if (prevView === currentView) return;

    const pagePath = `/?view=${currentView}`;
    const pageTitle = PAGE_TITLES[currentView] || currentView;

    // Track page view
    trackPageView({
      page_path: pagePath,
      page_title: pageTitle,
      referrer: prevView
        ? `/?view=${prevView}`
        : typeof document !== "undefined"
          ? document.referrer
          : undefined,
      duration_ms: durationMs > 0 ? durationMs : undefined,
    }).catch(() => {
      // Silent — tracking tidak boleh ganggu UX
    });

    lastTrackedRef.current = currentView;
    startTimeRef.current = now;
  }, [isAuthenticated, userId, currentView]);
}

// src/lib/format.ts
/**
 * Formatter utilities untuk UI upload.
 */

/**
 * Format bytes → human readable (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).
 */
export function formatBytes(bytes: number | undefined | null): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const i = Math.min(
    Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)),
    units.length - 1
  );
  const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
  // Tampilkan 1 desimal kalau <10, 0 desimal kalau >=10
  const decimals = value < 10 ? 1 : 0;
  return `${value.toFixed(decimals)} ${units[i]}`;
}

/**
 * Format speed (B/s) → human readable.
 */
export function formatSpeed(bps: number | undefined | null): string {
  if (!bps || bps <= 0) return "-";
  return `${formatBytes(bps)}/s`;
}

/**
 * Format ETA (detik) → "5s", "1m 23s", "1h 5m".
 */
export function formatEta(seconds: number | undefined | null): string {
  if (seconds == null || seconds <= 0) return "-";
  if (seconds < 1) return "<1s";
  if (seconds < 60) return `${Math.ceil(seconds)}s`;

  const total = Math.ceil(seconds);
  const h = Math.floor(total / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const s = total % 60;

  if (h > 0) {
    return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  }
  return `${m}m ${s}s`;
}

/**
 * Format elapsed (detik) → "12s", "1m 5s".
 */
export function formatElapsed(seconds: number | undefined | null): string {
  if (seconds == null || seconds < 0) return "0s";
  if (seconds < 60) return `${Math.floor(seconds)}s`;
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
  return `${m}m ${s}s`;
}

/**
 * Truncate file name supaya muat di UI.
 */
export function truncateName(name: string, max = 40): string {
  if (name.length <= max) return name;
  const ext = name.includes(".")
    ? name.slice(name.lastIndexOf("."))
    : "";
  const base = name.slice(0, name.length - ext.length);
  const head = Math.floor((max - ext.length - 3) / 2);
  const tail = max - ext.length - 3 - head;
  return `${base.slice(0, head)}...${base.slice(-tail)}${ext}`;
}


===== FILE: src/lib/oauth-broadcast.ts =====
// src/lib/oauth-broadcast.ts
/**
 * Broadcast hasil OAuth ke parent window via 3 mekanisme redundan:
 * 1. window.opener.postMessage (primary)
 * 2. localStorage (cross-tab storage event)
 * 3. BroadcastChannel (modern API)
 *
 * Semua dijalankan sekaligus untuk redundancy — parent tinggal
 * listen salah satu yang tersedia.
 *
 * Dipakai di callback page (/drives dan /oauth-callback) setelah
 * Google OAuth redirect balik ke aplikasi.
 */

const OAUTH_CHANNEL_NAME = "yudit:oauth-channel";
const OAUTH_STORAGE_KEY = "yudit:oauth-result";

export interface OAuthBroadcastPayload {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export function broadcastOAuthResult(payload: OAuthBroadcastPayload): void {
  const message = {
    type: "yudit:oauth",
    success: payload.success,
    error: payload.error,
  };

  // ---------- 1. postMessage to opener ----------
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.opener) {
    try {
      window.opener.postMessage(message, "*");
    } catch (err) {
      // Cross-origin access might throw → skip
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.warn("[oauth-broadcast] postMessage failed:", err);
    }
  }

  // ---------- 2. localStorage storage event ----------
  // Catatan: event 'storage' TIDAK fire di tab yang sama (by spec).
  // Parent tab yang listen akan dengar event ini.
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(OAUTH_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(message));
  } catch (err) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.warn("[oauth-broadcast] localStorage failed:", err);
  }

  // ---------- 3. BroadcastChannel ----------
  if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const channel = new BroadcastChannel(OAUTH_CHANNEL_NAME);
      channel.postMessage(message);
      // Tutup channel setelah 200ms (cukup untuk deliver)
      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          channel.close();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }, 200);
    } catch (err) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.warn("[oauth-broadcast] BroadcastChannel failed:", err);
    }
  }
}



===== FILE: src/lib/yudit/utils.ts =====
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import {
  FileText,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Film,
  Music,
  Archive,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Presentation,
  Code2,
  File,
  FileType2,
} from "lucide-react";

export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes === 0) return "0 B";
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + " " + sizes[i];
}

export function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("id-ID", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

export function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return d.toLocaleString("id-ID", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

export const MONTHS_ID = [
  "Januari",
  "Februari",
  "Maret",
  "April",
  "Mei",
  "Juni",
  "Juli",
  "Agustus",
  "September",
  "Oktober",
  "November",
  "Desember",
];

export const MONTHS_SHORT = [
  "Jan",
  "Feb",
  "Mar",
  "Apr",
  "Mei",
  "Jun",
  "Jul",
  "Ags",
  "Sep",
  "Okt",
  "Nov",
  "Des",
];

export function extOf(name: string): string {
  return (name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();
}

export interface FileIconInfo {
  Icon: LucideIcon;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}

export function fileIconInfo(
  mime: string,
  name = "",
): FileIconInfo {
  const ext = extOf(name);
  if (
    mime.startsWith("image/") ||
    ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp", "svg", "bmp", "heic"].includes(ext)
  ) {
    return {
      Icon: ImageIcon,
      color: "#22d3ee",
      bg: "rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (
    mime.startsWith("video/") ||
    ["mp4", "mkv", "mov", "avi", "webm"].includes(ext)
  ) {
    return {
      Icon: Film,
      color: "#f87171",
      bg: "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (
    mime.startsWith("audio/") ||
    ["mp3", "wav", "flac", "m4a", "ogg"].includes(ext)
  ) {
    return {
      Icon: Music,
      color: "#e879f9",
      bg: "rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (["zip", "rar", "7z", "tar", "gz"].includes(ext)) {
    return {
      Icon: Archive,
      color: "#d6d3d1",
      bg: "rgba(120, 113, 108, 0.18)",
    };
  }
  if (ext === "pdf") {
    return {
      Icon: FileType2,
      color: "#f87171",
      bg: "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (["doc", "docx", "odt", "rtf"].includes(ext)) {
    return {
      Icon: FileText,
      color: "#60a5fa",
      bg: "rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (["xls", "xlsx", "csv", "ods"].includes(ext)) {
    return {
      Icon: FileSpreadsheet,
      color: "#34d399",
      bg: "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (["ppt", "pptx", "odp"].includes(ext)) {
    return {
      Icon: Presentation,
      color: "#fbbf24",
      bg: "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  if (
    ["js", "ts", "py", "html", "css", "json", "sh", "java", "go", "sql", "xml", "md", "txt"].includes(
      ext,
    )
  ) {
    return {
      Icon: Code2,
      color: "#a5b4fc",
      bg: "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)",
    };
  }
  return {
    Icon: File,
    color: "#94a3b8",
    bg: "rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12)",
  };
}

export function getCategoryMeta(
  cat: string | null,
  customCats: { name: string; icon: string }[] = [],
): CategoryMeta {
  if (!cat)
    return {
      icon: "📄",
      cls: "cat-lainnya",
      color: "#94a3b8",
      bg: "rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.14)",
      border: "rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.3)",
    };
  if (CATEGORY_META[cat]) return CATEGORY_META[cat];
  const custom = customCats.find((c) => c.name === cat);
  return {
    icon: custom?.icon || "📄",
    cls: "cat-custom",
    color: "#a5b4fc",
    bg: "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.14)",
    border: "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)",
  };
}

  };
}

export function detectCategory(
  name: string,
  mime: string,
): string {
  const ext = extOf(name);
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();

  const RULES: { cat: string; test: () => boolean }[] = [
    { cat: "Surat Masuk", test: () => /surat\s*masuk|incoming|masuk/i.test(lower) },
    { cat: "Surat Keluar", test: () => /surat\s*keluar|outgoing|keluar/i.test(lower) },
    { cat: "BA (Berita Acara)", test: () => /berita\s*acara|\bba\b|\bnotula/i.test(lower) },
    {
      cat: "Surat Keputusan Pimpinan",
      test: () => /keputusan\s*pimpinan|sk\s*pimpinan/i.test(lower),
    },
    { cat: "Surat Keputusan DPRD", test: () => /keputusan\s*dprd|sk\s*dprd/i.test(lower) },
    {
      cat: "Surat Persetujuan Bersama",
      test: () => /persetujuan\s*bersama/i.test(lower),
    },
    {
      cat: "SPJ (Surat Pertanggungjawaban)",
      test: () => /spj|pertanggungjawab/i.test(lower),
    },
    { cat: "Notulen Banmus", test: () => /notulen\s*banmus|banmus/i.test(lower) },
    {
      cat: "Notulen Bapemperda",
      test: () => /notulen\s*bapem|bapemperda/i.test(lower),
    },
    { cat: "Notulen Pansus", test: () => /notulen\s*pansus|pansus/i.test(lower) },
  ];

  for (const r of RULES) {
    if (r.test()) return r.cat;
  }

  if (mime.startsWith("image/") || ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp", "svg"].includes(ext))
    return "Gambar";
  if (mime.startsWith("video/") || ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "webm"].includes(ext))
    return "Video";
  if (mime.startsWith("audio/") || ["mp3", "wav", "flac", "m4a"].includes(ext))
    return "Audio";
  if (["zip", "rar", "7z", "tar", "gz"].includes(ext)) return "Arsip";
  if (["xls", "xlsx", "csv", "ods"].includes(ext)) return "Spreadsheet";
  if (["ppt", "pptx", "odp"].includes(ext)) return "Presentasi";
  if (["js", "ts", "py", "html", "css", "json", "sh", "sql", "xml"].includes(ext))
    return "Kode";
  if (["pdf", "doc", "docx", "odt", "rtf", "txt", "md"].includes(ext)) return "Dokumen";
  return "Lainnya";
}

export function genId(prefix = "id"): string {
  return prefix + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36);
}

export function genToken(): string {
  return (
    Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) +
    Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
  );
}

type ToastFn = (msg: string, type?: "success" | "error" | "info") => void;
let toastFn: ToastFn | null = null;
export function registerToast(fn: ToastFn) {
  toastFn = fn;
}
function toast(msg: string, type: "success" | "error" | "info" = "info") {
  toastFn?.(msg, type);
}

// =====================================================
// UNSUPPORTED OP
// =====================================================
interface UnsupportedOp {
  key: string;
  reason: string;
}

// =====================================================
// ROLE HELPERS
// =====================================================
export function isOwner(user: User | null): boolean {
  return user?.role === "owner";
}

export function isSuperAdmin(user: User | null): boolean {
  return user?.role === "super_admin";
}

export function isMember(user: User | null): boolean {
  return user?.role === "member";
}

export function canManageWorkspace(user: User | null): boolean {
  return isOwner(user) || isSuperAdmin(user);
}

export function defaultViewForRole(user: User | null): ViewKey {
  return isMember(user) ? "my-tasks" : "files";
}

export function canAccessView(user: User | null, view: ViewKey): boolean {
  if (!user) return false;
  if (view === "my-tasks") return isMember(user);
  if (view === "transfer") return isOwner(user);
  return true;
}
