// =====================================================
function _viewFromUrl(): ViewKey | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const v = params.get("view");
    const valid: ViewKey[] = [
      "files", "monthly", "stats", "drives", "convert",
      "collaborators", "my-tasks", "profile", "scan", "transfer",
    ];
    if (v && (valid as string[]).includes(v)) {
      return v as ViewKey;
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  return null;
}

// =====================================================
// STORE
// =====================================================
export const useYudit = create<YuditState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      // =====================================================
      // INITIAL STATE
      // =====================================================
      isAuthenticated: false,
      user: null,
      authLoading: false,
      bootstrapped: false,

      currentView: "files",
      sidebarOpen: false,

      drives: [],
      pool: EMPTY_POOL,
      files: [],
      customCategories: [],
      defaultCategories: [],
      collaborators: [],

      currentFolderId: null,
      folders: [],
      folderBreadcrumb: [],
      foldersLoading: false,

      conversionOperations: [],
      conversionUnsupportedOps: [],
      conversionJobs: [],
      converting: false,

      filesLoading: false,
      drivesLoading: false,
      quotaRefreshing: false,
      collaboratorsLoading: false,

      currentCategory: "all",
      searchQuery: "",
      monthlySearchQuery: "",
      filters: {},
      filterPanelOpen: false,
      expandedMonthly: {},

      previewFileId: null,
      shareFileId: null,
      categoryManagerOpen: false,
      assignModalOpen: false,
      assignModalFileId: null,
      editorState: null,
      confirmDialog: { open: false, title: "", text: "", onConfirm: null },
      progress: { open: false, label: "", sub: "", pct: null },

      driveAuthError: { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null },

      // =====================================================
      // ⭐ BOOTSTRAP AUTH — IDEMPOTENT & TIDAK OVERRIDE currentView
      // =====================================================
      bootstrapAuth: () => {
        // Kalau sudah pernah di-bootstrap, jangan reset apa-apa
        if (get().bootstrapped) {
          return;
        }

        const token = getToken();
        const user = getStoredUser<User>();

        if (!token || !user) {
          set({
            isAuthenticated: false,
            user: null,
            bootstrapped: true,
          });
          return;
        }

        if (!user.role) {
          clearToken();
          set({
            isAuthenticated: false,
            user: null,
            bootstrapped: true,
          });
          return;
        }

        // ⭐ Sinkron currentView dengan URL
        // Kalau URL punya ?view=xxx, pakai itu.
        // Kalau tidak ada, pakai nilai yang sudah ada (dari persist) atau default.
        const urlView = _viewFromUrl();
        let nextView: ViewKey = get().currentView;

        if (urlView && canAccessView(user, urlView)) {
          nextView = urlView;
        } else if (!canAccessView(user, nextView)) {
          nextView = defaultViewForRole(user);
        }

        set({
          isAuthenticated: true,
          user,
          bootstrapped: true,
          currentView: nextView,
        });
      },

      // =====================================================
      // LOGIN
      // =====================================================
      login: async (email, password) => {
        set({ authLoading: true });
        try {
          const res = await authApi.login({ email, password });

          const role = res.user.role;
          if (role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin" && role !== "member") {
            throw new Error("Server mengembalikan role tidak valid");
          }

          const user: User = {
            id: res.user.id,
            email: res.user.email,
            username: res.user.username,
            role,
            owner_id: res.user.owner_id ?? null,
            must_change_password: res.user.must_change_password ?? false,
          };

          setToken(res.access_token);
          setStoredUser(user);

          set({
            isAuthenticated: true,
            user,
            authLoading: false,
            bootstrapped: true,
            currentView: defaultViewForRole(user),
            driveAuthError: { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null },
          });

          toast(`Selamat datang, ${user.username}!`, "success");

          if (user.must_change_password) {
            toast(
              "Anda masih memakai password default. Segera ganti password!",
              "error",
            );
          }
        } catch (e) {
          set({ authLoading: false });

          if (e instanceof ApiError) {
            if (e.status === 429) {
              const wait = e.retryAfter
                ? `Coba lagi dalam ${e.retryAfter} detik.`
                : "Coba lagi beberapa saat lagi.";
              toast(`Terlalu banyak percobaan login. ${wait}`, "error");
              throw e;
            }
            if (e.status === 401) {
              toast("Email atau password salah", "error");
              throw e;
            }
            if (e.status === 403 && e.detail.includes("dinonaktifkan")) {
              toast("Akun dinonaktifkan. Hubungi owner workspace.", "error");
              throw e;
            }
            if (e.status >= 500) {
              const rid = e.requestId ? ` (ref: ${e.requestId})` : "";
              toast(`Server error. Coba lagi.${rid}`, "error");
              throw e;
            }
            toast(e.detail, "error");
            throw e;
          }

          toast("Login gagal", "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      // =====================================================
      // REGISTER
      // =====================================================
      register: async (email, username, password) => {
        set({ authLoading: true });
        try {
          const res = await authApi.register({ email, username, password });

          const role = res.user.role;
          if (role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin" && role !== "member") {
            throw new Error("Server mengembalikan role tidak valid");
          }

          const user: User = {
            id: res.user.id,
            email: res.user.email,
            username: res.user.username,
            role,
            owner_id: res.user.owner_id ?? null,
            must_change_password: res.user.must_change_password ?? false,
          };

          setToken(res.access_token);
          setStoredUser(user);

          set({
            isAuthenticated: true,
            user,
            authLoading: false,
            bootstrapped: true,
            currentView: defaultViewForRole(user),
            driveAuthError: { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null },
          });
          toast(
            `Akun berhasil dibuat. Selamat datang, ${user.username}!`,
            "success",
          );
        } catch (e) {
          set({ authLoading: false });
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Registrasi gagal";
          toast(msg, "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      // =====================================================
      // LOGOUT
      // =====================================================
      logout: () => {
        clearToken();
        set({
          isAuthenticated: false,
          user: null,
          bootstrapped: false,   // reset supaya bisa bootstrap lagi setelah login
          currentView: "files",
          previewFileId: null,
          shareFileId: null,
          categoryManagerOpen: false,
          assignModalOpen: false,
          assignModalFileId: null,
          editorState: null,
          files: [],
          drives: [],
          pool: EMPTY_POOL,
          customCategories: [],
          defaultCategories: [],
          collaborators: [],
          conversionOperations: [],
          conversionUnsupportedOps: [],
          conversionJobs: [],
          currentFolderId: null,
          folders: [],
          folderBreadcrumb: [],
          driveAuthError: { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null },
        });
        toast("Logout berhasil", "info");
      },

      // =====================================================
      // CHANGE PASSWORD
      // =====================================================
      changePassword: async (currentPassword, newPassword) => {
        try {
          await authApi.changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword);

          const currentUser = get().user;
          if (currentUser) {
            const updated: User = {
              ...currentUser,
              must_change_password: false,
            };
            set({ user: updated });
            setStoredUser(updated);
          }
          toast("Password berhasil diubah", "success");
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal ganti password";
          toast(msg, "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      // =====================================================
      // ⭐ SET VIEW — scan & transfer pakai route terpisah
      // =====================================================
      setView: (v) => {
        const user = get().user;

        if (!canAccessView(user, v)) {
          toast("Anda tidak punya akses ke halaman ini.", "error");
          set({ currentView: defaultViewForRole(user), sidebarOpen: false });
          return;
        }

        // Cam Scanner — halaman full-screen terpisah
        if (v === "scan") {
          set({ sidebarOpen: false });
          if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
            window.location.href = "/scan";
          }
          return;
        }

        // Transfer Workspace — halaman terpisah
        if (v === "transfer") {
          set({ sidebarOpen: false });
          if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
            window.location.href = "/transfer";
          }
          return;
        }

        set({
          currentView: v,
          sidebarOpen: false,
          ...(v !== "files"
            ? {
                currentFolderId: null,
                folders: [],
                folderBreadcrumb: [],
              }
            : {}),
        });
      },

      setSidebarOpen: (open) => set({ sidebarOpen: open }),

      // =====================================================
      // DATA FETCH (tidak diubah dari versi sebelumnya)
      // =====================================================
      fetchFiles: async (params) => {
        set({ filesLoading: true });
        try {
          const files = await filesApi.listFiles(params || {});
          set({ files: files as FileItem[], filesLoading: false });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ filesLoading: false });
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat file";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchDrives: async () => {
        set({ drivesLoading: true });
        try {
          const [drives, pool] = await Promise.all([
            drivesApi.listDrives(),
            drivesApi.getPoolSummary().catch(() => EMPTY_POOL),
          ]);

          const currentErr = get().driveAuthError;
          let nextErr = currentErr;
          if (currentErr.email) {
            const target = (drives as DriveAccount[]).find(
              (d) => d.google_email === currentErr.email,
            );
            if (!target || target.is_active) {
              nextErr = { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null };
            }
          }

          set({
            drives: drives as DriveAccount[],
            pool: pool as PoolInfo,
            drivesLoading: false,
            driveAuthError: nextErr,
          });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ drivesLoading: false });
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat drive";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchCategories: async () => {
        try {
          const res = await catApi.listCategories();
          set({
            defaultCategories: res.default.map((c) => ({
              ...c,
              is_builtin: true,
            })),
            customCategories: res.custom.map((c) => ({
              ...c,
              is_builtin: false,
              keywords: c.keywords || [],
            })),
          });
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat kategori";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchCollaborators: async () => {
        set({ collaboratorsLoading: true });
        try {
          const res = await collabApi.listCollaborators();
          set({ collaborators: res, collaboratorsLoading: false });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ collaboratorsLoading: false });
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat collaborators";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchFolders: async (parentId) => {
        set({ foldersLoading: true });
        try {
          const targetParent =
            parentId !== undefined ? parentId : get().currentFolderId;
          const folders = await listFolders(targetParent ?? null);
          set({ folders, foldersLoading: false });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ foldersLoading: false });
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat folder";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      setCurrentFolderId: async (folderId) => {
        set({
          currentFolderId: folderId,
          searchQuery: "",
          currentCategory: "all",
          filters: {},
        });

        if (folderId) {
          try {
            const res = await listFilesInFolder(folderId);
            set({
              files: res.files as FileItem[],
              folderBreadcrumb: res.breadcrumb,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            const msg =
              e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat folder";
            toast(msg, "error");
            set({ currentFolderId: null, folderBreadcrumb: [] });
            await get().fetchFiles();
            return;
          }
        } else {
          set({ folderBreadcrumb: [] });
          await get().fetchFiles();
        }

        await get().fetchFolders(folderId);
      },

      refreshFolderFiles: async () => {
        const fid = get().currentFolderId;
        if (fid) {
          try {
            const res = await listFilesInFolder(fid);
            set({
              files: res.files as FileItem[],
              folderBreadcrumb: res.breadcrumb,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
            const msg =
              e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal refresh file";
            toast(msg, "error");
          }
        } else {
          await get().fetchFiles();
        }
        await get().fetchFolders(fid);
      },

      deleteFolderAction: async (folderId) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa hapus folder", "error");
          return;
        }
        try {
          await deleteFolderApi(folderId);
          toast("Folder dihapus", "success");
          if (get().currentFolderId === folderId) {
            await get().setCurrentFolderId(null);
          } else {
            await get().fetchFolders(get().currentFolderId);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal menghapus folder";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchConversionOperations: async () => {
        try {
          const res = await convApi.listOperations();
          set({
            conversionOperations: Array.isArray(res.operations)
              ? res.operations
              : [],
            conversionUnsupportedOps: Array.isArray(res.unsupported)
              ? res.unsupported
              : [],
          });
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat operasi konversi";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      fetchConversionJobs: async () => {
        try {
          const jobs = await convApi.listJobs(50);
          set({ conversionJobs: jobs });
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) return;
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal memuat riwayat konversi";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      runConversion: async (operation, fileIds, params = {}) => {
        if (get().converting) return null;
        set({ converting: true });
        set({
          progress: {
            open: true,
            label: "Mengonversi…",
            sub: `${fileIds.length} file • ${operation}`,
            pct: null,
          },
        });
        try {
          const result = await convApi.runConversion({
            operation,
            file_ids: fileIds,
            params,
          });
          toast(`Konversi berhasil: ${result.result_file.name}`, "success");
          await get().refreshFolderFiles();
          await get().fetchConversionJobs();
          get().refreshPool();
          return result;
        } catch (e) {
          let msg = "Konversi gagal";
          if (e instanceof ApiError) {
            if (e.isDriveError) {
              const email = e.driveEmail || "Google Drive";
              msg =
                `${email} perlu di-reconnect. ` +
                `Buka menu 'Google Drive' → hapus akun lama → connect ulang.`;
              if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
                window.dispatchEvent(
                  new CustomEvent("yudit:drive-auth-error", {
                    detail: {
                      email: e.driveEmail,
                      driveId: e.driveId,
                      message: e.detail,
                    },
                  }),
                );
              }
            } else if (e.status === 401) {
              msg =
                "Refresh token Google Drive sudah tidak valid. " +
                "Buka menu 'Google Drive' → hapus akun lama → connect ulang.";
            } else if (e.status === 402) {
              msg =
                "Kuota iLovePDF habis atau tool premium-only. " +
                "Login developer.ilovepdf.com untuk upgrade plan.";
            } else {
              msg = e.detail;
            }
          }
          toast(msg, "error");
          get().fetchConversionJobs();
          return null;
        } finally {
          set({
            converting: false,
            progress: { open: false, label: "", sub: "", pct: null },
          });
        }
      },

      refreshPool: async () => {
        try {
          const pool = await drivesApi.getPoolSummary();
          set({ pool: pool as PoolInfo });
        } catch {
          // silent
        }
      },

      refreshQuota: async () => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa refresh quota", "error");
          return;
        }
        if (get().quotaRefreshing) return;
        set({ quotaRefreshing: true });
        try {
          await drivesApi.forceRefreshQuota();
          await get().fetchDrives();
          toast("Quota berhasil di-refresh", "success");
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal refresh quota";
          toast(msg, "error");
        } finally {
          set({ quotaRefreshing: false });
        }
      },

      removeDrive: async (id) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa hapus drive", "error");
          throw new Error("Forbidden");
        }
        try {
          await drivesApi.disconnectDrive(id);
          toast("Akun Drive dihapus", "success");
          await get().fetchDrives();
        } catch (e) {
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal hapus drive";
          toast(msg, "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      uploadFiles: async (fileList, folderId) => {
        if (fileList.length === 0) return;

        const total = fileList.length;
        let done = 0;
        let driveAuthErrorCount = 0;

        const targetFolderId =
          folderId !== undefined ? folderId : get().currentFolderId;

        set({
          progress: {
            open: true,
            label: `Mengunggah 0/${total}`,
            sub: targetFolderId ? "Uploading ke folder aktif…" : "Menyiapkan…",
            pct: 0,
          },
        });

        for (const file of fileList) {
          try {
            await filesApi.uploadFile(file, targetFolderId, (pct) => {
              const overall = Math.round(((done + pct / 100) / total) * 100);
              set({
                progress: {
                  open: true,
                  label: `Mengunggah ${done + 1}/${total}`,
                  sub: file.name,
                  pct: overall,
                },
              });
            });
            done++;
            toast(`"${file.name}" berhasil diunggah`, "success");
          } catch (e) {
            if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) {
              driveAuthErrorCount++;
              const detail = e.detail || "";
              const isDriveError =
                e.isDriveError ||
                detail.toLowerCase().includes("drive") ||
                detail.toLowerCase().includes("reconnect") ||
                detail.toLowerCase().includes("revoked");

              if (isDriveError) {
                toast(
                  `"${file.name}" gagal upload: Google Drive perlu di-reconnect. ` +
                    `Buka menu "Google Drive" untuk memperbaiki.`,
                  "error",
                );

                if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
                  window.dispatchEvent(
                    new CustomEvent("yudit:drive-auth-error", {
                      detail: {
                        email: e.driveEmail,
                        driveId: e.driveId,
                        message: e.detail,
                      },
                    }),
                  );
                }
              } else {
                toast(`Gagal upload "${file.name}": ${detail}`, "error");
              }
              continue;
            }

            const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Upload gagal";
            toast(`Gagal upload "${file.name}": ${msg}`, "error");
          }
        }

        set({ progress: { open: false, label: "", sub: "", pct: null } });

        if (done > 0) {
          await get().refreshFolderFiles();
          get().refreshPool();
        }

        if (done === 0 && driveAuthErrorCount > 0) {
          // Banner sudah muncul via event listener
        }
      },

      deleteFile: async (id) => {
        try {
          await filesApi.deleteFile(id);
          set((s) => ({ files: s.files.filter((f) => f.id !== id) }));
          toast("File dihapus", "success");
          get().refreshPool();
          if (get().currentFolderId) {
            await get().fetchFolders(get().currentFolderId);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.isDriveError) {
            const email = e.driveEmail || "Google Drive";
            toast(
              `${email} perlu di-reconnect. Buka menu "Google Drive".`,
              "error",
            );
            if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
              window.dispatchEvent(
                new CustomEvent("yudit:drive-auth-error", {
                  detail: {
                    email: e.driveEmail,
                    driveId: e.driveId,
                    message: e.detail,
                  },
                }),
              );
            }
            return;
          }
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal hapus file";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      updateFileCategory: async (id, category) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa ubah kategori", "error");
          return;
        }
        try {
          const res = await filesApi.updateCategory(id, category);
          set((s) => ({
            files: s.files.map((f) =>
              f.id === id ? { ...f, ...res.file } : f,
            ),
          }));
          toast("Kategori diperbarui", "success");
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal update kategori";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      setCategory: (cat) => {
        set({ currentCategory: cat });
        if (get().currentFolderId) return;

        const { filters, searchQuery } = get();
        get().fetchFiles({
          category: cat !== "all" ? cat : undefined,
          search: searchQuery || undefined,
          ...filters,
        });
      },

      setSearch: (q) => {
        set({ searchQuery: q });
        if (get().currentFolderId) return;

        const { filters, currentCategory } = get();
        get().fetchFiles({
          category: currentCategory !== "all" ? currentCategory : undefined,
          search: q || undefined,
          ...filters,
        });
      },

      setMonthlySearch: (q) => set({ monthlySearchQuery: q }),

      setFilters: (f) => {
        set({ filters: f });
        if (get().currentFolderId) return;

        const { currentCategory, searchQuery } = get();
        get().fetchFiles({
          category: currentCategory !== "all" ? currentCategory : undefined,
          search: searchQuery || undefined,
          ...f,
        });
      },

      resetFilters: () => {
        set({ filters: {} });
        if (get().currentFolderId) return;

        const { currentCategory, searchQuery } = get();
        get().fetchFiles({
          category: currentCategory !== "all" ? currentCategory : undefined,
          search: searchQuery || undefined,
        });
      },

      setFilterPanelOpen: (open) => set({ filterPanelOpen: open }),

      toggleMonthly: (key) =>
        set((s) => ({
          expandedMonthly: {
            ...s.expandedMonthly,
            [key]: !s.expandedMonthly[key],
          },
        })),

      collapseAllMonthly: () => set({ expandedMonthly: {} }),

      expandAllMonthly: () => {
        const grouped = groupByFolder(get().files);
        const out: Record<string, boolean> = {};
        Object.keys(grouped).forEach((k) => (out[k] = true));
        set({ expandedMonthly: out });
      },

      openPreview: (id) => set({ previewFileId: id }),
      closePreview: () => set({ previewFileId: null }),
      openShare: (id) => set({ shareFileId: id }),
      closeShare: () => set({ shareFileId: null }),

      createShare: async (cfg) => {
        const id = get().shareFileId;
        if (!id) return;
        try {
          const res = await shareApi.createShare({
            file_id: id,
            expires_hours: cfg.expires_hours,
            password: cfg.password,
          });
          set((s) => ({
            files: s.files.map((f) =>
              f.id === id
                ? {
                    ...f,
                    is_public: true,
                    share_token: res.token,
                    share_expires_at: res.expires_at,
                  }
                : f,
            ),
          }));
          toast("Link share dibuat", "success");
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 403) {
            get().closeShare();
            toast(
              e.detail ||
                "Anda tidak punya izin share file ini. " +
                  "Minta owner menambahkan permission share.",
              "error",
            );
            throw e;
          }
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 410) {
            get().closeShare();
            toast(
              "File ini terkait Google Drive yang sudah dihapus. " +
                "Reconnect akun Google Drive untuk mengakses kembali.",
              "error",
            );
            throw e;
          }
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal buat share";
          toast(msg, "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      revokeShare: async (id) => {
        try {
          await shareApi.revokeShare(id);
          set((s) => ({
            files: s.files.map((f) =>
              f.id === id
                ? { ...f, is_public: false, share_token: null, share_views: 0 }
                : f,
            ),
          }));
          toast("Share dicabut", "success");
        } catch (e) {
          const msg = e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal cabut share";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      openAssignModal: (fileId) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa assign", "error");
          return;
        }
        set({ assignModalOpen: true, assignModalFileId: fileId });
      },

      closeAssignModal: () =>
        set({ assignModalOpen: false, assignModalFileId: null }),

      openEditor: (fileId, mode = "local") =>
        set({ editorState: { fileId, mode } }),

      closeEditor: () => set({ editorState: null }),

      setCategoryManagerOpen: (open) => {
        if (open && !canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast(
            "Hanya owner atau super admin yang bisa kelola kategori",
            "error",
          );
          return;
        }
        set({ categoryManagerOpen: open });
      },

      addCustomCategory: async (name, icon, keywords) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Akses ditolak", "error");
          throw new Error("Forbidden");
        }
        try {
          await catApi.createCategory({ name, icon, keywords });
          toast(`Kategori "${name}" ditambahkan`, "success");
          await get().fetchCategories();
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal tambah kategori";
          toast(msg, "error");
          throw e;
        }
      },

      removeCustomCategory: async (id) => {
        if (!canManageWorkspace(get().user)) {
          toast("Akses ditolak", "error");
          return;
        }
        try {
          await catApi.deleteCategory(id);
          toast("Kategori dihapus", "success");
          await get().fetchCategories();
        } catch (e) {
          const msg =
            e instanceof ApiError ? e.detail : "Gagal hapus kategori";
          toast(msg, "error");
        }
      },

      showConfirm: (title, text, onConfirm) =>
        set({ confirmDialog: { open: true, title, text, onConfirm } }),

      closeConfirm: () =>
        set((s) => ({
          confirmDialog: {
            ...s.confirmDialog,
            open: false,
            onConfirm: null,
          },
        })),

      showProgress: (label, sub, pct = null) =>
        set({ progress: { open: true, label, sub, pct } }),

      hideProgress: () =>
        set((s) => ({ progress: { ...s.progress, open: false } })),

      setDriveAuthError: (email, message) =>
        set({
          driveAuthError: {
            email,
            message,
            lastAt: Date.now(),
          },
        }),

      clearDriveAuthError: () =>
        set({
          driveAuthError: { email: null, message: null, lastAt: null },
        }),
    }),
    {
      name: "yudit-cloud-store",
      // ⭐ PERSIST isAuthenticated, user, currentView
      // Ini kunci supaya /scan dan /transfer tahu sesi SEBELUM render
      partialize: (s) => ({
        isAuthenticated: s.isAuthenticated,
        user: s.user,
        currentView: s.currentView,
        filters: s.filters,
        expandedMonthly: s.expandedMonthly,
      }),
      // ⭐ Hydration callback: setelah localStorage dibaca,
      // set bootstrapped=true kalau ada token.
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state) => {
        if (!state) return;
        if (state.isAuthenticated && state.user && getToken()) {
          state.bootstrapped = true;
        }
      },
    },
  ),
);

// =====================================================
// HELPERS
// =====================================================
export function groupByFolder(
  files: FileItem[],
): Record<string, FileItem[]> {
  const grouped: Record<string, FileItem[]> = {};
  for (const f of files) {
    const key = f.folder_name || "Tanpa Folder";
    if (!grouped[key]) grouped[key] = [];
    grouped[key].push(f);
  }
  return grouped;
}

export function categoryCounts(
  files: FileItem[],
): Record<string, number> {
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const f of files) {
    if (f.category) out[f.category] = (out[f.category] || 0) + 1;
  }
  return out;
}

export function availableYears(files: FileItem[]): string[] {
  const set = new Set<string>();
  files.forEach((f) => {
    if (f.year != null) {
      set.add(String(f.year));
    }
  });
  return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
}

// GLOBAL EVENT LISTENERS
// =====================================================
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("yudit:unauthorized", () => {
    useYudit.getState().logout();
  });

  window.addEventListener("yudit:drive-auth-error", ((e: Event) => {
    const detail = (e as CustomEvent<{
      email?: string | null;
      driveId?: string | null;
      message?: string | null;
    }>).detail;

    if (!detail) return;

    const email = detail.email || null;
    const message =
      detail.message ||
      "Google Drive perlu di-reconnect. Buka menu Google Drive untuk memperbaiki.";

    useYudit.getState().setDriveAuthError(email, message);

    const state = useYudit.getState();
    if (canManageWorkspace(state.user)) {
      state.fetchDrives().catch(() => {
        /* silent */
      });
    }
  }) as EventListener);
}

// src/lib/api/oauth.ts
import { api } from "./client";

// =====================================================
// TYPES
// =====================================================
export interface OAuthResult {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  /** Error code yang mungkin:
   *  - "cancelled"         → user tutup popup manual
   *  - "popup_blocked"     → popup diblokir browser
   *  - "timeout"           → 5 menit tidak ada respons
   *  - "max_accounts"      → batas akun tercapai
   *  - "duplicate_account" → email Google sudah pernah connect
   *  - "no_refresh_token"  → Google tidak kirim refresh token
   *  - "invalid_state"     → state JWT tidak valid
   *  - "network_error"     → gagal fetch auth_url
   *  - <lainnya>           → pesan error dari server
   */
}

// =====================================================
// CONSTANTS
// =====================================================
const OAUTH_CHANNEL_NAME = "yudit:oauth-channel";
const OAUTH_STORAGE_KEY = "yudit:oauth-result";
const MAX_WAIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 menit

// =====================================================
// GET AUTH URL
// =====================================================
export async function getGoogleConnectUrl(): Promise<string> {
  const { data } = await api.get<{ auth_url: string }>("/oauth/google/connect");
  return data.auth_url;
}

// =====================================================
// CONNECT GOOGLE DRIVE (via popup OAuth)
// =====================================================
/**
 * Buka popup Google OAuth, tunggu sampai callback redirect.
 *
 * Strategi komunikasi cross-window (3 mekanisme redundan):
 * 1. postMessage (primary, paling cepat)
 * 2. BroadcastChannel (fallback modern browser)
 * 3. localStorage storage event (fallback paling kompatibel)
 *
 * ⚠️ CATATAN: window.closed TIDAK dipakai sebagai primary signal
 * karena COOP memblokir di Chrome ketika popup masih di cross-origin
 * (accounts.google.com). Polling tetap ada tapi SUPPRESS error noise.
 */
export function connectGoogleDrive(): Promise<OAuthResult> {
  return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
    let resolved = false;
    let pollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
    let broadcastChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
    let storageHandler: ((e: StorageEvent) => void) | null = null;
    let messageHandler: ((e: MessageEvent) => void) | null = null;
    let currentPopup: Window | null = null;

    const cleanup = () => {
      if (pollTimer) {
        clearInterval(pollTimer);
        pollTimer = null;
      }
      if (broadcastChannel) {
        try {
          broadcastChannel.close();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
        broadcastChannel = null;
      }
      if (storageHandler) {
        window.removeEventListener("storage", storageHandler);
        storageHandler = null;
      }
      if (messageHandler) {
        window.removeEventListener("message", messageHandler);
        messageHandler = null;
      }
      try {
        currentPopup?.close();
      } catch {
        // ignore — mungkin COOP block
      }
    };

    const finish = (result: OAuthResult) => {
      if (resolved) return;
      resolved = true;

      // Clear storage key agar event berikutnya tidak memicu resolve
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(OAUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }

      cleanup();
      resolve(result);
    };

    try {
      // ---- 1. Ambil auth_url dari backend ----
      const url = await getGoogleConnectUrl();
      if (!url) {
        finish({ ok: false, error: "auth_url tidak ditemukan" });
        return;
      }

      // ---- 2. Buka popup ----
      const w = 520;
      const h = 640;
      const dualScreenLeft = window.screenLeft ?? window.screenX ?? 0;
      const dualScreenTop = window.screenTop ?? window.screenY ?? 0;
      const width =
        window.innerWidth ||
        document.documentElement.clientWidth ||
        screen.width;
      const height =
        window.innerHeight ||
        document.documentElement.clientHeight ||
        screen.height;
      const left = width / 2 - w / 2 + dualScreenLeft;
      const top = height / 2 - h / 2 + dualScreenTop;

      const popup = window.open(
        url,
        "google-oauth-yudit",
        `width=${w},height=${h},left=${left},top=${top},resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`,
      );

      currentPopup = popup;

      if (!popup) {
        finish({ ok: false, error: "popup_blocked" });
        return;
      }

      // ---- 3. Listener: postMessage (primary) ----
      messageHandler = (e: MessageEvent) => {
        if (!e.data || e.data.type !== "yudit:oauth") return;
        finish({
          ok: !!e.data.success,
          error: e.data.error || undefined,
        });
      };
      window.addEventListener("message", messageHandler);

      // ---- 4. Listener: storage event (cross-tab fallback) ----
      storageHandler = (e: StorageEvent) => {
        if (e.key !== OAUTH_STORAGE_KEY || !e.newValue) return;
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
          if (payload?.type !== "yudit:oauth") return;
          finish({
            ok: !!payload.success,
            error: payload.error || undefined,
          });
        } catch {
          // ignore parse error
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener("storage", storageHandler);

      // ---- 5. Listener: BroadcastChannel (modern fallback) ----
      if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== "undefined") {
        try {
          broadcastChannel = new BroadcastChannel(OAUTH_CHANNEL_NAME);
          broadcastChannel.onmessage = (msg) => {
            if (!msg.data || msg.data.type !== "yudit:oauth") return;
            finish({
              ok: !!msg.data.success,
              error: msg.data.error || undefined,
            });
          };
        } catch {
          // BroadcastChannel not available — abaikan, fallback ke 2 channel lain
        }
      }

      // ---- 6. Polling: deteksi popup ditutup manual ----
      // window.closed TIDAK reliable karena COOP, tapi tetap dipakai
      // dengan try/catch DEFENSIVE untuk deteksi user cancel.
      const startTime = Date.now();

      pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
        // Batas maksimal — hindari memory leak
        if (Date.now() - startTime > MAX_WAIT_MS) {
          finish({ ok: false, error: "timeout" });
          return;
        }

        try {
          // Kalau COOP block, ini throw → catch → abaikan
          // Kalau berhasil dicek dan popup sudah tutup → cancelled
          if (!popup || popup.closed) {
            // Delay kecil untuk handle race dengan postMessage yang telat
            setTimeout(() => {
              finish({ ok: false, error: "cancelled" });
            }, 600);
          }
        } catch {
          // COOP block — abaikan, tetap polling.
          // User kemungkinan masih di halaman Google.
        }
      }, 1000);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg =
        e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Gagal membuka OAuth popup";
      finish({ ok: false, error: msg });
    }
  });
}

// src/lib/api/scan.ts
import { api } from "./client";

export type OutputFormat = "pdf" | "docx" | "jpg" | "png";
export type PageSize = "A4" | "A3" | "Letter" | "Legal" | "auto";
export type FilterType = "none" | "enhance" | "bw" | "grayscale" | "magic";
export type SessionStatus =
  | "draft" | "processing" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export interface ScanPage {
  id: string;
  session_id: string;
  page_order: number;
  original_order: number;
  original_storage_path: string;
  edited_storage_path: string | null;
  original_width: number | null;
  original_height: number | null;
  original_size: number | null;
  mime_type: string | null;
  edit_operations: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  filter_applied: FilterType | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  preview_url: string | null;
}

export interface ScanSession {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  owner_id: string;
  title: string;
  status: SessionStatus;
  output_format: OutputFormat;
  page_size: PageSize;
  quality: number;
  result_file_id: string | null;
  result_size: number | null;
  page_count: number;
  error_message: string | null;
  provider: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  completed_at: string | null;
  pages?: ScanPage[];
}

export async function createScanSession(payload: {
  title?: string;
  output_format?: OutputFormat;
  page_size?: PageSize;
  quality?: number;
}): Promise<ScanSession> {
  const { data } = await api.post("/scan/sessions", payload);
  return data;
}

export async function listScanSessions(limit = 30): Promise<ScanSession[]> {
  const { data } = await api.get("/scan/sessions", { params: { limit } });
  return data;
}

export async function getScanSession(id: string): Promise<ScanSession> {
  const { data } = await api.get(`/scan/sessions/${id}`);
  return data;
}

export async function updateScanSession(
  id: string,
  patch: Partial<Pick<ScanSession, "title" | "output_format" | "page_size" | "quality">>,
): Promise<ScanSession> {
  const { data } = await api.patch(`/scan/sessions/${id}`, patch);
  return data;
}

export async function deleteScanSession(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await api.delete(`/scan/sessions/${id}`);
}

export async function uploadScanPage(
  sessionId: string,
  file: Blob,
  originalOrder = 0,
  onProgress?: (pct: number) => void,
): Promise<ScanPage> {
  const form = new FormData();
  const fname = file instanceof File ? file.name : `capture_${Date.now()}.jpg`;
  form.append("file", file, fname);
  form.append("original_order", String(originalOrder));

  const { data } = await api.post(
    `/scan/sessions/${sessionId}/pages`,
    form,
    {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      onUploadProgress: (e) => {
        if (onProgress && e.total) {
          onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100));
        }
      },
      timeout: 120_000,
    },
  );
  return data;
}

export async function updateScanPage(
  sessionId: string,
  pageId: string,
  patch: {
    page_order?: number;
    edit_operations?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    filter_applied?: FilterType | null;
  },
): Promise<ScanPage> {
  const { data } = await api.patch(
    `/scan/sessions/${sessionId}/pages/${pageId}`,
    patch,
  );
  return data;
}

export async function deleteScanPage(
  sessionId: string,
  pageId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await api.delete(`/scan/sessions/${sessionId}/pages/${pageId}`);
}

export async function reorderScanPages(
  sessionId: string,
  pageIds: string[],
): Promise<ScanPage[]> {
  const { data } = await api.post(
    `/scan/sessions/${sessionId}/pages/reorder`,
    { page_ids: pageIds },
  );
  return data;
}

export async function processScanSession(
  sessionId: string,
  options?: {
    output_format?: OutputFormat;
    page_size?: PageSize;
    quality?: number;
    folder_id?: string | null;
    category?: string | null;
    use_ilovepdf?: boolean;
  },
): Promise<{
  session_id: string;
  status: string;
  result_file: any;
  drive_email: string;
  folder_name: string;
}> {
  const { data } = await api.post(
    `/scan/sessions/${sessionId}/process`,
    options || {},
    { timeout: 300_000 },
  );
  return data;
}

// src/lib/api/share.ts
import { api, getApiUrl } from "./client";

export interface ShareCreatePayload {
  file_id: string;
  expires_hours?: number | null;
  password?: string | null;
}

export interface ShareCreateResponse {
  token: string;
  url: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
  has_password: boolean;
}

export interface ShareInfo {
  name: string;
  size: number;
  mime_type: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  has_password: boolean;
  views: number;
}

// src/lib/api/share.ts — PATCH

export async function createShare(
  payload: ShareCreatePayload,
): Promise<ShareCreateResponse> {
  try {
    const { data } = await api.post<ShareCreateResponse>(
      "/share/create",
      payload,
    );
    return data;
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err?.status === 403) {
      // Backend tolak karena permission share tidak diberikan
      throw new Error(
        err.detail ||
          "Anda tidak punya izin share file ini. " +
            "Minta owner menambahkan permission share di assignment.",
      );
    }
    if (err?.status === 410) {
      throw new Error(
        "File ini terkait Google Drive yang sudah dihapus. " +
          "Reconnect akun Google Drive untuk mengakses kembali.",
      );
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function revokeShare(fileId: string): Promise<void> {
  await api.delete(`/share/${fileId}`);
}

/**
 * URL publik untuk share link — dipakai user untuk share ke orang lain.
 * Mengarah ke halaman frontend /share/[token] (BUKAN API).
 */
export function getShareUrl(token: string): string {
  const base =
    typeof window !== "undefined"
      ? window.location.origin
      : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || "";
  return `${base}/share/${token}`;
}

/**
 * URL API untuk download via share token.
 */
export function getShareDownloadUrl(token: string, password?: string): string {
  const q = password ? `?password=${encodeURIComponent(password)}` : "";

===== FILE: src/lib/api/client.ts =====
// src/lib/api/client.ts
/**
 * Axios API client.
 *
 * Semua URL dibaca dari `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`.
 * TIDAK ada hardcode domain.
 *
 * Fitur:
 * - Auto-attach Bearer token
 * - Auto-logout saat 401 JWT (bukan Drive) dengan THROTTLE
 * - Deteksi Drive auth error via header & message (CORS-safe)
 * - Parse error dari Blob & JSON (termasuk FastAPI validation errors)
 */
import axios, { AxiosError, InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from "axios";

// =====================================================
// ENV — WAJIB DI-SET
// =====================================================
const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL;

if (!API_URL) {
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  console.error(
    "[yudit/api] ❌ NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is not set. " +
      "Set it in .env.local (dev) or Vercel Environment Variables (prod).",
  );
}

export const API_BASE_URL = (API_URL || "").trim().replace(/\/$/, "");

// =====================================================
// STORAGE KEYS
// =====================================================
export const TOKEN_KEY = "yudit_token";
export const USER_KEY = "yudit_user";

// =====================================================
// AXIOS INSTANCE
// =====================================================
export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  timeout: 120_000,
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  withCredentials: false,
});

// =====================================================
// TOKEN & USER STORAGE
// =====================================================
export function getToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function setToken(token: string): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export function clearToken(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

export function getStoredUser<T = unknown>(): T | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function setStoredUser(user: unknown): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

// =====================================================
// REQUEST INTERCEPTOR
// =====================================================
api.interceptors.request.use((config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
  const token = getToken();
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// =====================================================
// HELPERS
// =====================================================
const PUBLIC_PATHS = ["/share/", "/auth/login", "/auth/register"];

function isPublicPath(url?: string): boolean {
  if (!url) return false;
  return PUBLIC_PATHS.some((p) => url.includes(p));
}

/**
 * ⭐ Extract error detail — handle JSON, string, Blob, dan FastAPI
 * validation errors (array of {loc, msg, type}).
 */
async function extractErrorDetail(data: unknown): Promise<string> {
  if (!data) return "";
  if (typeof data === "string") return data;

  // Handle Blob (untuk responseType: 'blob')
  if (data instanceof Blob) {
    try {
      const text = await data.text();
      try {
        const json = JSON.parse(text);
        return extractErrorDetail(json);
      } catch {
        return text;
      }
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }

  if (typeof data === "object") {
    const obj = data as Record<string, unknown>;

    // ⭐ Handle FastAPI validation errors:
    // {"detail": [{"loc": ["body", "email"], "msg": "value is not a valid email", "type": "..."}]}
    if (Array.isArray(obj.detail)) {
      return obj.detail
        .map((item: any) => {
          if (typeof item === "string") return item;
          if (item?.msg) {
            const loc = Array.isArray(item.loc)
              ? item.loc.filter((x: any) => typeof x === "string").slice(-1)[0]
              : "";
            return loc ? `${loc}: ${item.msg}` : item.msg;
          }
          return JSON.stringify(item);
        })
        .join("; ");
    }

    // Handle detail string biasa (FastAPI HTTPException)
    if (typeof obj.detail === "string") return obj.detail;

    // Handle detail object dari backend error format baru
    // { "detail": { "detail": "...", "code": "...", "request_id": "..." } }
    if (typeof obj.detail === "object" && obj.detail !== null) {
      const d = obj.detail as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof d.detail === "string") return d.detail;
      if (typeof d.message === "string") return d.message;
    }

    // Handle message string (custom error format)
    if (typeof obj.message === "string") return obj.message;

    // Fallback: try JSON.stringify supaya tidak hilang
    try {
      const str = JSON.stringify(obj);
      return str.length > 500 ? str.slice(0, 500) + "…" : str;
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }

  return "";
}

function looksLikeDriveAuthMessage(detail: string): boolean {
  if (!detail) return false;
  const lower = detail.toLowerCase();
  return (
    lower.includes("reconnect") ||
    lower.includes("refresh token") ||
    lower.includes("revoked") ||
    (lower.includes("google drive") &&
      (lower.includes("tidak valid") ||
        lower.includes("dinonaktifkan") ||
        lower.includes("invalid")))
  );
}

// =====================================================
// ⭐ UNAUTHORIZED THROTTLE — cegah spam 401
// =====================================================
let lastUnauthorizedAt = 0;
const UNAUTHORIZED_THROTTLE_MS = 1500; // 1.5 detik

function triggerUnauthorizedOnce() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastUnauthorizedAt < UNAUTHORIZED_THROTTLE_MS) {
    return; // Skip — baru saja logout
  }
  lastUnauthorizedAt = now;
  clearToken();
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("yudit:unauthorized"));
}

// =====================================================
// ApiError CLASS
// =====================================================
export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  detail: string;
  isDriveError?: boolean;
  driveEmail?: string;
  driveId?: string;
  code?: string;
  requestId?: string;
  retryAfter?: number;

  constructor(status: number, detail: string, code?: string) {
    super(detail);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.detail = detail;
    this.code = code;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// RESPONSE INTERCEPTOR
// =====================================================
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error: AxiosError<unknown>) => {
    const url = error.config?.url;
    const status = error.response?.status || 0;
    const headers = (error.response?.headers || {}) as Record<string, string>;
    const requestId = headers["x-request-id"] || undefined;

    if (!error.response) {
      const msg =
        error.code === "ECONNABORTED"
          ? "Request timeout — server tidak merespons."
          : "Tidak bisa terhubung ke server. Periksa koneksi atau CORS.";
      console.error("[yudit/api] Network error:", error.message, url);
      return Promise.reject(new ApiError(0, msg));
    }

    const detail =
      (await extractErrorDetail(error.response.data)) ||
      error.message ||
      "Terjadi kesalahan";

    // Deteksi drive auth error
    const headerDriveError =
      headers["x-drive-error"] === "reconnect_required";
    const messageDriveError =
      status === 401 && looksLikeDriveAuthMessage(detail);
    const isDriveError = headerDriveError || messageDriveError;

    // ⭐ Rate limit handling
    let retryAfter: number | undefined;
    if (status === 429) {
      const ra = headers["retry-after"];
      if (ra) {
        const n = parseInt(ra, 10);
        if (!isNaN(n)) retryAfter = n;
      }
    }

    // ⭐ Auto-logout hanya 401 JWT, bukan Drive, bukan public, dengan THROTTLE
    if (
      status === 401 &&
      !isPublicPath(url) &&
      !isDriveError &&
      getToken()
    ) {
      triggerUnauthorizedOnce();
    }

    const apiError = new ApiError(
      status,
      String(detail),
      headers["x-error-code"] || undefined,
    );
    apiError.requestId = requestId;
    apiError.retryAfter = retryAfter;
    if (isDriveError) {
      apiError.isDriveError = true;
      apiError.driveEmail = headers["x-drive-email"] || "";
      apiError.driveId = headers["x-drive-id"] || "";
    }

    return Promise.reject(apiError);
  },
);

// =====================================================
// URL HELPER
// =====================================================
export function getApiUrl(path: string): string {
  if (path.startsWith("http")) return path;
  if (!API_BASE_URL) {
    throw new ApiError(
      0,
      "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL belum diset. Cek Environment Variables di Vercel.",
    );
  }
  return `${API_BASE_URL}${path.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${path}`;
}

export async function uploadFile(
  file: File,
  folderId?: string | null,
  onProgress?: (pct: number) => void,
): Promise<UploadResponse> {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append("file", file);
  if (folderId) form.append("folder_id", folderId);

  const { data } = await api.post<UploadResponse>("/files/upload", form, {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    onUploadProgress: (e) => {
      if (onProgress && e.total) {
        onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100));
      }
    },
    // ⭐ 10 menit untuk upload file besar
    timeout: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  return data;
}

    );

===== FILE: src/services/uploadQueue.ts =====
// src/services/uploadQueue.ts
/**
 * Upload queue untuk multiple files dengan konkurensi terbatas.
 * Berguna kalau user drop banyak file sekaligus.
 */

import { uploadFile } from "./uploadService";
import type {
  UploadOptions,
  UploadProgress,
  UploadResult,
} from "@/types/upload";

export type QueueItemStatus =
  | "queued"
  | "uploading"
  | "done"
  | "failed"
  | "cancelled";

export interface QueueItem {
  id: string;
  file: File;
  status: QueueItemStatus;
  progress: UploadProgress | null;
  result: UploadResult | null;
  error: string | null;
  abortController: AbortController;
}

export interface UploadQueueOptions extends Omit<UploadOptions, "signal" | "onProgress"> {
  /** Max upload concurrent (default 2) */
  concurrency?: number;
  /** Callback per item progress */
  onItemProgress?: (itemId: string, progress: UploadProgress) => void;
  /** Callback per item complete */
  onItemComplete?: (itemId: string, result: UploadResult) => void;
  /** Callback seluruh queue selesai */
  onAllComplete?: (results: Map<string, UploadResult>) => void;
}

function makeId(): string {
  return `up_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
}

export class UploadQueue {
  private items: Map<string, QueueItem> = new Map();
  private queue: string[] = [];
  private activeCount = 0;
  private concurrency: number;
  private opts: UploadQueueOptions;
  private results: Map<string, UploadResult> = new Map();
  private stopped = false;

  constructor(opts: UploadQueueOptions) {
    this.opts = opts;
    this.concurrency = Math.max(1, opts.concurrency ?? 2);
  }

  /**
   * Tambah file ke queue. Return itemId.
   */
  add(file: File): string {
    const id = makeId();
    const item: QueueItem = {
      id,
      file,
      status: "queued",
      progress: null,
      result: null,
      error: null,
      abortController: new AbortController(),
    };
    this.items.set(id, item);
    this.queue.push(id);
    this.pump();
    return id;
  }

  /**
   * Batalkan satu item (kalau sedang upload atau masih queued).
   */
  cancel(id: string): void {
    const item = this.items.get(id);
    if (!item) return;
    item.abortController.abort();
    if (item.status === "queued") {
      this.queue = this.queue.filter((q) => q !== id);
      item.status = "cancelled";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Batalkan semua.
   */
  cancelAll(): void {
    this.stopped = true;
    this.queue = [];
    for (const item of this.items.values()) {
      item.abortController.abort();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Ambil semua item (untuk render UI).
   */
  getItems(): QueueItem[] {
    return Array.from(this.items.values());
  }

  /**
   * Hapus item yang sudah selesai.
   */
  clearCompleted(): void {
    for (const [id, item] of this.items.entries()) {
      if (
        item.status === "done" ||
        item.status === "failed" ||
        item.status === "cancelled"
      ) {
        this.items.delete(id);
        this.results.delete(id);
      }
    }
  }

  // =====================================================
  // INTERNAL
  // =====================================================
  private pump(): void {
    if (this.stopped) return;

    while (
      this.activeCount < this.concurrency &&
      this.queue.length > 0
    ) {
      const id = this.queue.shift()!;
      const item = this.items.get(id);
      if (!item || item.status !== "queued") continue;

      void this.processItem(item);
    }

    // Kalau queue kosong & tidak ada aktif → all complete
    if (this.queue.length === 0 && this.activeCount === 0) {
      this.opts.onAllComplete?.(this.results);
    }
  }

  private async processItem(item: QueueItem): Promise<void> {
    item.status = "uploading";
    this.activeCount++;

    try {
      const result = await uploadFile(item.file, {
        ...this.opts,
        signal: item.abortController.signal,
        onProgress: (p) => {
          item.progress = p;
          this.opts.onItemProgress?.(item.id, p);
        },
      });

      item.result = result;
      item.status = result.success ? "done" : "failed";
      item.error = result.success
        ? null
        : result.errorMessage || "Upload gagal";
      this.results.set(item.id, result);

      this.opts.onItemComplete?.(item.id, result);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = (e as Error)?.message || "Upload gagal";
      item.status = "failed";
      item.error = msg;
      const result: UploadResult = {
        success: false,
        errorMessage: msg,
        errorCode: "CLIENT_ERROR",
        retryable: true,
      };
      item.result = result;
      this.results.set(item.id, result);
      this.opts.onItemComplete?.(item.id, result);
    } finally {
      this.activeCount--;
      this.pump();
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: src/services/uploadService.ts =====
// src/services/uploadService.ts
/**
 * Upload service — two-phase upload dengan progress tracking akurat.
 *
 * Fase 1 (bytes → server): diukur via XHR onUploadProgress (0-100%)
 * Fase 2 (server → Drive): diukur via polling /status (0-100%)
 *
 * Overall progress = clientProgress × clientWeight + serverProgress × serverWeight
 */

import type {
  UploadInitResponse,
  UploadOptions,
  UploadPhase,
  UploadProgress,
  UploadResult,
  UploadStatusResponse,
} from "@/types/upload";

// =====================================================
// MAIN UPLOAD
// =====================================================
export async function uploadFile(
  file: File,
  options: UploadOptions
): Promise<UploadResult> {
  const {
    folderId,
    onProgress,
    signal,
    apiBaseUrl,
    authToken,
    clientWeight = 0.4,
    serverWeight = 0.6,
    pollIntervalMs,
    maxPollRetries = 5,
  } = options;

  const startedAt = Date.now();

  const emit = (p: UploadProgress) => {
    try {
      onProgress?.(p);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[upload] onProgress error", e);
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // FASE 1: POST /files/upload/init
  // ---------------------------------------------------
  emit({
    phase: "UPLOADING_TO_SERVER",
    overallPercent: 0,
    clientPercent: 0,
    serverPercent: 0,
    message: "Mengunggah file ke server...",
    fileName: file.name,
    bytesUploaded: 0,
    bytesTotal: file.size,
    elapsedSeconds: 0,
  });

  let initResponse: UploadInitResponse;
  try {
    initResponse = await uploadBytesToServer({
      file,
      folderId,
      apiBaseUrl,
      authToken,
      signal,
      onUploadProgress: (clientPct, loaded, total) => {
        emit({
          phase: "UPLOADING_TO_SERVER",
          overallPercent: clientPct * clientWeight,
          clientPercent: clientPct,
          serverPercent: 0,
          message: `Mengunggah ke server... ${clientPct.toFixed(0)}%`,
          fileName: file.name,
          bytesUploaded: loaded,
          bytesTotal: total,
          elapsedSeconds: (Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000,
        });
      },
    });
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const err = e as { name?: string; message?: string };

    if (err?.name === "AbortError") {
      emit({
        phase: "CANCELLED",
        overallPercent: 0,
        clientPercent: 0,
        serverPercent: 0,
        message: "Upload dibatalkan.",
        fileName: file.name,
      });
      return { success: false, errorCode: "CANCELLED" };
    }

    const msg = err?.message || "Gagal upload ke server";
    emit({
      phase: "FAILED",
      overallPercent: 0,
      clientPercent: 0,
      serverPercent: 0,
      message: msg,
      fileName: file.name,
    });
    return {
      success: false,
      errorCode: "CLIENT_UPLOAD_FAILED",
      errorMessage: msg,
      retryable: true,
    };
  }

  // Fase 1 selesai — overall = 100 × clientWeight (default 40%)
  emit({
    phase: "RECEIVED",
    overallPercent: 100 * clientWeight,
    clientPercent: 100,
    serverPercent: 0,
    message: initResponse.message || "File diterima server.",
    fileName: file.name,
    bytesUploaded: file.size,
    bytesTotal: file.size,
    elapsedSeconds: (Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000,
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // FASE 2: Polling GET /files/upload/{job_id}/status
  // ---------------------------------------------------
  const jobId = initResponse.job_id;
  const interval = Math.max(
    200,
    pollIntervalMs ?? (initResponse.poll_interval_seconds || 0.5) * 1000
  );

  let consecutiveErrors = 0;

  while (true) {
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      emit({
        phase: "CANCELLED",
        overallPercent: 0,
        clientPercent: 100,
        serverPercent: 0,
        message: "Upload dibatalkan.",
        fileName: file.name,
      });
      // Cleanup job di server
      void cleanupJob(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken);
      return { success: false, errorCode: "CANCELLED", jobId };
    }

    await sleep(interval);

    let status: UploadStatusResponse;
    try {
      status = await fetchStatus(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken, signal);
      consecutiveErrors = 0;
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const err = e as { name?: string };
      if (err?.name === "AbortError") {
        void cleanupJob(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken);
        return { success: false, errorCode: "CANCELLED", jobId };
      }

      consecutiveErrors++;
      if (consecutiveErrors >= maxPollRetries) {
        emit({
          phase: "FAILED",
          overallPercent: 0,
          clientPercent: 100,
          serverPercent: 0,
          message: "Koneksi ke server terputus saat polling status.",
          fileName: file.name,
        });
        void cleanupJob(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken);
        return {
          success: false,
          errorCode: "NETWORK_ERROR",
          errorMessage: "Koneksi ke server terputus.",
          retryable: true,
          jobId,
        };
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Hitung overall percent
    const serverPct = status.progress_percent || 0;
    const overall = 100 * clientWeight + serverPct * serverWeight;

    emit({
      phase: status.phase,
      overallPercent: Math.min(100, overall),
      clientPercent: 100,
      serverPercent: serverPct,
      message: status.message || phaseMessage(status.phase),
      speedBps: status.upload_speed_bps,
      etaSeconds: status.eta_seconds,
      bytesUploaded: status.bytes_uploaded,
      bytesTotal: status.bytes_total || file.size,
      elapsedSeconds: status.elapsed_seconds,
      fileName: status.file_name || file.name,
      category: status.category,
    });

    // Terminal states
    if (status.phase === "DONE") {
      // Konfirmasi & cleanup job di server (hemat RAM)
      void cleanupJob(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken);

      emit({
        phase: "DONE",
        overallPercent: 100,
        clientPercent: 100,
        serverPercent: 100,
        message: "Upload selesai!",
        fileName: status.file_name || file.name,
        bytesUploaded: file.size,
        bytesTotal: file.size,
        elapsedSeconds: (Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        fileMeta: status.file_meta,
        driveEmail: status.drive_email,
        folderName: status.folder_name,
        jobId,
      };
    }

    if (status.phase === "FAILED") {
      emit({
        phase: "FAILED",
        overallPercent: overall,
        clientPercent: 100,
        serverPercent: serverPct,
        message: status.error_message || "Upload gagal.",
        fileName: file.name,
        elapsedSeconds: status.elapsed_seconds,
      });

      void cleanupJob(jobId, apiBaseUrl, authToken);

      return {
        success: false,
        errorCode: status.error_code,
        errorMessage: status.error_message,
        retryable: status.retryable,
        jobId,
      };
    }
  }
}

// =====================================================
// PHASE MESSAGES
// =====================================================
function phaseMessage(phase: UploadPhase): string {
  switch (phase) {
    case "RECEIVED":
      return "File diterima server.";
    case "CLASSIFYING":
      return "Mengklasifikasi file...";
    case "SELECTING_DRIVE":
      return "Memilih Google Drive...";
    case "CREATING_FOLDER":
      return "Menyiapkan folder bulanan...";
    case "UPLOADING_DRIVE":
      return "Mengunggah ke Google Drive...";
    case "SAVING_METADATA":
      return "Menyimpan metadata...";
    default:
      return phase;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// XHR UPLOAD (bytes → server)
// =====================================================
function uploadBytesToServer(params: {
  file: File;
  folderId?: string;
  apiBaseUrl: string;
  authToken: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onUploadProgress: (pct: number, loaded: number, total: number) => void;
}): Promise<UploadInitResponse> {
  const { file, folderId, apiBaseUrl, authToken, signal, onUploadProgress } =
    params;

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("POST", `${apiBaseUrl}/files/upload/init`);

    xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", `Bearer ${authToken}`);

    xhr.upload.onprogress = (e) => {
      if (e.lengthComputable) {
        const pct = (e.loaded / e.total) * 100;
        onUploadProgress(pct, e.loaded, e.total);
      }
    };

    xhr.onload = () => {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText) as UploadInitResponse;
          resolve(data);
        } catch {
          reject(new Error("Invalid JSON response dari server"));
        }
      } else {
        let detail = `Server error ${xhr.status}`;
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
          detail = data.detail || data.message || detail;
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
        reject(new Error(detail));
      }
    };

    xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Network error saat upload"));
    xhr.ontimeout = () => reject(new Error("Upload timeout"));

    if (signal) {
      if (signal.aborted) {
        const err = new Error("Aborted");
        err.name = "AbortError";
        reject(err);
        return;
      }
      signal.addEventListener("abort", () => {
        xhr.abort();
        const err = new Error("Aborted");
        err.name = "AbortError";
        reject(err);
      });
    }

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);
    if (folderId) formData.append("folder_id", folderId);

    xhr.send(formData);
  });
}

// =====================================================
// FETCH STATUS (polling)
// =====================================================
async function fetchStatus(
  jobId: string,
  apiBaseUrl: string,
  authToken: string,
  signal?: AbortSignal
): Promise<UploadStatusResponse> {
  const res = await fetch(
    `${apiBaseUrl}/files/upload/${jobId}/status`,
    {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}` },
      signal,
    }
  );
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Status ${res.status}`);
  }
  return res.json();
}

// =====================================================
// CLEANUP JOB (fire-and-forget)
// =====================================================
async function cleanupJob(
  jobId: string,
  apiBaseUrl: string,
  authToken: string
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await fetch(`${apiBaseUrl}/files/upload/${jobId}/complete`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}` },
    });
  } catch {
    // Ignore — cleanup opsional
  }
}

// =====================================================
// SLEEP
// =====================================================
function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}
